1557501.synopsis: A routine parent-teacher interview takes a violent turn as a frustrated teacher is pushed past his breaking point by two feral parents.
1557501.title: The Parent Teacher Interview

1557636.synopsis: Naguib and his wife Mariam decide to take over a dangerous Journey to the United States starting from central America all the way to the US - Mexico Border facing many tough life threatening obstacles.
1557636.title: 40 Days

1557855.synopsis: When his daughter is falsely defamed, Chaman Lal's four daughters lose marriage prospects. A traveler named Sikander helps him find inner peace over social approval, leading to hope and his family's restoration.
1557855.title: Raavi de Kande

1557863.synopsis: The Coolangatta Gold, a punishing endurance race scripted as part of a 1980's romantic film, originating from the sport of surf lifesaving. Ali Day, the greatest ironman of all time, aims for his tenth title but his body is older and a field of competitors are desperate to beat him, including the young gun Conner Maggs.
1557863.title: Chasing the gold

1557876.synopsis: Three hopelessly incompetent crooks think they’ve pulled off the perfect scam on a mafia boss, but their theft of his treasured painting sparks a ridiculous pursuit that threatens to undo them entirely.
1557876.title: The Prequel To Competence

1557889.synopsis: Set in 1990s Punjab, near the India-Pakistan border, Sooba is a well-educated young man who runs a telephone shop yet feels incomplete without his ancestral land.
1557889.title: Soohe Ve Cheere Waleya

1557944.synopsis: A Muslim woman makes a splash at her local swimming pool with her ‘scandalous’ modest swimwear.
1557944.title: Burqini Body

1557977.synopsis: In June 2001, hundreds of kilos of cocaine washed up in a Portuguese village. This gripping documentary reveals the long-lasting impact on the community.
1557977.title: Turn of the Tide: The Surreal Story of Rabo de Peixe

1557993.synopsis: Personal interviews with Haftbefehl and those closest to him reveal the story behind the German rap icon as he takes a brutally honest look at his life.
1557993.title: Babo: The Haftbefehl Story

1558343.synopsis: On the brink of homelessness, Ruby goes to stay with her pregnant baby sister and husband after the death of their alcoholic father. Her theatrical presence and blatant lies quickly cause problems as a distraught Ruby tries to hide her vulnerable circumstance in hopes of being saved by showbusiness.
1558343.title: Hancock Park

1558380.synopsis: oh to be a kid and to dream and imagine bigger than what is possible  to see the world in technicolor  and to spend it with those who seem to make the world around you expand
1558380.title: good days

1558568.synopsis: When their team-building event gets downgraded to a tiny village, a cheese company's staff think it can't get worse — then they learn about the layoffs.
1558568.title: Go Team!

1558796.synopsis: In 2008, the graduating class of North Meadows High School had their senior year cut short due to a disastrous tornado. Now in their mid-30s, they're being forced to return home and finish high school once and for all.
1558796.title: Never Change!

1558905.synopsis: Jack Nelson isn’t your average delivery driver.  Mistakenly let out of a mental institution with a new job in small-town California, the locals are in for a nightmare. Jack isn’t looking to deliver - he’s looking for his next victim.
1558905.title: Don't Answer

1558981.synopsis: A delivery driver accidentally witnesses a crime on the job with his eight-year-old surrogate son. Now, he must protect the child from violent forces.
1558981.title: The Delivery Rider

1559135.synopsis: In a big city in China, an individual is just a dot on a gigantic wall of other dots. Social media and certain notions about masculinity make it very difficult for young men searching for a serious partner. Xao lives here. He is depressed and dreams of having a girlfriend. So he invites Lin to his home – but can he manage to open up and overcome his fear of physical contact?
1559135.title: Hello...

1559213.synopsis: A musical group made up of unique personalities tries to reunite to put on a show, but supernatural forces thwart their efforts. Each one is engaged in a personal struggle with hidden enemies.
1559213.title: Dark Room

1559440.synopsis: More than a decade ago, the Emmy-nominated documentary "Poor Kids" explored poverty in the United States as it’s rarely seen: through the eyes of children. "Born Poor" tells the stories of the same children, now grown, chronicling their lives from childhood to the present day. The 90-minute documentary follows Kaylie, Johnny and Brittany across three chapters of their lives as they grow from kids to teenagers to adults, trying to pursue their dreams while dealing with an economy where they face more obstacles than opportunities — and trying to overcome the grinding poverty that shaped their childhoods.
1559440.title: Born Poor

cast: King Charles III of the United Kingdom
1559456.synopsis: In an unprecedented portrait of King Charles III, Finding Harmony: A King's Vision provides intimate insight into His Majesty's passionate quest to reunite humanity with nature. Academy Award-winner Kate Winslet narrates this journey through The King's Foundation's vital work.
1559456.title: Finding Harmony: A King's Vision

1559491.synopsis: After twenty years running a parish with more debt than parishioners, Father Steve ends up officiating the wedding of his high school sweetheart, Isabel. But when the groom bolts, Isabel is left homeless – and Steve takes her in, with one catch: only nuns are allowed to live in the church. What starts as a holy disguise soon stirs up old feelings, and Steve must choose between his vows to God… and his heart.
1559491.title: You Gotta Have Faith

1559535.synopsis: 2050, Aqli Academy, Vancouver: Four gifted children—Abdullah, Aysha, Khalid and Layla—stumble upon the ability to time travel, they are thrust into an adventure along the historic Silk Road to protect the era's great scientists from the evil time travelling alchemist Fasid. Will the Time Hoppers be able to save the foundations of modern science and safely return home?
1559535.title: Time Hoppers: The Silk Road

1559572.synopsis: One singer. One city. One shot. Ed Sheeran rocks the streets of New York with his greatest hits in this groundbreaking, real-time music experience.
1559572.title: ONE SHOT with Ed Sheeran

1559613.synopsis: In this fearlessly honest special, Mo Amer honors his Palestinian roots, recounts confrontations on the road and relives becoming a father.
1559613.title: Mo Amer: Wild World

1559628.synopsis: A group of friends are terrorized by an anaconda during their vacation.
1559628.title: Anaconda: Blood Coil

1559632.synopsis: In a quiet British seaside town, Santana, a troubled young woman desperate to escape her suffocating family, runs away with her volatile boyfriend Frank. The pair marry in a rundown coastal venue, hoping for a fresh start — but their new life is shattered when a mysterious car rams into them on a rural night road, killing Santana instantly and leaving Frank consumed by grief and obsession. Refusing to accept her death, Frank traps his former medical professor, Dr. Pret — a man secretly infatuated with Santana — and forces him to help reanimate her using a stolen voodoo ritual. As Frank’s desperation deepens, he manipulates and blackmails Pret into harvesting “perfect” body parts from Santana’s own family, driving both men further into depravity.
1559632.title: Bride of Frankenstein Awakens

1559637.synopsis: When the deep‑space vessel Orpheus discovers a centuries‑old derelict drifting at the edge of a black hole, the crew retrieves a sealed sarcophagus from its ruins. Soon after, crew members begin to disappear. Something ancient has awakened in the void - Dracula himself, exiled to the stars and hungry after centuries of confinement.
1559637.title: Dracula in Space

1559715.synopsis: A young boy’s life is transformed when his father brings home a playful golden retriever, sparking a deep bond that grows over the years.
1559715.title: Wrong Time

1559760.synopsis: In a dystopic America, children are taught how to prepare for school shootings through elaborate drills. Yet what are intended as self-defense mechanisms are themselves deeply traumatic for students, parents, educators, and entire communities.
1559760.title: Thoughts & Prayers

1559776.synopsis: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins.
1559776.title: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas

1559984.synopsis: Middle schooler AJ finds himself joining forces with faculty and friends to save the world from an alien invasion.
1559984.title: My Weird School

1560093.synopsis: A heartfelt story of love that blossoms between two people from completely different backgrounds. As they navigate personal struggles and societal resistance, their connection deepens into something unshakable. Together, they prove that love knows no boundaries and can truly transform lives forever.
1560093.title: Soch Toh Parey

1560100.synopsis: A gripping revenge thriller set in a lonely farmhouse where a powerful man is captured and forced to confront his past sins, guilt and the darkness within.
1560100.title: Farmhouse

1560112.synopsis: Commemorate seven decades of the magic, joy and innovation of one of the most beloved theme parks in the world.
1560112.title: The Happiest Story on Earth: 70 Years of Disneyland

1560148.synopsis: A multi-story film that centers on six different Filipino families during a Christmas Eve when the internet goes out worldwide, forcing them to reconnect with each other through more traditional means.
1560148.title: Rekonek

1560168.synopsis: In the middle of annulment cases and custody battles, Celine and Ivan meet at the law office of a lawyer and YouTube host of “Walang Butas Ang Batas”. What begins as a chance encounter grows into a friendship that helps them navigate heartbreak, family, and the possibility of starting over.
1560168.title: UnMarry

1560229.synopsis: A joyful and surprising journey into the fascinating world of toddler pop, exploring why kids' music is so catchy, can be deeply meaningful, and how AI is taking hold and shaping the industry. Featuring appearances by The Wiggles, Laurie Berkner, and other musicians.
1560229.title: Music Box: Happy and You Know It

1560392.synopsis: The documentary traces Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s long campaign to destroy Iran’s nuclear capabilities and counter its proxy forces, the conflict with the Palestinians, and the role of the U.S. through decades of difficulty in the region.  Drawing on new, insider interviews, this two-hour special examines how long-running and escalating tensions between Israel and Iran erupted into all-out war in June 2025. The film also explores how multiple U.S. presidents have tried to manage the volatile issues at play.
1560392.title: Remaking the Middle East: Israel vs. Iran

1560448.synopsis: A family’s trip to rural Arkansas takes a sinister turn when they stumble upon a backwoods revival unlike any other. What begins as a curious glimpse into small-town faith soon spirals into chaos as devotion turns violent and belief gives way to bloodshed. Trapped among zealots who see salvation in sacrifice, the family must confront a terrifying force that blurs the line between the divine and the demonic. In this haunting descent into madness, faith, fear, and fanaticism fuse into unrelenting horror.
1560448.title: The Anointed

1560469.synopsis: A young boy awaits the return of his father who has worked abroad for many years
1560469.title: Kareem

1560520.synopsis: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!
1560520.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall

1560565.synopsis: Todd and Lisa are on the brink. As a big argument unfolds, we are treated to glimpses into their past when life was still ahead of them. At the end, secrets come to light, and past issues surface that threaten to tear them apart.
1560565.title: Out the Game

1560607.synopsis: FRONTLINE and NPR investigate why the U.S. is more vulnerable than ever to climate change-related storms and how Hurricane Helene became an ominous warning about America’s lack of preparedness.  In “Hurricane Helene’s Deadly Warning,” Laura Sullivan goes on the ground in North Carolina in the days after the 2024 storm and speaks with survivors who describe the devastation, fear and shock they experienced at seeing entire communities washed away. She revisits Houston, Texas, where thousands of homes remain in an area that already flooded during Harvey in 2017. Sullivan also returns to Staten Island, where, according to a former FEMA director, the billion dollar rebuilding process may not have been enough to prevent mass destruction should another Superstorm Sandy hit.
1560607.title: Hurricane Helene's Deadly Warning

1560664.synopsis: An oil worker and his dog embark on a journey to his wedding, but after a violent attack at a rest stop, he teams with his ex-convict father to seek revenge, uncovering dark secrets in their rural community.
1560664.title: The Roughneck

1560681.synopsis: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.
1560681.title: Colors of Evil: Black

1560951.synopsis: In the Moscow Metro, a choir is formed from employees—cashiers, train drivers, and station workers—learning to sing under the guidance of an enthusiastic conductor. For a contest, the conductor discovers the opera “Flood”, which is going to be performed for the first time. The opera tells the story of the last day before the world’s end. Following a triumphant premiere, the choir sets off on its first tour, only to face a real catastrophe.
1560951.title: Mind the Closing Doors

1561687.synopsis: A woman from a small town in Tamil Nadu moves to South Korea — a place she always dreamed of — but struggles to find her footing in a foreign land.
1561687.title: Made in Korea

1561758.synopsis: When financial trouble forces Halina to call off her wedding, her friends and family decide to hatch a wild plan to bring in tourist money.
1561758.title: It Takes a Village

1561840.synopsis: Reporter Tir Dhondy investigates the rise of sextortion scams targeting teenage boys on social media. Her journey leads to Nigeria, where she confronts the scammers taking part in these crimes.
1561840.title: Blackmailed: The Sextortion Killers

1561955.synopsis: A psychiatrist evaluating a self-confessed serial killer unravels a twisted web of trauma, deceit, and psychological manipulation—only to question if the killer is truly guilty or just another victim in a larger, darker game.
1561955.title: Stephen

1561969.synopsis: A cop's inquiry into child kidnappings unravels chilling secrets as supernatural events endanger his family and the peaceful town of Baramulla.
1561969.title: Baramulla

1562010.synopsis: Filmed at the end of Taylor Swift's record-breaking Eras Tour in Vancouver, B.C., this complete, in-depth 45-song concert includes the complete 'The Tortured Poets Department' set and special mashups.
1562010.title: Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour | The Final Show

1562093.synopsis: A sci-fi multiversal thriller about a man taken hostage by multiple people from different futures, all of whose survival depends on whether or not he breaks up with his fiance.
1562093.title: Jim vs the Future

1562272.synopsis: A horny teenage boy stumbles across a trail cam live feed.
1562272.title: Fawnstar

1562313.synopsis: Two friends who adore cinema, embark on a wondrous, chaotic and exhilarating journey of filmmaking
1562313.title: faire un film

1562642.synopsis: Reclusive government asset Henry Fitzgerald is living off the grid in Wyoming, designing new systems for a weapons research agency. When a multi trillion dollar investment management firm begins employing corrupt police and foreign mercenaries to force farmers off their ranches, the Green Beret veteran decides to employ his weapon prototypes to assist his neighbors.
1562642.title: Ghost Soldier

1562713.synopsis: Sophie, a young woman torn between independence and duty, attends a Chinese New Year family gathering. When a red packet is exchanged, it uncovers hidden conflicts between generations. As tensions rise, Sophie and her relatives must confront the balance between their personal freedom and cultural traditions. The Red Packet explores themes of love, duty, and unspoken emotions, blending warmth with conflict to reflect on the ties that bind families together.
1562713.title: The Red Packet

1562758.synopsis: The Father of the Araku valley hill station church, Andrew Joseph is murdered. As per the police investigation, Joseph`s car driver seems to be the culprit. However, the protagonist Krishna is not convinced. Will Krishna succeed in finding the real culprit?
1562758.title: Vanchana

1562866.synopsis: Dara Nevo, a devoted officer in the 8200 intel squadron is at a race against time when Hamas abducts an Israeli soldier and required 1000 Palestinian prisoners for his release, including the terrorist who has murdered her father in a terror attack 10 years prior.
1562866.title: Listen

1562894.synopsis: The Silver Curtain is an experimental 16mm film that examines photography through the perspective of a film lab technician, reflecting on the material and psychological act of memory preservation. Set against the legacy of Kodak in Naarm/Melbourne, the film explores the tension between remembering and forgetting, and the ecological costs of image-making. What is lost in the pursuit of memory, and what must the Earth surrender so we can remember?
1562894.title: The Silver Curtain

1562978.synopsis: A businessman's empire crumbles after a shady deal. Desperate, he and his wife's best friend (his lover) plot to kill his author wife. She must choose: finish her story or survive it.
1562978.title: My Side Piece: Full Body Massage

1563109.synopsis: Twinkle returns home for a surprise Diwali trip, but secrets and disagreements test her family's bonds in ways she never imagined.
1563109.title: Greater Kalesh

1563214.synopsis: The original L.A. GUNS lineup live in concert in Hollywood with bonus interviews and rare backstage footage.  Come along on this wild, lust-fuelled, gasoline-soaked, intoxicating rocket ride of pure 80's metallic mayhem! Tracii, Phil, Steve, Kelly and Mick (the original gunners) lay it on the line in this down & dirty tell all, a sunset strip concert with rare, never before seen backstage footage from the electric gypsies' early road ravages.  Enjoy outrageous, interviews recounting the band's origins, interspersed with vintage, raw concert footage of the boys in their prime! Relive the passion, parties, sweat and hi-octane thrills that propelled L.A. GUNS to mega-notoriety and forever etched their star on the loud 'n gritty, oh so pretty streets of the Los Angeles hard rock explosion!  Rare interview footage , Photo slideshow and extra songs too!
1563214.title: L.A. GUNS: The Hollywood Years - Live & Loaded

1563524.synopsis: A disillusioned man (Scott Cohen), whose life is completely falling apart, starts to believe that his teenage son is the Messiah, destined to save the world.
1563524.title: Circumcision

1563772.synopsis: Finlay and Joe are processing the tragic death of their friend, Luke. But when Finlay's unique coping mechanism becomes too problematic to ignore, a long-avoided conflict forces a confrontation that will change everything.
1563772.title: Pavements

1563897.synopsis: During a freak blizzard, a remote British lodge is shut down with just two guests: Ellie, a sarcastic travel blogger, and a handsome, overly polite guest who's definitely not from around here. Turns out, he's Prince Alaric, stranded while trying to escape royal duties. With only each other and no Wi-Fi, sparks (and snowballs) fly.
1563897.title: A Christmas Snowed in with a Prince

1563903.synopsis: Hannah, a waitress in a small U.K. town, is stunned when a royal security team mistakes her for Crown Princess Helena of Camalonia. The real Helena disappeared just days before her coronation. Hannah agrees to pose as the princess to prevent national panic, only to fall for the royal advisor helping her navigate palace life.
1563903.title: The Christmas Princess Switch

1563912.synopsis: Khloe and Joyce, two trans women who work for a defense-technology corporation, fall in love when they're sent to a college career fair together. Their fragile bond forces Khloe to choose between safety and the uncertain path of freedom.
1563912.title: How to Find a Career That Loves You Back

1563925.synopsis: In his most personal documentary yet, Chris Hemsworth turns the camera on his own family after his dad’s recent Alzheimer’s diagnosis. They embark on a road trip into their past, exploring the science of social connection and how it can support memory function. They revisit meaningful places and faces, capturing it all as a home movie, and reviving treasured recollections.
1563925.title: Chris Hemsworth: A Road Trip to Remember

1563969.synopsis: Ten years after the premiere, the director takes you behind the scenes to explore the universe behind two different versions of the film, and everything that went into making it all happen.
1563969.title: Lesbian Western - The Feature

1564058.synopsis: Spidey and Iron Man team up with the Avengers to stop Ultron and Green Goblin from controlling all of the city's devices.
1564058.title: Spidey and Iron Man: Avengers Team Up!

1564072.synopsis: Ballet in three acts (1994) Encore Screenings! ‘What has become of love today?’ asked Angelin Preljocaj in 1994, when he created Le Parc for the Paris Opera Ballet. Thirty years later, the world has changed again, but his timeless ballet has travelled around the world. In a French-style garden, the choreography draws us into the seduction games of the Grand Siècle and the Age of Enlightenment, appealing to our classical musical and literary imagination: famous works by Mozart, the Map of Tendre, Dangerous Liaisons. But Preljocaj breaks with tradition by introducing a contemporary soundtrack and a choreographic language composed of broken lines and sensual movements. Like the final pas de deux, where the bodies whirl around for a languorous kiss: a moment of grace that has become the signature of this ballet.
1564072.title: Paris Opera Ballet: Le Parc

1564181.synopsis: A carefree rickshaw driver’s life changes when a don targets him and a European tourist, Isa, joins him to test her fiancé’s love. As they journey through Rajasthan’s deserts, havelis, and forts, their bond deepens—but soulmates don’t always stay together. A cross-cultural romance filled with adventure, magic, and longing.
1564181.title: Soulmates

1564232.synopsis: Filmed live at the legendary United Center arena in Chicago, Sebastian Maniscalco goes all in on family chaos, aging, and the little things that drive us all nuts—with his one-of-a-kind comedic bite.
1564232.title: Sebastian Maniscalco: It Ain't Right

1564267.synopsis: It's good old fashioned farmers (Jim Keating) vs eco-terrorist conservationists (Percy Williams).  Anything goes.
1564267.title: FAROUT

1564346.synopsis: A tragic hostage case from 2008 Brazil unfolds through unseen diary entries, family interviews, and media coverage, as a 15-year-old girl is held captive by her ex-boyfriend for 100 hours while TV networks broadcast it live.
1564346.title: Eloá the Hostage: Live on TV

1564430.synopsis: Comedy legend Colin Mochrie teams with master hypnotist Asad Mecci for HYPROV: Improv Under Hypnosis, where audience members are hypnotized into becoming fearless, laugh-out-loud improv superstars.
1564430.title: Hyprov: Improv Under Hypnosis

1564494.synopsis: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.
1564494.title: Harbinger

1564532.synopsis: Echoes of the Ancients explores the lives, genes, and legacy of Neanderthals through science, archaeology, and art. It reveals the deep roots of human identity in a visually stunning and intellectually rich journey across prehistoric Europe.
1564532.title: Echoes of the Ancients: A Journey through Neanderthal Lives

1564548.synopsis: Four Black women bond over wine, laughter, and shared anxieties about America, only to uncover deeper truths that will change them forever.
1564548.title: Not Every Woman

1564577.synopsis: A struggling screenwriter, obsessed with portraying Black Excellence and authenticity on the big screen, is forced to do a rewrite of his latest draft in order to save his career.
1564577.title: The ReWrite.

1564580.synopsis: On Christmas Eve in the middle of nowhere two men meet an abandoned girl named Mary. Chris, Max must decide if she is a miracle or their curse.
1564580.title: Mary Chris Max

1564584.synopsis: Jill Wagner and her husband invite you onto their farm to celebrate their family traditions and experience their small-town community as they celebrate the true meaning of Christmas.
1564584.title: Christmas on the Farm with Jill Wagner and Family

1564614.synopsis: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.
1564614.title: Leviticus

1564735.synopsis: After being cancelled, a BookToker stumbles into a mysterious book store looking for a comeback.
1564735.title: Bibliophile

1564812.synopsis: Tracing the dramatic and controversial rise of Robert F. Kennedy Jr., FRONTLINE examines how the scion of a storied dynasty endured tragedy and scandal, broke with the Democratic Party and his family, stoked conspiracy theories, and is reshaping government and public health.
1564812.title: The Rise of RFK Jr.

1564949.synopsis: A woman finds her peaceful home invaded when hitmen pursue a mysterious visitor and missing diamonds.
1564949.title: Deadly Visitor

1565101.synopsis: A tired and lonely cleaner finds an abandoned mobile phone in an office she is cleaning. When the phone rings and she answers it, the caller appears to be herself. When she interrogates the caller her surroundings slowly vanishes until she herself vanishes.
1565101.title: The Call

1565134.synopsis: A masterpiece of bel canto at the Teatro Real in Madrid: conductor José Miguel Pérez-Sierra and director David McVicar take on Donizetti’s Maria Stuarda, with Lisette Oropesa in the title role.
1565134.title: Gaetano Donizetti: Maria Stuarda @ Teatro Real, Madrid

1565487.synopsis: A man is recently released from prison, yet his newly free life is interupted by eeirly reasltic visions of an endless forest and haunting figures. He can't control when they happen, or when he can leave.
1565487.title: Washed In The Blood

1565509.synopsis: Alice, a basketball player, secretly likes Wayne and helps him finds his clothes after a birthday prank. She plans to invite him to see fireworks and confess her feelings despite knowing another girl likes him too. But Wayne never shows up. Alone, she finds a love letter to the other girl in his pocket and walks home in quiet heartbreak.
1565509.title: POCKET

1565733.synopsis: Tangled Hearts follows four couples as they navigate the highs and lows of their relationships, each facing challenges that test their love, faith, and trust. As their lives intertwine, these four couples learn that love is more than just romance–it requires faith, sacrifice, and sometimes, forgiveness. Their journeys are filled with emotional twists that challenge their hearts and redefine their relationships.
1565733.title: Tangled Hearts

1565790.synopsis: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.
1565790.title: Double Occupancy

1565970.synopsis: After 9/11 our Nation sent the Aussie S.A.S. into harms way to protect us. 25 years later, their suffering continues. The S.A.S. now tell their story of what really happened in Afghanistan and Iraq.
1565970.title: Bravery & Betrayal

1566073.synopsis: Songül is about to finish her shift at the hospital where she works as a nurse. Upon learning that her husband Hakkı, whom she is about to leave, is coming home to collect his belongings, she decides to go home later to avoid seeing him.
1566073.title: Until Death Do Us Part

1566230.synopsis: Michelle Wolf gets real about white women, serial killers and adjusting to motherhood in this sharp, unfiltered stand-up special.
1566230.title: Michelle Wolf: The Well

1566269.synopsis: When the holidays are filled with unexpected adventures and challenges, the Fraggles learn to appreciate each day for being unique and special, like a snowflake.
1566269.title: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock

1566512.synopsis: Set between episodes 9 and 10 of the final series, the film finds the family taking their festive spirit far from home and onto a South American cruise to Colombia. Despite best intentions, their plans quickly unravel in a series of chaotic events.
1566512.title: Bump: A Christmas Film

1566556.synopsis: Rise of the Underdog tells the captivating true story of a filmmaker's unbreakable spirit, born from unjust imprisonment. Emerging from darkness, he turns his struggles into a cinematic testament of unwavering will.
1566556.title: Rise of the Underdog

1566666.synopsis: Karl Marx, a middle-class man in his mid-forties, lives in a small housing board quarters with his mouthy wife and his two kids. As long as he can remember Karl Marx had only one dream, to buy a couple of acres of land in his native village and do farming. This middle-class man with his middle-class dream gets a reversal of fortune because of a good deed done by his father in the past. That being a cheque for an amount of one crore rupees. But fate plays a cruel trick on Karl Marx as he misplaces the cheque and struggles to find it. He has only two days to find the missing cheque and encash it. Does he find it? Does he fulfil his dream? The story that unfolds is Middle Class
1566666.title: Middle Class

1566727.synopsis: Zac Power’s position as the top teenage spy is compromised after a brilliant new agent arrives. When his recklessness allows an ostentatious supervillain to steal a high-tech weapon, Zac is forced to confront his own flaws and team up with his rival.
1566727.title: Zac Power

1566740.synopsis: Chef Seetha survives an accident and seeks to thank her saviors. She falls for stranger Abhishek, who hides a secret. When truth surfaces, she must choose between love, honesty, and her future.
1566740.title: Seetha Payanam

1567151.synopsis: Considered one of the most fearless voices in modern comedy, Nikki Glaser delivers a brutally honest special that takes on aging, beauty, and fame - confronting what it means to stay relevant, desirable, and real in a culture that never looks away.
1567151.title: Nikki Glaser: Good Girl

1567156.synopsis: The true tale of Martin McNally, a man who hijacked an American Airlines plane in 1972 in an attempt to repeat what the infamous DB Cooper did 6 months prior, and led authorities on a 5 day manhunt across the country. However this was just the beginning of one of the wildest true crime stories ever. This is the documentary version of the Top 20 Apple podcast American Skyjacker.
1567156.title: American Skyjacker

1567164.synopsis: Shaken & Stirred follows the lives of three flair bartenders at the top of their game as they set their sights on a big competition in Florida, intercut with interviews with legendary bartenders who discuss the sport’s past, present, and future.  The movie features legends from the bartending world including Christian and Rodrigo Delpech, Dario Doimo, Tom Dyer, Ivan Usov and many more!  This is the first full length feature documentary about the sport and art of flair bartending.
1567164.title: Shaken and Stirred: The Story of Flair Bartending

1567489.synopsis: Leanne Morgan discusses her rise to fame, family matters, and her one-time CBD experience.
1567489.title: Leanne Morgan: Unspeakable Things

1567605.synopsis: Tale of an elderly miser who embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.
1567605.title: Ebenezer

1567691.synopsis: Four strangers follow completely different paths through the same day. Leading them all to meeting at a beach party filled with chaos, drama, and action.
1567691.title: Currents

1567711.synopsis: When Merel joins her son on a sunny trip to Curaçao ahead of his wedding, she soon discovers the holiday is actually a singles getaway. Amid a group of hopeful romantics, unexpected encounters, and island charm, love begins to surface in ways no one anticipated.
1567711.title: Love in Curaçao

1567802.synopsis: Rock stars, wild parties, and untold stories come alive at LA's iconic Sunset Marquis hotel, where music legends created unforgettable moments during the hedonistic peak of '70s and '80s rock culture.
1567802.title: If These Walls Could Rock

1567887.synopsis: After inheriting the local toy stores, Cincy Nerd (Daniel Allen Day) and the Retro Freaks face a sinister new enemy who turns nostalgia into a nightmare. Now, they'll have to confront their past to survive the future.
1567887.title: Retro Freaks II

1567893.synopsis: After four seasons (and counting) on Saturday Night Live, Sarah Sherman's unholy alter ego, Sarah Squirm, slithers onto your screen and rips off the straitjacket, unleashing a festering and hilarious hour of bodily fluids, open-wound confessionals, and jokes that will leave scars on your soul.
1567893.title: Sarah Squirm: Live + in the Flesh

1568056.synopsis: Amidst a pandemic, a woman documents the search for her cousin who disappeared after entering a clinical trial for an experimental miracle drug called Dumitor.
1568056.title: Mirror Life

1568069.synopsis: On May 22, 2023, 47 years after their birth, Def Leppard returned to their home city to perform their second ever stadium concert in Sheffield at Bramall Lane.  Kicking off their European tour, this monumental homecoming show was performed to a sold-out roaring crowd of almost 40,000 fans. It includes classics Photograph and Pour Some Sugar on Me as well as UK live debuts Take What You Want and This Guitar, the latter dedicated to the band’s late great guitarist Steve Clark.
1568069.title: Def Leppard: Diamond Star Heroes – Live from Sheffield

1568089.synopsis: A small-town radio disk-jockey is taken hostage by a deranged killer during her overnight shift. As the night progresses, a mysterious force outside unleashes zombie-like attackers, who see the radio station as their target.
1568089.title: Air Shift

1568180.synopsis: For filmmaker Nordin Lasfar, who grew up in the Netherlands as the child of Moroccan parents, author Paul Bowles opened the door to literature and stories from the land of his forebears. In the 1960s and 70s, Tangier was a base for Western artists and writers of the Beat Generation, among them Bowles.
1568180.title: Mohammed & Paul – Once Upon a Time in Tangier

1568183.synopsis: One in ten people hear voices. In this film, we meet five people living with this phenomenon. One person hears a single voice, another hears 19. One voice wants to protect, another wants to kill.
1568183.title: My Word Against Mine

1568195.synopsis: Family tensions arise after a brother disapproves of his sister's boyfriend's family.
1568195.title: Madhaniyan

1568241.synopsis: The protagonist Sathya from Simhabettu finds himself in a dilemma after he finds out the truth behind the people he trusted the most.
1568241.title: JAI

1568348.synopsis: Four friends become hunted by a giant killer snake during a canoeing trip on the Chattahoochee River and must overcome their differences in order to survive.
1568348.title: Snake Creek

1568443.synopsis: A ship sinks off West Africa. Everyone aboard drowns, except the cook. Trapped in a small air pocket with water up to his neck, he faces a slow death as oxygen dwindles.  This extraordinary documentary follows untrained diver Nico’s daring mission to save him.  After miraculously finding the cook alive after three days, Nico faces his biggest challenge yet: navigating narrow, deadly passages to bring him to safety.  Told through authentic footage and audio from divers' helmet cams, this film showcases heroism, hope, and friendship, proving miracles can still happen.
1568443.title: Trapped

1568538.synopsis: A fearless Philly detective is sent to Atlanta after a botched drug bust. She clashes with a rising kingpin-who's dating her estranged sister-forcing her to choose between justice and family in a city where survival comes at gunpoint.
1568538.title: Bullet Rush

1568600.synopsis: Two people attempt to restart their romance after a major breakdown, believing that a “reset” will fix what went wrong. Just as hopeful habits begin, the shoals of memory, regret and new expectations force them to search for what they really want. A loop of love, loss and renewal takes them through familiar terrain with unfamiliar stakes.
1568600.title: Kadhal Reset Repeat

1568748.synopsis: Zara hates weddings—especially when her demanding cousin insists she bring a date to hers. Dreading the event, she enlists her best friend Jamie to help her find the perfect plus one. But each disastrous and awkward date only deepens her frustration and forces her to question what she’s really looking for. As the big day approaches, Zara begins to realize that the perfect partner might not be a stranger at all, but someone who’s been by her side all along.
1568748.title: 4 First Dates

1568856.synopsis: A man uses dark magic to make his brother's wife fall in love with him, but the spell corrupts natural desire into destructive obsession and summons supernatural terrors.
1568856.title: Whispers of the Witching Hour

1569364.synopsis: The documentary gives us a unique insight into the life of a pop star who broke through at ten years old. We follow her around the world and see a side she's never shown before. This is the story of an artist reaching for the very top, but with the knowledge that no matter how much she achieves, it'll never be enough to satisfy her.
1569364.title: Zara Larsson - Up Close

1569545.synopsis: After losing his belongings on the way to work, a man tries to find his way home.
1569545.title: New York I Love You

1569765.synopsis: Documentary investigating the crash on 13th May 1935 which resulted in the death of T.E. Lawrence (Lawrence of Arabia) six days later.
1569765.title: Who Killed Lawrence of Arabia?

1569807.synopsis: A comic tragedy about an obscure but uncompromising journalist, a specialist in ancient Greek sayings, who tries to keep his apartment and lead a decent life, without giving up on his principles, without losing his integrity.
1569807.title: Receptions

1569820.synopsis: After Jeeto’s death, her sister sacrifices her dreams to hold the family together. Watch how far love and duty take her in this gripping story.
1569820.title: Ik Chithi Dard Bhari

1569947.synopsis: A family gather to spend Thanksgiving at an isolated cabin, unaware that the site has a horrific history of murder and cannibalism and that the Priest responsible did not rest in peace. Now they are on the menu for Thanksgiving dinner.
1569947.title: The Priest: Thanksgiving Massacre

1570132.synopsis: A struggling production company take on a deadly assignment.
1570132.title: Late Night Television

1570190.synopsis: A world-famous singer becomes dangerously obsessed with one of her female fans, blurring the line between admiration and control in a chilling tale of fame, fixation, and fear.
1570190.title: Fan of Mine

1570233.synopsis: After many disappointments, Olivia gives up on the idea of ever feeling the full joy of intimacy. As she loses confidence in herself and becomes ashamed of her body, a figure appears filled with glitter and wise words. This figure is Mary the fairy. Mary is on a mission to show Olivia the beauty of pleasure and the importance of sexual liberation. With hopefulness that this will unlock a level of self-assuredness that Olivia has never experienced before.
1570233.title: Mary The Fairy

1570238.synopsis: “What do you want to be when you grow up?” Simple question asked to kids with a complex view as we grow older. As a child we are obliged to look in only one direction, which leaves adults defeated when the question is not fulfilled. We sat down with people who have multiple jobs, changed jobs or don’t believe in the word "careers". Here they recall their experiences and reveal their views on the working culture.
1570238.title: What Do You Want To Be When You Grow Up?

1570242.synopsis: Evelyn and Beverly are sisters that couldn’t be more opposite from one another. Beverly, outgoing for life, left the family and married a wealthy man. While Evelyn enjoys the simple things, stayed in their hometown looking after their mother. After the death of their mother, the two sisters come together on a dark and chilling night where they discover her final wishes.
1570242.title: The Manor

1570246.synopsis: Belle’s unconditional love for Travis is put in question when Travis’ mental health grows darker. Travis is diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder which burdens their connection but not their endearment. The relationship is at a fork on the road. They have one last attempt to rekindle their relationship and decide if love is enough to stay.
1570246.title: My Head Hurts

1570282.synopsis: Bullied for wanting to be an idol, Kenji finds belonging in a cabaret and help from a trailblazing doctor, emerging onstage as her true self, Ai Haruna.
1570282.title: This Is I

1570388.synopsis: A fragmented collection of private home video footage, interwined with the moon and stars.
1570388.title: Memories of the Moon

1570394.synopsis: In 2002, a young Palestinian asylum seeker is released from Australian detention — but the footage capturing this pivotal moment vanishes, never archived. Fear of Songs is an experimental short film that attempts to reconstruct what was lost, blurring memory, media, and imagination. Through absence, it questions who gets to be seen, and what is remembered.
1570394.title: Fear of Songs

1570622.synopsis: David and Georgina’s lives are about to change when they receive some unexpected news: David has inherited Cottonwood, an old Victorian house that was once used as an orphanage. However, the family is unaware that they’ve also inherited its dark past.
1570622.title: The Haunting of Cottonwood

1570740.synopsis: A young woman with schizophrenia and addiction embraces a fresh start at college, but her stability shatters when her vital medication disappears.
1570740.title: The Sound of Balloons 2

1570924.synopsis: The story of the DC Sniper and Mildred Muhammad; her testimony reveals it was part of a calculated plan rooted in manipulation, control, and domestic abuse driven by a single, dark obsession.
1570924.title: Hunted by My Husband: The Untold Story of the DC Sniper

1571066.synopsis: Against All Odds is the gripping sequel to Try That Again, following Jason, Jocelyn, and the enigmatic bartender Lexian as they navigate the dangerous consequences of Jason’s repeated manipulations of time. Hunted by Xaldin, a relentless enforcer of the natural order, the trio must outwit their pursuer and confront the ripple effects of their past choices. Every decision carries weight, and survival may demand sacrifices they never imagined. Can they stay one step ahead of destiny itself—against all odds?
1571066.title: Against All Odds

1571400.synopsis: In a cold future, where society is controlled by technology. Ethan, has a flash of his life before and starts to question what it means to truly live.
1571400.title: Neural Command

1571470.synopsis: To pull off a daring heist, a gang of six misfit outlaws will have to do something they've never done before: trust each other — and a washed-up Witcher.
1571470.title: The Rats: A Witcher Tale

1571485.synopsis: The final creative chapter of one of music’s most iconic artists. Featuring rare interviews with those who knew and worked alongside Bowie as well as famous fans and figures who have been inspired by his artistry, the film will uncover the strategy behind Bowie’s artistic resurrection and the inexhaustible extraordinary creativity that defined his final decade, in which he released his critically acclaimed album Blackstar just two days before he died. This was an emergence from the turbulence of the 1990s, when Bowie had found himself at odds with a changing industry but pushed on to headline Glastonbury in 2000.
1571485.title: Bowie: The Final Act

1571551.synopsis: An unmarried police officer, Nishaan Kaur , was appointed by her department to stop the adulteration black market in grocery items . Powerful bhopa sah running adulteration business with political support. Nishaan kaur's parents left her when she was a kid because they didn't want to grow a child . Nishaan kaur's grandfather raised nishaan kaur and helped her to become a police officer .nishana kaur did hard work to winning national athlete . In sports reservation she became police officer. Her grandfather pushed her to get married as soon as possible, but she is involved in cases of criminals all the time.
1571551.title: Kaur Is King

1571722.synopsis: A short documentary about Jackie Forster, a groundbreaking LGBT+ rights campaigner.
1571722.title: Jackie Forster

1571782.synopsis: The film follows the life and times of gangster-turned-politician Haroon Ali Shah Baig, who rises from being a crook to one of the most powerful men in Bihar.
1571782.title: Rangbaaz: The Bihar Chapter

1571896.synopsis: A warlock risks his soul for a chance to become the concubine of the demon who lives in the eye of the hurricane.
1571896.title: Trial of the Concubine

1572007.synopsis: Four men gather for cards and cognac after the death of a close friend. What begins as a fellowship becomes raw confessions of infidelity, betrayal, guilt, and loss, forcing each man to speak their truth while strengthening their brotherhood.
1572007.title: Cards & Cognac

1572017.synopsis: A privileged young man working at his wealthy father's business traps himself in a lie when he falls in love with a hard-working medical student, and tries to convince her that he comes from more humble beginnings like hers. What follows is a comedic whirlwind of chaos and heartfelt revelations.
1572017.title: Love and Wine

1572064.synopsis: A salvage crew finds a relic box on an abandoned ship. Opening it unleashes Krampus, an ancient predator now stalking their vessel. With the creature picking them off, the crew races to decode the relic's origins before their mission-and their lives-are swallowed by the darkness they unleashed.
1572064.title: Krampus in Space

1572072.synopsis: A deep-sea research submarine becomes stranded miles below the ocean surface after a mysterious systems failure. As oxygen runs low and pressure mounts, the crew battles rising panic, hidden tensions, and an unseen force outside the hull.
1572072.title: Submarine

1572073.synopsis: Some secrets are better left at the bottom of the ocean. Once she's in your house, there is no escape. When a struggling artist pulls a beautiful, unconscious woman from the freezing coastal waters, he thinks he’s performed a miracle. But as she recovers within the walls of his secluded home, a series of unsettling events leads him to a terrifying realization: her presence is no coincidence. She is inextricably linked to the same watery grave that claimed his family years ago.
1572073.title: The Deadly Little Mermaid

1572075.synopsis: A Christmas gathering turns horrific when a family’s inherited home is discovered to be haunted by a legend known as the Green Monster.
1572075.title: The Green Monster

1572077.synopsis: A family outing spirals into a fight for survival against the Tin Man, a heart-hungry machine risen from the ruins of Oz.
1572077.title: Wizard of Death: Tinman's Rise

1572259.synopsis: Photojournalist Ese arrives in Ibeshe to find her missing sister and uncovers a journal leading to a dark mystery involving supernatural forces and a ritual killing ring.
1572259.title: Thicker Than Water

1572380.synopsis: Paul Di'Anno (Paul Andrews), Iron Maiden's first vocalist before Bruce Dickinson, passed away in October 2024. Di'Anno was expelled from the band after the release of their second album due to drug and alcohol problems. During this period, he signed a contract excluding him from song royalties after Iron Maiden had risen to fame. "Di'Anno: Iron Maiden's Lost Singer" follows Paul Di'Anno's final years.
1572380.title: Di'Anno: Iron Maiden's Lost Singer

1572470.synopsis: An investigation into how far-right leaders in Germany have risen to the brink of power. Reporter Evan Williams examines the reasons behind the surge in support for their brand of hardline nationalist politics, and the roles of Russia and the U.S.
1572470.title: The Rise of Germany’s New Right

1572548.synopsis: System Update isn’t just a film—it’s a rallying call for a better future. It shows how bold changes in political, economic, and social systems can protect people from climate collapse. Most of humanity wants action, yet leaders fail to deliver. Like a computer, society must be rebooted to avoid disaster and create a fairer, more sustainable system. Offering fresh ideas and inspiration, the film invites us to reclaim power, join forces, and shape a world that works for everyone. A wake-up call to act, resist, and rewrite our collective future.
1572548.title: System Update- Rebooting Our Future

1572644.synopsis: Twin assassins take on a night of violent contracts until betrayal turns their mission into a fight for survival, forcing sister against sister in a relentless clash of blood, loyalty, and revenge.
1572644.title: Double Kill

1572915.synopsis: The two deadliest battles of the Iraq War occurred in 2004. The Battle of Najaf was fought in the South against the Shiite Mahdi militia. The Battle of Fallujah was fought in the West against Sunni insurgents.These brutal urban conflicts were not the high-tech battles the military had prepared for after the first Gulf War in 1991, but they are the face of modern warfare. The Last 600 Meters tells the story of these battles through the words and deeds of those who fought there: the ground truth.
1572915.title: The Last 600 Meters: The Battles of Najaf and Fallujah

1573225.synopsis: Concert film of The Cure’s November 1st (2024) performance at London’s Troy.
1573225.title: The Cure: The Show of a Lost World

1573632.synopsis: A man discovers he is physically shrinking. With the help of his wife, they navigate life's ups and downs with increasing creativity and adaptability.
1573632.title: Beyond Measure

1573688.synopsis: Julio Torres takes the stage in NYC and invites the audience to see the people, places, and things around us through his kaleidoscopic lens. Blending stand-up, an interactive set, and live drawings, Julio explores the inherent traits, personalities, and emotions of particular colors.
1573688.title: Color Theories by Julio Torres. A Guide to Seeing the World

1573743.synopsis: When Lisa is working a closing shift at the All Star Drive-In, strange things start to occur and she is confronted by her vice when a supernatural entity targets her.
1573743.title: The Last Picture Show!

1573756.synopsis: In the remote mountain town of Graven Hollow, autumn is more than just a season — it’s a warning. Every thirteen years, as the harvest moon rises and the leaves turn blood-red, the town prepares for a ritual it dares not speak aloud. When a group of college friends arrives for the annual fall festival, they’re drawn into a chilling legend about the Hollow Man — a masked figure born of fire and betrayal, who returns to collect a blood debt. As the friends unravel the town’s secrets and fight to survive, they discover that tradition runs deep… and some roots are soaked in horror.
1573756.title: The Hollow Season

1573773.synopsis: With dry wit, Canadian comic Gerry Dee explores his perilous years as a schoolteacher, the pitfalls of open marriages and the truth about Santa.
1573773.title: Gerry Dee: Funny You Should Say That

1573869.synopsis: A story of generational conflict and the clash between tradition and modern life, centered on phở—an icon of Vietnamese cuisine. Beneath the disputes and disagreements, hidden truths gradually surface, unfolding a journey back to familial warmth through humor, wit, and charming moments.
1573869.title: The Scent Of Pho

1574042.synopsis: When an alien hunter arrives on Earth, it takes down a gang of warlords and unexpectedly becomes a folk hero to the oppressed locals. Now, with their support, the alien sets its sights on the warlords' ruthless leader.
1574042.title: Predator: Wastelands

1574181.synopsis: A supernatural thriller about a buried curse that resurfaces when a widow returns to her childhood home with her pregnant daughter. As sinister events escalate, the daughter uncovers a forbidden book that reveals a horrifying truth about her unborn child.
1574181.title: Inthralled

1574296.synopsis: A young couple navigates the chaotic world of pre-wedding photography, facing unexpected hurdles and family drama as they try to capture their perfect moments before tying the knot.
1574296.title: The Great Pre-Wedding Show

1574432.synopsis: On Saturday, November 8, 2025, rock royalty once again gathered to celebrate the induction of another class of performers, influencers and excellent musicians into the Hallowed Hall of Rock. The 2025 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees were Bad Company, Chubby Checker, Joe Cocker, Cyndi Lauper, Outkast, Soundgarden and The White Stripes in the Performer category.
1574432.title: 2025 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony

1574470.synopsis: True-crime hosts John and Mary meet brutal offender Amos Alexander at his isolated house, where he promises more confessions. The routine shoot spirals into a chilling face-off that unravels dark truths, forcing Mary to question justice and truth.
1574470.title: Amoz Alexander

1575207.synopsis: Dilan is an ITB student who returned from Cuba in March 1997. In the midst of the heated political situation leading up to the Reformation.
1575207.title: Dilan 1997

1575321.synopsis: A conceptual, music-driven experimental psychodrama following a frustrated painter living in isolation and haunted by visions of a spectral, vampiric muse.
1575321.title: Drakulon

1575337.synopsis: Iroha's life gets knocked off its orbit when Kaguya, a carefree runaway from the Moon, moves in and convinces her to perform in a virtual world together.
1575337.title: Cosmic Princess Kaguya!

1575414.synopsis: In a world that seems to never make sense, a young boy finds solace in books of poetry.
1575414.title: Whispers

1575438.synopsis: Two middle aged brothers and their respective sons travel to Ireland to play the Finnegan Family's annual golf outing, where they distribute the ashes of the family patriarch
1575438.title: Finnegan's Foursome

1575497.synopsis: Six college grad students and a mysterious stranger battle a pack of ferocious werewolves in a secluded cabin.
1575497.title: Frenzy Moon

1575534.synopsis: After five years in a coma following a fatal car accident, Madison Neubauer wakes to find her home and family in the grip of 'The Observance', a religious cult who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets.
1575534.title: The Observance

1575588.synopsis: From childhood innocence to the chaos of adulthood, we follow Josh-a widowed father-and his loyal band of misfit friends as they fight to save his family and home. In a last-ditch effort, Josh and his best friend Ryan enter a holiday-themed high-stakes wrestling match. As the crew rallies together, unexpected allies surface and signs from Josh's late wife Sandy appear, guiding their turbulent journey. What follows is an unpredictable mix of calamity, comedy, and camaraderie-leading to a gritty and moving conclusion.
1575588.title: Misfits

1575615.synopsis: A young trans girl and a policeman spend the night together.
1575615.title: TRY ME

1575647.synopsis: An aimless nightcrawler races to unravel the mystery of the supernatural entity hunting him.
1575647.title: It Hunts

1575690.synopsis: Senior couple Józef and Elżbieta Gugulak plan to marry after decades together. When the bride vanishes, wedding prep becomes a journey through family history, testing their love while younger relatives face romantic challenges of their own.
1575690.title: Off We Go 2

1575732.synopsis: Grandfather Halim, who lives in Germany, wants to spend his last holiday in his hometown. His grandson, Hami, disguises Maşukiye as Trabzon to take his grandfather to the difficult-to-reach city. Hami, who complies with Grandfather Halim's demands, maintains the lie and finds himself torn between Anna and Pelin. When his grandfather disappears, things get complicated, and his family rushes to the village for an explanation.
1575732.title: Son Bayram

1575782.synopsis: An intense love story brews between Deva and Bindhu. On the other side, a masked man who calls himself GOD shakes the city with his brutal serial killings.
1575782.title: I Am God

1575833.synopsis: Nuremberg: The Real Story revisits the Nuremberg Trials, where Nazi leaders were brought to justice and the foundations of modern international law were laid. Alongside the courtroom drama, it uncovers the little-known story of American psychiatrist Douglas Kelley, tasked with judging whether the defendants were fit to stand trial. His fraught encounters with Hermann Göring, Hitler’s right-hand man, became a battle of wits that exposed unsettling truths about power and psychology.
1575833.title: Nuremberg: The Real Story

1576012.synopsis: The special celebrates the 40th anniversary of the beloved sitcom and features interviews with the series creator Susan Harris, executive producer Tony Thomas, original writers, and superfans like Kelly Ripa, Sheryl Lee Ralph, and Mario Lopez. It explores the show's enduring appeal and lasting influence on pop culture.
1576012.title: The Golden Girls: 40 Years of Laughter and Friendship - A Special Edition of 20/20

1576159.synopsis: West Point Rugby's 2023 season after their National Championship win, exploring the team's distinctive culture while offering insight into both rugby and military academy life.
1576159.title: Brothers on Three

1576166.synopsis: When a young missionary uncovers his late father's long-held secret, he travels from the Philippines to Spain in search of his dad's forbidden love.
1576166.title: I Wish You Had Told Me

1576287.synopsis: Go deep behind the scenes with visionary filmmaker Guillermo del Toro and the "Frankenstein" cast and crew as they give new life to the classic tale.
1576287.title: Frankenstein: The Anatomy Lesson

1576369.synopsis: The family's journey to Sreekandapuram to settle the late Bharathan Nair's second wife and son takes a dark turn when an issue from his past resurfaces, leading to an unexpected crime. Forced into a desperate cover-up to protect their future, the family must navigate a treacherous path of secrecy and mounting pressure, determined to overcome any obstacle by any means necessary.
1576369.title: Bharathanatyam 2 Mohiniyattam

1576570.synopsis: A film about non-Jews who saved Jews during the Holocaust.
1576570.title: This Ordinary Thing

1576878.synopsis: An isolated private investigator is convinced by a friend to come out of hiding to help find her missing sister, putting him back in reach by those who want his family dead.
1576878.title: Unseen Enemy

1577326.synopsis: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.
1577326.title: Srinivasa Mangapuram

1577525.synopsis: Martina, a woman in her mid 40s finds herself in a pool of regret after selling her beloved cat to pay off her gambling debt. Living hostel to hostel and having $50 to her name, she feels defeated. This all changes after the purchase of two cigarettes and a scratchcard.
1577525.title: The Gambler

1577730.synopsis: Explore Kui Buri National Park, a Southeast Asian haven where elephants, gaurs, and vibrant wildlife thrive thanks to ingenious conservation efforts.
1577730.title: Kui Buri: Thailand's Hidden Eden

1577888.synopsis: This documentary short explores the complex psychological landscape created by Instagram's "Close Friends Story”.  The feature, originally designed for genuine intimacy and selective sharing, has evolved into a battleground of digital performance and anxiety. A tool designed for vulnerability instead forces us to "perform authenticity" for a smaller, designated audience, one that defines our in-groups and perpetuates connection, long after real-life relationships have drifted. Will the endless pursuit of digital intimacy ever teach us enough?
1577888.title: the close friends story

1577906.synopsis: a surreal, handcrafted short film inspired by HYLICS. In this world, floating creatures pulse with explosive energy, driven by a unifying harmonic scream.  The second entry in ducklorde’s COLOUR SERIES, blends his experimental animation with a dithered surrealist style. It’s accompanied by an original track by Tom Hughes, that emulates Chuck Salamone’s work on HYLICS 2.  The result is like watching consciousness dissolve through a microwaved sunbeam.
1577906.title: YELLOW

1577976.synopsis: A Deep Dive into the life of Stephen Zivkovic, the owner of the last DVD rental store in Adelaide.
1577976.title: Planet of the Tapes

1578130.synopsis: A group of friends vacation on a lake front cabin and find Aladdin's ancient lamp which grants 3 terrible wishes.
1578130.title: Aladdin

1578540.synopsis: In this introspective exploration of identity and relationships, a young filmmaker reflects on the concept of being "two-faced," revealing that we all wear multiple masks depending on the situation. He identifies three key personas: the anxious individual, the creative force, and the playful spirit, each shaping his view of the world and his interactions with others.
1578540.title: The Wonder of You

1578603.synopsis: Kuber Sharma, debt-ridden man drowning under the weight of financial burdens, sees no way out of his grim reality-until a sudden and mysterious windfall changes everything.
1578603.title: Magne Raja

1578631.synopsis: 'Tis the season! Meghan shares her favorite holiday traditions, seasonal crafts and family recipes with friends old and new in this festive special.
1578631.title: With Love, Meghan: Holiday Celebration

1578645.synopsis: On a first date, a young woman gets herself entangled with a man who is desperate to stay in her life no matter how far he has to go.
1578645.title: Doorman

1578868.synopsis: A young ghostwriter finds his quiet life at a remote estate suddenly disrupted when he encounters a woman who has suffered a terrible ordeal. As they navigate the aftermath together, their shared experience creates an unexpected bond that challenges them both in profound ways. This atmospheric character drama explores how two strangers, brought together by circumstance, discover strength and connection in the face of life's darkest moments.
1578868.title: Sheshippu

1579182.synopsis: May 1977. Undercover British army Captain Robert Nairac is abducted and killed by the IRA - his body secretly buried. Decades on, a former enemy searches for his remains.
1579182.title: The Disappearance of Captain Nairac

1579211.synopsis: The incredible story behind the phone hacking scandal that shook Rupert Murdoch’s media empire that follows the small group of determined journalists and police officers who uncovered one of the biggest cover-ups in modern British media history. Featuring exclusive access and surprising new interviews with key figures—some speaking for the first time—it traces the trail of evidence that led from a single suspicious story to a scandal that reached the highest levels of power. As the truth emerged, it brought about a reckoning for the world’s most powerful media mogul, culminating in what became known as “the most humble day” of his life.
1579211.title: The Real Hack

1579212.synopsis: After settling into their new home in the midwestern countryside, the Cooper family's night of peaceful relaxation is disrupted by the arrival of two mysterious drifters who aren't who or what they appear to be.
1579212.title: The Visitors

1579286.synopsis: One day, a young man answers the door and is greeted by an unexpected visitor.
1579286.title: Reflection

1579405.synopsis: A couple is in love. One partner's excessive spending pushes the other into debt. When the burdened partner decides to seek a divorce, the other files a police complaint through the leader of a women's association. As they begin living together, they gradually understand each other's struggles. Eventually, they reconcile and choose to continue their life together.
1579405.title: Love Oh Love

1579766.synopsis: When a solitary stranger robs the corrupt family controlling a remote Idaho town, his only guide to escape over the mountains is the family patriarch's headstrong granddaughter.
1579766.title: Idaho Fallen

1579796.synopsis: A group of US tourists on a cheap Aussie outback tour discover the scam's fake dropbear attack has led them into the lair of a real, flesh-hungry koala king and his rabid army.
1579796.title: Dropbear

1579811.synopsis: "Toymaker" lives hidden behind privilege and power: by day, he's a respected figure in the city; by night, he's a predator who commissions, tortures, and preserves his crimes on VHS tapes that his wife, Camila, edits for the black market. Carlos recruits the victims; a shadowy "director" orchestrates the sadistic fantasies without getting his hands dirty.
1579811.title: The Tape Inside

1579952.synopsis: Three young mechanics move their bike repair workshop to an isolated homestay rumoured to be haunted - only to encounter chilling, unexplained events that soon come to life and cannot be ignored.
1579952.title: Nidhiyum Bhoothavum

1580070.synopsis: A family plans to renovate a rundown farmhouse during the summer but uncovers a nest of giant snake eggs and an unusual squatter on the property... Soon the eggs hatch, releasing deadly killer snakes and the family must begin a deadly fight to survive.
1580070.title: One Big Snake

1580084.synopsis: Cast and creators reflect on the impact of "Hamilton" on it's 10th Anniversary on Broadway.
1580084.title: Hamilton: Reuniting the Revolution

1580188.synopsis: One night during a heavy rainstorm, a stranded stranger knocks on the door of Angela's country cottage, claiming his car has broken down. Angela lets him in to shelter but soon a police officer arrives, asking questions, amid conducting a manhunt for an escaped criminal. Angela puts two and two together, but is there more to it than meets the eye?
1580188.title: Death Among the Pines

1580286.synopsis: After another stint in jail, Tony finds that Rinku, his one true love and hope, has been taken by his brother Dabloo. This shocks him into reforming, but Ambika drags him back into crime, with Kamal on his trail. How Manjari gets to have the last laugh, with Tony, Ambika and Kamal at the forefront, forms the rest of the two-part gangster drama.
1580286.title: Nishaanchi 2

1580353.synopsis: Failed entrepreneur and struggling dad Sattam finds himself tangled in a madcap scheme when he decides to repay his debts — by kidnapping his own father.
1580353.title: The Fakenapping

1580534.synopsis: A former investigative journalist goes undercover at a psychedelic wellness center to find her missing sister. What she uncovers is far more unsettling than she expected.  Wet Paper Bag is a psychological drama that explores identity, control, and the quiet tension beneath carefully constructed lives.
1580534.title: Wet Paper Bag

1580561.synopsis: The story revolves around four friends embarking on an unexpected road trip in a rusty Maruti 800.
1580561.title: Jigris

1580651.synopsis: The story behind the making of the 1985 Chicago Bears' rap anthem and video that became a cultural phenomenon, redefined sports entertainment, and cemented the team's larger-than-life legacy.
1580651.title: The Shuffle

1580659.synopsis: The king of Amaragiri calls upon the detective Ramakrishna to find the cause behind the villager's sudden memory loss. His search leads Rama to a web of political schemes and historical conspiracies.
1580659.title: Vikkatakavi - The Movie

1580912.synopsis: Rose, a film-obsessed woman in a desert town, falls under the spell of Anais, a mysterious filmmaker whose vampiric nature links her to local murders. Drawn into Anais's world, Rose must decide between her ordinary life and timelessness.
1580912.title: Love Wants Us Dead

1581099.synopsis: Older, wiser — and still hilarious. Kevin Hart opens up about his midlife mishaps, from intimacy pills to the perils of unexpected injuries.
1581099.title: Kevin Hart: Acting My Age

1581361.synopsis: This fall, Teton Gravity Research proudly unveils Pressure Drop, our 30th annual ski and snowboard film.  Pressure Drop captures that fleeting space between calm and chaos — when breath slows, vision sharpens and the mountain demands everything. It’s the moment before gravity takes over.
1581361.title: Pressure Drop

1581613.synopsis: A late-night call to a train station's Lost & Found sends a woman spiralling through memory, regret, and the fragile hope of reconnection.
1581613.title: Reconnected

1581729.synopsis: From gifts gone wrong to family tradition fails, Matt Rife turns an unpredictable audience into an unscripted holiday special.
1581729.title: Matt Rife: Unwrapped - A Christmas Crowd Work Special

1581761.synopsis: On Nov 16, 2005, Australia didn't just qualify for the FIFA World Cup, it found its voice on the global stage. We hear from the players, coaches and fans who were part of that historic moment.
1581761.title: The Kick That United A Nation

1581787.synopsis: On a vast glacier, where ice cubes live trapped in a cycle, one of them begins to question its existence and decides to rebel against the monster that controls them.
1581787.title: Under the Igloo's Shadow

1582009.synopsis: After narrowly escaping death and a life sentence in prison, Becky becomes obsessed with a young couple-determined to claim a life with them, whether they want it or not.
1582009.title: Becky 2: Bloodtears

1582182.synopsis: After disability and trauma forces life to change track, the discovery of cycling reveals a powerful new ability that drives three unique athletes to chase a Paralympic dream.
1582182.title: Changing Track

1582626.synopsis: Adam Sandler invites Dave backstage on his comedy tour, then they sit down at NYU to chat about stand-up, famous roles and his beloved Stratocaster.
1582626.title: My Next Guest with David Letterman and Adam Sandler

1582770.synopsis: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.
1582770.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge

1582900.synopsis: A disturbed doctor at a state hospital murders a patient and covers it up. 13 years later, Nolan and a group of teens explore the now abandoned hospital.
1582900.title: Stonegate

1582928.synopsis: On September 26th of 2023, the Midnight Screening Productions website server was hacked, and this .mp4 file was uploaded directly to our page from an unknown server with an accompanying executable program entitled Badbadbad.exe.
1582928.title: No One Came To His Birthday Party

1582946.synopsis: A weekend getaway leaves a young couple stranded on an isolated road in the woods where they discover they’re being targeted for alien abduction.
1582946.title: Alien AI: Legacy

1583135.synopsis: Cast members from Little House on the Prairie embark on a journey to the real-world locations that inspired Laura Ingalls Wilder’s classic books. Along the way, they explore the history behind the stories and revisit the enduring spirit of Little House that continues to inspire audiences around the world.
1583135.title: Little House Homecoming

1583220.synopsis: Consumed by an internet conspiracy about a sinister, unseen entity, a journalist grows increasingly convinced the threat is real. As his investigation deepens, he loses his grip on reality and spirals into paranoia. Ignoring his roommate’s warnings, he turns to a fringe parapsychologist who feeds his obsession. He doesn’t know if he’s closing in on the ominous presence—or if it’s hunting him.
1583220.title: Molt

1583374.synopsis: An unflinching portrait of life in Gaza at the height of Israeli attacks. The filmmakers follow a British doctor of Palestinian origin who travels to volunteer in a local hospital. What emerges is an uncensored chronicle of war, the daily fight to sustain a collapsing medical system under relentless bombardment, and the immense emotional burden carried by victims and their families.
1583374.title: The Mission

1583463.synopsis: A trio of siblings return to their grandfather's farm to scatter his ashes but after staying the night they wake to find one of them missing and they are being stalked by a wendigo.
1583463.title: The Farm

1583468.synopsis: After responding to an internet ad without thoroughly reading it, a traveller stays with an old Australian couple under the guise of a working holiday.
1583468.title: Working Holiday

1583500.synopsis: Told in his own words, the definitive story of Denver Broncos quarterback John Elway goes deep on his NFL dreams, heartbreaks and Super Bowl redemption.
1583500.title: Elway

1583609.synopsis: The woman in the footage has been identified as Australian vlogger Zadie Joyce, better known by her username spac3yZadie. Joyce’s various social media accounts were last updated on March 6, 2008: her whereabouts since are unknown.
1583609.title: ~*{findingxOxmyxOxbliss}*~

1583798.synopsis: In a future where technology feels more human than ever, people confront love, loss, and identity as the boundaries between man and machine disappear.
1583798.title: Merge

1584118.synopsis: Naarm drag artists JENS RADDA and IVA ROSEBUD are Neely O’Hara and Helen Lawson, in this lavish act of diva worship committed to Super 16mm film. Adapted from the camp classic 1967 film Valley of the Dolls, itself an adaptation of the Jacqueline Susann novel of the same name from 1966.
1584118.title: I Can't Believe It's Not Valley of the Dolls!

1584125.synopsis: In 1975, as America faced social and political upheaval, filmmakers turned chaos into art.
1584125.title: Breakdown: 1975

1584174.synopsis: Short film about the changes in a girl's body.
1584174.title: Growing Up

1584215.synopsis: A CIA-trained assassin recruits other graduates from her secret childhood program, The Internship, to violently destroy the organization. The CIA fights back with deadly force.
1584215.title: The Internship

1584595.synopsis: When Katherine Choong suggested to her friend Éline Le Menestrel that they tackle the Zahir, a classic route in the Swiss Alps and a demanding gem of the Wendenstöcke, Éline agreed... on one condition: that they only use sustainable transport to get to the foot of the wall.  As the days passed suspended on the rock, they realized the scale of the challenge: intense commitment, tiny holds, accumulated fatigue from cycling... every movement became a challenge.  Between motivation and euphoria, perseverance and doubt, would Katherine and Éline manage to reach their Zahir, that summit where audacity and wild beauty come together?
1584595.title: Zahir

1584619.synopsis: Monaco, 1999. One of the world's richest men dies in his penthouse. This documentary unpacks the mysterious murder of billionaire banker, Edmond Safra.
1584619.title: Murder in Monaco

1584780.synopsis: From his Saturday Night Live beginnings to a string of classic comedies, Chevy Chase has always had huge comedic range. He is also a complex and contradictory human being. Featuring revealing interviews with those closest to him, this documentary digs into the talent, flaws, and humanity that shaped an icon.
1584780.title: I'm Chevy Chase and You're Not

1585058.synopsis: This special offers a rare glimpse into the Kapoors, Hindi cinema's first family, over an afternoon of conversation, nostalgia and homemade delicacies.
1585058.title: Dining with the Kapoors

1585089.synopsis: Rick, the pharmacist, is driven by vengeance after his sister dies from counterfeit drugs sold by Eddie. He is torn between his desire for revenge and a newfound purpose as he returns to school to become a legitimate pharmacist.
1585089.title: Trap 48

1585266.synopsis: Canadian electronics company Clairtone finds a successful niche producing high-end modernist stereo systems before succumbing to hard economic realities.
1585266.title: Clairtone

1585383.synopsis: A quintet of international lesbian short films, the latest in its popular Upon Her Lips collection. These films aim to tempt you with secret desires in the brightest of days or the darkest of nights. Two schoolgirls in Iran try covering up a misdemeanour whilst a Spanish couple’s weekend retreat means navigating family dynamics. In 19th century Germany,  a peasant clairvoyant has the villagers gossiping whilst in present-day New Zealand, a woman uses laughter to let go.  For these emboldened women, sexuality becomes the least of their worries
1585383.title: Upon Her Lips: Open Secrets

1585476.synopsis: Kevin Costner hosts this special exploring the extraordinary journey of Mary and Joseph as they navigate the hardships, trials and triumphs surrounding Jesus Christ's birth, offering an inspiring way to experience the true meaning of Christmas.
1585476.title: Kevin Costner Presents: The First Christmas

1585580.synopsis: Melbourne is the last bastion of "The Progressives," a society shielded from the outside world by a glowing rainbow "virtue signal." When the shield begins to fail, an Aboriginal elder named Murray reveals the truth: the culture war was lost long ago, and only the legendary Victimhood can save them. Tasked with retrieving it is Pete, a downtrodden white man treated as the lowest rung of society. Joined by Murray, the vain Princess Stacey, and Social Justice Warrior Lance, Pete ventures into the "real" Australia for the first time, discovering it's nothing like he was told — while Prime Minister Pauline Hanson races to reach the weapon first.
1585580.title: A Super Progressive Movie
