1585709.synopsis: The Boulet Brothers and David Dastmalchian present a chilling holiday-themed anthology horror special featuring four original shorts, each written and directed by a different genre powerhouse: The Boulet Brothers, Dastmalchian, Akeela Cooper, and Kate Siegel.
1585709.title: The Boulet Brothers' Holiday of Horrors

1585728.synopsis: The true story of Joel and Luke Smallbone’s rise from Australia to worldwide acclaim. Through setbacks, struggles, and faith, the brothers reveal how purpose, family, and grace shaped their journey from mowing lawns to selling out arenas, uncovering the heart behind the band like never before.
1585728.title: for KING + COUNTRY: NO TURNING BACK

1585745.synopsis: A behind-the-scenes journey into the creation and lasting legacy of Wishbone, the Emmy-winning PBS series that introduced a generation to classic literature through the adventures of a small dog with a big imagination.
1585745.title: What's the Story, Wishbone?

1585924.synopsis: Dear ocean; I love you' , is a coming of age story set in the 90s, it follows a woman as she reflects on her life and comes to terms with the romantic feelings she had for her best friend.
1585924.title: Dear Ocean, I Love You

1585953.synopsis: The Beast of Trinity Texas is a murder mystery film set in a small East Texas town where a former homicide detective turned sheriff must confront a possible mythical beast
1585953.title: The Beast of Trinity Texas

1585979.synopsis: When Charlie attempts to connect with their estranged Father, will their unexpected queer kinship be enough to mend their paternal relationship?
1585979.title: Lin's Laundromat

1586505.synopsis: Directed by Lih-Kuei Chen, this film honours Professor Chiou’s legacy and traces his journey from early disillusionment under martial law in Taiwan, to formative years in the United States, and decades of community-based activism in Australia. Through interviews, archival footage, and his own writings, the film explores Cold War exile, the making of diasporic identity, and the small but powerful role of critical thought in shaping transnational Taiwanese democracy. More than a portrait of a single intellectual, the documentary reflects on broader dynamics of cultural resistance, diaspora diplomacy, and the political life of ideas beyond the Taiwan/China binary.
1586505.title: Life's Good

1586757.synopsis: After claiming he served 20 years in a secret space program, Corey Goode became a UFO icon - then a lightning rod. This documentary follows his rise and the strange intersection of memory, myth, and media in the age of disclosure.
1586757.title: Beyond Disclosure - The Corey Goode Files

1586794.synopsis: A remote town is plagued by a dark and twisted figure cloaked in tradition, turning cheer into terror. This psychological horror blends folklore, fear, and survival in a chilling new tale.
1586794.title: Santa-N the Red Awakening

1586820.synopsis: Elmo and his Sesame Street friends work with former NASA engineer turned YouTube star Mark Rober to make special presents for a Merry Giftmas exchange.
1586820.title: Elmo and Mark Rober's Merry Giftmas

1586962.synopsis: After her husband’s death, Sara seeks peace in a forest town, but rumors of a rabbit-man with deadly carrots soon turn her refuge into terror.
1586962.title: Bad Bunny

1587180.synopsis: An exploration of the historical event and the culture of conspiracy surrounding the assassination of former President John F. Kennedy.
1587180.title: Truth and Lies: Who Killed JFK?

1587195.synopsis: A little girl with cerebral palsy is relentlessly bullied throughout her life, yet finds it in her heart to forgive by seeking strength from a higher source above.
1587195.title: Forgiveness Girl

1587448.synopsis: As the world races for critical minerals, a new trade route is transforming Central Africa. Lobito-Bound: A journey to Africa’s new frontier follows explorer Dwayne Fields - in partnership with pan-African mobile provider Africell - from the Indian Ocean to the Atlantic along the Lobito Corridor, tracing the impact of global power struggles on local lives. Through voices on the ground, the film explores whether the Lobito Corridor will bring real progress or simply shift the balance of control.
1587448.title: Lobito Bound: A Journey to Africa's New Frontier

1587524.synopsis: A horror film directed by Brandon Scotland about a real estate entrepreneur who becomes entangled in a web of lies and murder after meeting a mysterious woman just before Christmas.
1587524.title: Dead Before Christmas

1587686.synopsis: Imprinted is a journey into the world of choreographer JoAnna Mendl Shaw, whose work with dancers and horses reveals a choreographic language that redefines how we connect to animals, to one another, and to ourselves.
1587686.title: Imprinted

1587964.synopsis: Reformed ex-convict Walt Manigan returns home to rebuild his family with the love of his life, Ketta. His path leads him to a boxing gym inside a D.C. youth recreation center about to be closed. There, he works under the wise coach Slim to mentor a group of boys to train for the junior national boxing tournament, all leading to a showdown between best friends Quincey and Peanut as they battle for a spot on the U.S. Junior Olympic Team.
1587964.title: They Fight

1588020.synopsis: Casey, an antisocial individual, uses their ability to physically manifest their dreams to contact their late mother one last time. Voyaging through unfamiliar lands, Casey must confront their internalised fears and forgotten commitments before they can reach their last chance to say goodbye. Their only problem: Casey must decide between going back home and taking responsibility for their younger sibling, or missing out on their final moment of closure.
1588020.title: Roots

1588256.synopsis: When a fame hungry couple moves into an ideal LA home, their new dream life spirals into a nightmare as a supernatural scarecrow begins stalking them - feeding on their lies, testing their truth, and turning their fandom into witnesses of its judgment.
1588256.title: Strawstalker

1588427.synopsis: A budding friendship between two seemingly normal young men takes a dark turn after lies and sinister motives are uncovered.
1588427.title: Sutures

1588609.synopsis: Burned-out exec Olivia and reclusive writer Theo meet when their dogs' leashes tangle, sparking a charming, unexpected romance-for both pairs.
1588609.title: Husky Christmas

1588671.synopsis: Dive into a real-time investigation of the shocking daylight robbery at Paris' Louvre Museum. Former thieves, security staff, eyewitnesses and investigators piece together the crime and ongoing chase to recover France's crown jewels before it's too late.
1588671.title: Louvre Heist: Minute by Minute

1588727.synopsis: In an attempt to discover the truth about the mysterious death of his son, Journalist Vince Sand descends into a dangerous netherworld of drug-abuse and murder that forces him to confront his own demons.
1588727.title: High Water

1588838.synopsis: A group of friends bonded by their love for extreme sports discovers BASE jumping in wingsuits — but feeling like flying carries the highest risks.
1588838.title: To the Max

1588965.synopsis: Parenting fails. Blackout bar stories. Career regrets. Tom Segura explores the darkly funny side of life's most unpredictable lessons.
1588965.title: Tom Segura: Teacher

1589007.synopsis: A reclusive father and his daughter find themselves in the crosshairs of a battle between dragons and the Military.
1589007.title: Fire Breather

1589083.synopsis: A girlfriend breaks up with her boyfriend, only for a vampire to try to seduce her and kill her boyfriend.
1589083.title: Granted

1589128.synopsis: Elle and Mare are opposites-steady vs. impulsive, cautious vs. romantic. Yet after their father's death, their clashing ways help balance each other through sorrow and love, showing that sisterhood is the strongest when differences unite.
1589128.title: Sense & Sensibility: A Modern Retelling

1589248.synopsis: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.
1589248.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me

1589398.synopsis: The boundless joy and unabashed passion of master gelato-maker Sergio Dondoli take center stage in this exuberant tribute to the delights of food, creativity, and a life well-lived. 'Sergio Dondoli's Happy Life' chronicles the rise of Dondoli and his world-famed Tuscan gelateria. What emerges is a portrait of a man who started from the humblest beginnings yet found a way to cultivate sweetness in all its forms through his life's work.
1589398.title: Sergio Dondoli's Happy Life

1589401.synopsis: George, a heroin-addicted chess hustler who sleeps in the park outside of the Section 8 housing where 12-year-old Vivienne lives, helps her prepare for a screen test through street schemes as twisted rehearsals, forging a unique bond built on chaos.
1589401.title: Gifts of Disposition

1589891.synopsis: A psychoanalyst on community service aids an agent shattered by infidelity; together, they will confront danger and discover second chances.
1589891.title: A Time for Bravery

1589905.synopsis: Breakout star Robby Hoffman hilariously pushes the limits of comedy with red-hot, controversial takes in her debut special.
1589905.title: Robby Hoffman: Wake Up

1589949.synopsis: Layla's search for acceptance leads to dangerous choices that have a ripple effect on her family.
1589949.title: Grape

1590012.synopsis: In Nashville, a spirited songwriter and a widowed consultant clash over the fate of a music publishing office. As Christmas nears, rivalry turns to romance in this conflict-filled holiday tale where saving dreams means risking hearts.
1590012.title: Music City Mistletoe

1590041.synopsis: Roni Gingrich is a PTSD survivor and aspiring artist whose buried childhood trauma manifests in the form of sleep paralysis and recurring dreams as she unravels the truth of her past.
1590041.title: Finding Joy

1590097.synopsis: In a future shaped by war, AI, and fractured timelines, five sci-fi stories explore humanity’s fight for connection, survival, and meaning across time and space.
1590097.title: Afterlight

1590553.synopsis: When a monkey samurai kills a crab samurai, the crab’s child takes revenge with the help of friends.  Based on an Edo period folktale.
1590553.title: The Battle of Monkey and Crab

1590560.synopsis: Momotaro was an Edo-era folk hero repurposed in the 1930s to align with Japan’s more nationalist viewpoint.  Here, Momotaro seeks revenge on an eagle that disturbed a group of peaceful penguins.
1590560.title: Momotaro Wild Eagle Conquest

1590597.synopsis: Selfish businessman Jason Mudrick is awakened on Christmas Eve by spirits who reveal to him his own miserable existence, what opportunities he wasted in his youth, his current cruelties, and the dire fate that awaits him if he does not change his ways. Mudrick is faced with his own story of growing bitterness and meanness, and must decide what his own future will hold: death or redemption.
1590597.title: A Christmas Carol

1590775.synopsis: After the pandemic, high school is on holiday, and Can's classmates throw a big party at his house. Can has prepared a special video for his ex-girlfriend, Nursena. However, OD Züm and Nora take advantage of Can's drunkenness to obtain a secret recording and alter it. Can Can and his friends prevent the wrong video from reaching Nursena?
1590775.title: Yanlış Paket

1590863.synopsis: A young man left with nothing but a derelict house plant finds himself struggling in the arduous task of navigation following the collapse of his relationship.
1590863.title: House Plant

1590870.synopsis: After the end of an intense relationship, Aurora returns to the places that marked its beginning and end. While reliving good and painful memories, she confronts what she lost of herself in trying to hold onto the love. In writing a final letter, Aurora attempts to transform the end into a learning experience—and understand that letting go is also part of moving on.
1590870.title: The Night We Met

1591003.synopsis: A century ago, millions flocked to Wembley Park in London to witness the British Empire Exhibition, where objects and people from the colonies were displayed as spectacle. Though its pavilions have long vanished, fragments remain buried in the city’s soil and in the lives of its communities. ‘The Park (Dancing on the Rubble of Empire)’ meditates on these hidden inheritances, asking what it means to celebrate, play, and belong amid the rubble of empire.
1591003.title: The Park (Dancing on the Rubble of Empire)

1591193.synopsis: Lawyer Tuğçe is unexpectedly left by her boyfriend Furkan. Struggling at work, she agrees to help her troubled client Erdem in exchange for rekindling her relationship with Furkan. Plans go awry, but as Tuğçe and Erdem get to know each other, she discovers true love in Erdem's arms.
1591193.title: Meant For You

1591256.synopsis: When a laid-off TV host and her cameraman launch a live stream holiday baking challenge, they whip up viral success, community spirit, and an unexpected romance
1591256.title: The Christmas Mixer

1591257.synopsis: Captured live from Milan, Damiano Michieletto world premiere production of Francesco Filidei's new opera, based on Umberto Eco's medievel thriller.
1591257.title: La Scala: The Name Of The Rose

1591516.synopsis: Unravel the case of Utah therapist Jodi Hildebrandt, whose child abuse arrest with parenting YouTuber Ruby Franke exposed a twisted tale of manipulation.
1591516.title: Evil Influencer: The Jodi Hildebrandt Story

1591582.synopsis: Best friends Gwen and Moira join a food and wine tour in Chile, ending up at a remote resort run by a mysterious couple. As guests vanish, they uncover a cannibal cult. The two must fight to survive, rescue each other, and escape becoming the next meal.
1591582.title: Best Served Cold

15916.synopsis: In the ruins of a strange city, a young girl takes care of a large egg she holds carefully in her arms. She bonds with a boy who is searching for a bird he saw in a dream.
15916.title: Angel's Egg

1591654.synopsis: When two low-level criminals scam a vicious London mob and are in over their heads, they flee to rural Greece to avoid the bloody repercussions. But escape isn't that simple.
1591654.title: A Gangster's Life

1591675.synopsis: Fourth-grader Fujino is admired for the comics she makes for her school newspaper. Her world is upended when asked to share the space with her reclusive classmate Kyomoto, whose stunning artwork is better than anything she can make. When the girls finally meet, Fujino discovers Kyomoto has been idolizing her from afar all along. Her one-sided rivalry abates, and the two are pulled into an all-consuming love of drawing that carries them into adulthood as aspiring manga artists. The adult Fujino and Kyomoto embark on a shared journey where the joys of artistic expression collide with the unpredictability of life.
1591675.title: Look Back

1591822.synopsis: Decades after humanity's first contact with Pandora, a new expedition returns to harvest what's left of the planet's resources-only to discover that the alien species is preparing to strike back against Earth.
1591822.title: Pandora: Fire and Ice

1591972.synopsis: In an abandoned amusement park, a shoestring budget horror film is rolling. The crew features a "washed‐up yet unwavering" director, a leading couple whose onscreen romance has bled into real life, and a hot‐tempered makeup artist. The true nightmare begins when the director performs a "Blood Moon Ritual" meant to force genuine terror from his actors, no acting, only real fear and real tears.
1591972.title: Blood Moon Rite 8

1592105.synopsis: Three friends, Naika, Zhenya, and Alisa, embark on a traditional spa weekend to escape their routine and family roles, but especially their mothers-in-law. Their plans are ruined when Naika's future mother-in-law, Margarita Pavlovna, unexpectedly joins them, and the three friends' escape from reality and everyday life turns into a true test of their friendship. It turns out they all view life differently.
1592105.title: Между нами, девочками

1592358.synopsis: A behind-the-scenes documentary uncovering the real history of Birmingham’s Peaky Blinders, separating fact from fiction in the hit TV series and exploring the creative vision behind its unique style.
1592358.title: Peaky Blinders: The Real Story

1592572.synopsis: An aspiring Cult Leader struggles to recruit followers for his cosmic religion, but finds some success when he manages to lure a few drifters in.
1592572.title: Cult Leader

1592587.synopsis: When high school senior and math prodigy, Ethan Young is enrolled in public school for the first time, his privileged, upper-class life becomes a secret he must hide if he wants to fit in and successfully lead his new school's underdog economics team to victory. And after being relegated to public school for disobeying his father (Wayne), Ethan is forced to choose between two competing priorities of becoming a successor to his father's business legacy or forging his own path and helping his newfound friends.
1592587.title: Rich Kid

1592609.synopsis: S. writes to Juan, who is deeply asleep. She reflects on images and cinema, and a piece of advice from a director she admires challenges her and all her previous work. Determined to find an idea behind the images she has recorded so far, S. wanders among materials, her own archive of images and sounds, internet browser tabs, western films and Japanese short stories. S. compiles all these thoughts and findings into a letter, hoping to deliver it to Juan when he wakes up.
1592609.title: Frequently asked questions

1592679.synopsis: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.
1592679.title: Oh Sukumari

1592766.synopsis: An edge-of-your-seat adventure into one man’s fight to reclaim his life by taking on the world’s most dangerous marathon swims, the Oceans Seven. Featuring unforgettable characters, raw vulnerability and breathtaking ocean feats, it’s  a gripping, uplifting journey of resilience, reinvention and what it really takes to survive.
1592766.title: Don't Be Prey

1592774.synopsis: Pellegrini's Espresso Bar is a testament to the enduring power of community, tradition, and love. This documentary explores the cafe's rich history, its cultural impact, and the profound legacy of its beloved figure, Sisto Malaspina.
1592774.title: Pellegrinis: A Melbourne Legacy

1593089.synopsis: Arasayyana Prema Prasanga is a Kannada comedy-drama about Arasayya, a simple man whose search for love and family harmony sparks hilarious misunderstandings, heartfelt moments, and a warm celebration of promises and relationships.
1593089.title: Arasayyana Prema Prasanga

1593419.synopsis: From the immersive opening shot to the emotional final line, go behind the scenes with director Noah Baumbach, George Clooney, Adam Sandler and more.
1593419.title: The Making of Jay Kelly

1593773.synopsis: Explore the captivating evolution of firearms in this documentary, with a primary focus on the United States. Journey through history from the early pistols of yesteryears to the iconic guns wielded in the Wild West era, culminating in a riveting exploration of modern-day firearms. Witness the technological advancements, cultural influences, and societal impacts that have shaped the fascinating story of guns in America.
1593773.title: History of the Gun

1593825.synopsis: Edo-period samurai Araki Mataemon and his brother-in-law Watanabe Kazuma seek revenge on Kawai Matagoro. Paper film produced using celuloid from Araki Mataemon: Master Swordsman (Kumahiko Nishina, Japan, 1935)
1593825.title: Araki Mataemon, parts 1 and 2

1593887.synopsis: A rabbit seeks revenge on an evil tanuki (raccoon dog).  Based on a popular folktale story.
1593887.title: Kachikachi Yama, part 1

1593889.synopsis: A rabbit seeks revenge on an evil tanuki (raccoon dog).  Based on a popular folktale story. Sequel reel.
1593889.title: Kachikachi Yama, part 2

1593896.synopsis: An amateur handmade film found on the backside of another paper film that includes theatrical signage, admission prices and a recreation of a chase scene from the 1955 film noir Cell 2455 Death Row.
1593896.title: Cell 2455 Death Row

1593901.synopsis: While on an evening walk, Ohei is ambushed by legendary bandits from Japanese history and mythology, such as the legendary Monk Sohei and a three-eyed oni.
1593901.title: The Unbeatable Ohei’s Bandit Extermination

1593909.synopsis: The Unbeatable Ohei helps a kappa whose head dish (“sara”) was stolen.  Ohei defeats several bandits while the kappa reclaims its stolen dish.
1593909.title: The Unbeatable Ohei's Kappa Dance

1593932.synopsis: While learning of her parent's divorce, a young teenager meets a stranger in the woods who claims to be responsible for her soul.
1593932.title: The Veil

1593954.synopsis: After New Zealand goes into lockdown, eight-year-old Meiling stays with her grandfather Richard, and together they turn a simple bear hunt game into heartwarming Teddy Shows that rekindle joy and connection within their isolated community.
1593954.title: Teddy Show: A Lockdown Story

1593980.synopsis: Robin Roberts sits down with former first lady Michelle Obama for a candid and intimate conversation about the evolution of her style and the power of fashion.
1593980.title: Michelle Obama: The Style, The Power, The Look – A Conversation with Robin Roberts

1594244.synopsis: Caught between the perilous demands of love and the dangerous lure of easy money, a U.S. probation officer and her ex-convict lover navigate a web of secrets, betrayal, and high-stakes deception that threatens to destroy them both.
1594244.title: A Sticky Situation

1594318.synopsis: An intimate, illuminating and emotionally powerful exploration of Nick Cave’s creative process and enduring influence, told through the eyes of his closest collaborators, friends and the visionaries he’s inspired.
1594318.title: Nick Cave's Veiled World

1594356.synopsis: When a rowdy biker gang storms into town determined to ruin Christmas, Hank must dig deep — and with help from his old friend Elvis — find the courage to defend the town, reconcile his past, and rediscover his purpose. It’s a heartfelt story of faith, friendship, and redemption, wrapped in holiday cheer.
1594356.title: Hank’s Christmas Wish 3: Elvis Lives

1594478.synopsis: Six estranged friends reunite over Christmas, only to accidentally awaken Black Krampus-a darker, older incarnation of the yuletide demon long erased from African folklore. As the creature stalks them one by one, punishing past sins with brutal precision, the group must unravel the legend's buried truth before their names are etched onto his eternal naughty list.
1594478.title: Black Krampus

1594509.synopsis: He returns to Nigeria with a wealthy woman he's secretly using for money. But back home, he has a wife and family hidden in plain sight. To keep the lies going, he introduces his wife as his sister, and the whole family plays along.
1594509.title: Seized the moment

1594591.synopsis: A haunted cemetery draws attention away from the real supernatural force lurking in a nearby hostel, where three students become entangled with an unexplained energy.
1594591.title: Kanimangalam Kovilakam

1594647.synopsis: For decades, UFOs have intrigued the world, but many scientists avoided studying them. In the United States, after highly publicised sightings of unidentified objects by US Navy pilots, UFOs are moving out of the shadows and into the light as NASA pledges to study them scientifically.  So what does science have to say? Though some are identified as balloons, drones, weather phenomena or optical illusions, others remain mysterious. Could they be the result of secret new technology? And what would it take for alien engineers to traverse vast distances to send probes or visit Earth from other solar systems? Explore the evidence as astrophysicists and engineers use new technologies to investigate the strangest objects in our skies.
1594647.title: What are UFOs?

1594885.synopsis: Jesus, history's most influential figure, transformed the world through his teachings. Explore his life from scholars who've dedicated their careers to studying him.
1594885.title: Jesus

1594914.synopsis: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.
1594914.title: Lucky Strike

1595111.synopsis: After their grandmother's death, Lucy and Miles return to their family's swamp island, only to face buried secrets, eerie visions, and their volatile cousin Chet. As myths come alive, the trio is pulled into a nightmare of shape-shifting terror and reckoning.
1595111.title: Skinwalker Island

1595128.synopsis: After being invited to a party by a mysterious and alluring woman, six men awake to find themselves part of a cult family's gruesome annual tradition to find the perfect suitor.
1595128.title: Lure

1595157.synopsis: A seemingly righteous exorcist is called to save a teenage girl from a violent demonic possession. As he conducts a dramatic and intense ritual, strange and unpredictable forces come into play.
1595157.title: The Eggsorcist

1595215.synopsis: An investigation into laboratory research on animals exposes a hidden world in which it’s not just the animals getting hurt. The story of Dr. Lisa Jones Engel, a primatologist turned animal welfare advocate, asks whether harming animals and ourselves in science’s name is justified
1595215.title: Sentient

1595325.synopsis: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.
1595325.title: The Anacondas

1595368.synopsis: Sequel to Popeye's Revenge (2025). A military experiment goes catastrophically wrong when a test subject escapes after receiving an experimental enhancement serum. Now supercharged with deadly abilities, he descends upon an unsuspecting summer camp with violent intent.
1595368.title: Popeye II: Returns

1595481.synopsis: Elizabeth Smart's harrowing abduction at 14 from her family's Utah home unfolds through her own words and never-before-seen material in this documentary.
1595481.title: Kidnapped: Elizabeth Smart

1595507.synopsis: A police officer's pursuit of truth in a shocking prison crime intertwines with the lives of a widowed prison guard and a soon to be released inmate, unravelling a web of morality and redemption.
1595507.title: Vadh 2

1595787.director: Luis Fernando Frías de la Parra
1595787.synopsis: This uninterrupted concert film captures Depeche Mode's iconic performances across three nights in September 2023 at the legendary Foro Sol Stadium during the Memento Mori World Tour.
1595787.title: Depeche Mode - Memento Mori: Mexico City

1595788.synopsis: "Some lakes are for swimming...This lake is the resting place for hundreds of innocent young women's souls." Welcome to Lake Rockaway a small, isolated, country town that has kept many secrets for decades.
1595788.title: Lake Rockaway

1595840.synopsis: It’s been a month since Terrance’s best friend Andre died. In the hope of offering the final apology he never had the chance to make, he enlists a witch to help conjure Andre’s ghost in a blood ritual. He will return in physical form, but there’s a catch: he will only get to stay for one night until daylight.  When Andre manifests, he is in no mood to stick around to hear what Terrance has to say. Instead, he flees to his favourite club, with his grieving, guilt-ridden friend in hot pursuit, desperate to find him before sunrise. Unsuccessful in his search, Terrance returns home to discover Andre waiting for him, ready to talk.
1595840.title: My Best Friend, Andre

1595852.synopsis: Hasley, a girl with a list of unfulfilled dreams, and Luke, a complex and vulnerable boy marked by a tragic past, find refuge on the boulevard where they discover if love can conquer all.
1595852.title: Boulevard

1595875.synopsis: Widowed farmer Malcolm Gardner lives a quiet life near a secluded forest. When a mysterious ten-year-old girl emerges from the trees, he uncovers a hidden world lurking just beyond his view.
1595875.title: The Girl in the Woods

1595909.synopsis: How far will you go for revenge? A cop torn between duty and his own demons is pushed to the edge in a gripping story of love, deception, and betrayal. When the weight of the badge becomes too much, one snap changes everything.
1595909.title: Shattered

1596008.synopsis: Follows a struggling family whose lives change when a receipt printer starts generating money after a lightning strike, leading to public chaos when society discovers the money-making machine.
1596008.title: Con City

1596021.synopsis: A woman struggles to navigate her present life while haunted by the mental and physical trauma of her childhood. Having endured years of abuse, she unknowingly carries the scars of the past, which damage her present relationship.
1596021.title: Damaged

1596243.synopsis: On his first day as a hitman, Keith is confronted with the reality of his job - killing for the greater good.
1596243.title: Keith's First Day

1596286.synopsis: After #MeToo broke the cultural silence on gender violence, international human rights lawyer Jennifer Robinson fights against the weaponization of defamation laws to silence survivors.
1596286.title: Silenced

1596291.synopsis: A Hungarian girl dreams of conquering international men’s chess. After a 15-year battle against world champion Garry Kasparov and her domineering father, Judit Polgár revolutionizes the sport’s patriarchal culture to become one of the greatest chess prodigies in history and the greatest woman chess player of all time.
1596291.title: Queen of Chess

1596315.synopsis: The untold origins of artificial intelligence lie not in machines but in power, revealing the fantasies behind the hype that got us here and where we go next.
1596315.title: Ghost in the Machine

1596335.synopsis: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity, and explores the most powerful technology humanity has ever created... and what's at stake if we get it wrong.
1596335.title: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist

1596349.synopsis: A global fascination with strength, human performance and physique transformation has created massive commerce, impacting regional economies throughout the world. At the top of this movement is the most prestigious fitness experience in the world - "The Olympia." Dream Big: The Olympia Movie celebrates 60 years of history, passion, and cultural impact behind bodybuilding's ultimate stage.
1596349.title: Dream Big: The Olympia Movie

1596551.synopsis: After having freshly completed a masterpiece, two musicians must find a way to make their dreams of success a reality.
1596551.title: The Don

1596971.synopsis: Join Lenny the Lion & Lucy the Lamb as they attempt to protect the first snowflake of Christmas and deliver it to the Christmas King! But since he lives at the top of Christmas Mountain they’ve got their work cut out for them. Their journey has many obstacles including penguin weddings, candy cane forests, and even a Christmas kraken! It’s a miraculous holiday adventure for the entire family!
1596971.title: The Christmas King!

1597017.synopsis: A reclusive ex-cartel enforcer is drawn back into bloodshed when he saves a singer from murder, leading to a confrontation with a vengeful crime lord seeking revenge against him.
1597017.title: Annihilator Unleashed

1597306.synopsis: #NTK25 –Live in Concert was recorded during Anastacia's acclaimed NOT THAT KIND tour in 2025 – pure power, soul and voice.
1597306.title: Anastacia - #NTK25 Live in Concert

1597596.synopsis: Since February 2022, hundreds of thousands of Russians have passed through the front lines. They return home changed—shaped by experiences beyond imagination. They’ve seen shells tear their friends apart, dogs eat corpses. They’ve slept on dead bodies. And they’ve pulled the trigger themselves. How has this changed them? What do they think about the war? Can they find their place in peaceful life? We came to these men with questions that trouble us as well. Eighteen men speak about the terrifying events they took part in. About the choices they made. And how they now judge those choices. Their shared story as men is one of the greatest tragedies to have befallen our country in recent decades.
1597596.title: The Returnees

1597646.synopsis: An inside look at "Avatar: Fire and Ash," featuring interviews with James Cameron and the cast and creative minds behind the "Avatar" phenomenon.
1597646.title: Avatar: A New Era - Special Edition of 20/20

1597670.synopsis: Students and teachers from a Marathi school come together to save their school from demolition, as an international school is set to be built in its place. Personal challenges merge with institutional struggles as they seek preservation of Marathi-medium schools and their local culture, while also acknowledging the need for change.
1597670.title: Krantijyoti Vidyalay Marathi Madhyam

1597671.synopsis: 'Alofa’ meaning ‘To Love’ in Samoan, explores the the trials and tribulations of Samoan ex pastor Andre Afamasaga, who fought to reconcile his faith, culture and sexual identity.
1597671.title: Alofa

1597863.synopsis: "Universe Designed" is a documentary that explores some of the evidences for God's existence with interviews from some of the world's top Christian apologists.
1597863.title: Universe Designed

1598017.synopsis: 8 Kids. 100 Hours. Zero Life Skills.  An odd lot of scew up teens get community service for various different misdemeanors.  Through hard work and good leadership from Delores (a social worker), they learn to be better friends and better people.
1598017.title: The Community Service Club

1598022.synopsis: From Sabbath to solo, addiction to redemption, the chaotic rise and fall of rock's Prince of Darkness.
1598022.title: Ozzy Osbourne: The Final Encore

1598256.synopsis: In GASLIT, award-winning actor and activist Jane Fonda embarks on a road trip through Texas oil fields and Gulf Coast communities, meeting the people who are fighting back against the oil and gas extraction boom. This boom, which has led to the United States becoming the world’s biggest liquified natural gas (LNG) exporter, is also fueling a massive expansion of plastics production, as fossil fuel companies double down on petrochemicals to secure their future. These are the stories of the shrimpers, cattle ranchers, former oil workers, families, members of faith communities, community organizers, self-described “reluctant activists”, and people across political and cultural spectrums who have come together in defense of the communities and coastlines they love. Join Fonda as she travels across Texas and Louisiana bearing witness to the decades-long struggle between fossil fuel profiteering and the lives of everyday people.
1598256.title: Gaslit

1598509.synopsis: When Sarah Millican was a bairn, she wouldn't say boo to a goose. Quiet at school, not many friends, no boobs 'til she was 16. Now? NOW she is loud, with good friends, a cracking rack and goose booing all over the shop. In Sarah's seventh stand-up special, she explores how one became the other. Plus, lots of stuff about dinners and lady gardens.
1598509.title: Sarah Millican: Late Bloomer

1598785.synopsis: Six delinquents are tasked with cleaning a train as part of a community service program. But when the train suddenly takes off, chaos ensues.
1598785.title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express - the Movie

1598947.synopsis: Percepter, a super soldier from a dystopian future, goes back in time to stop the last superhero, Phantom, from dying. But the bitter Phantom he finds is far from what he imagined, and the two unlikely heroes embark on a quest to save the world.
1598947.title: Phantom and Percepter

1599015.synopsis: The one-hour special tells the story of the life of the beloved director, producer and actor and his wife, a photographer, producer and writer known for her work in documentary and political activism. The special provides a detailed look at the investigation into the killings and the impact Reiner had on television and film history, from his starring roles in "All in the Family" to directing hits such as "This Is Spinal Tap," "A Few Good Men" and "When Harry Met Sally."
1599015.title: The Rob Reiner Story: A Hollywood Tragedy

1599078.synopsis: Filmed in Miami, Hernández's special features his comedic take on his first-generation American upbringing before a local audience.
1599078.title: Marcello Hernández: American Boy

1599084.synopsis: At a place where nothing stays for long, an inconspicuous desk clerk turns lost items into meaningful moments. A poetical animation about pausing and connecting in a helter-skelter world.
1599084.title: Lost and Found

1599087.synopsis: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.
1599087.title: Mike Epps: Delusional

1599090.synopsis: No ropes. No fear. Free solo legend Alex Honnold risks it all in a high-stakes, live ascent of one of the world's tallest skyscrapers in Taipei, Taiwan.
1599090.title: Skyscraper Live

1599301.synopsis: A Fighting Legacy explores how a 700-year-old Thai fighting art took root in the American Midwest, following the pioneer who brought it to the United States and the community built around the largest combat event in the Western Hemisphere.
1599301.title: A Fighting Legacy

1599346.synopsis: A suit creates total chaos, gifted, rejected, regifted and passed from home to home, only to return right where it started! Full-on comedy & drama.
1599346.title: Tenu Suit Suit Karda

1599472.synopsis: A couple engaged in a bizarre legal proceeding confront the source of their problem.
1599472.title: The Suit

1599649.synopsis: Years after losing his daughter, Phillips, a former Brazilian soldier, is called on a mission to rescue Amanda, a 17-year-old girl. On this journey, Phillips slowly forms a father-and-daughter relationship with Amanda.
1599649.title: Hell's Haven

1599721.synopsis: On his last night as DPO, CSP Wale Savage faces a deadly siege by gang leader Shina, seeking revenge for his brother's death. With downed officers, dwindling ammunition, and escalating chaos, Wale must choose between upholding the law or joining the prisoners to survive.
1599721.title: Project Assault

1600088.synopsis: Reemai is the story of a young woman who refuses a childhood marriage arranged under traditional Gurung customs, and must face the consequences of her decision. The film beautifully captures the essence of Gurung culture, exploring themes of love, tradition, and personal freedom
1600088.title: Reemai

1600097.synopsis: Movie follows the story of Balaram, an orphaned Brahmin boy raised by a poor Rai couple in a society that never accepts him as their own. Struggling with identity, poverty, and prejudice, Balaram is pushed into crime but rises against injustice to prove that true family is built on love, not blood. As he fights for dignity and belonging, he transforms not just his fate, but the hearts of those around him.
1600097.title: Baristha Balaram

1600172.synopsis: From a high school art class to a local radio station, the day-to-day lives of several women coalesce into a poetic documentation of women’s presence and physicality across everyday spaces.
1600172.title: Girls and Boxes

1600174.synopsis: A young couple's hopes of buying their dream home are put to the test when they learn the house they're inspecting is haunted. Well, not the whole house. It's just this one room - a very bad room.
1600174.title: The Bad Room

1600338.synopsis: RR has always been in love with his best friend, Janine. But she's infatuated with Kenzo, the star of her own fan fiction. When he finds a way for Janine to meet Kenzo, will he risk his own happiness just for her to have her own happiness?
1600338.title: Almost Us

1600421.synopsis: Featuring the global K-Pop sensation Stray Kids and a live performance from their record-breaking world tour, alongside exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and intimate interviews with the band, Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience is an epic concert film that gives fans both a spectacular front-row seat and unique access to their favourite band.
1600421.title: Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience

1600535.synopsis: An aspiring filmmaker, Raghunath wants to make a film with Marathi superstar Saie Tamhankar as his heroine. What happens when his admiration becomes a dangerous obsession, blurring boundaries?
1600535.title: Date with Saie

1600536.synopsis: An immortal woman and her reincarnating firefighter girlfriend fight over her future in the career after a coworker in injured on the job.
1600536.title: Sequoia

1600540.synopsis: “Iconic Women of Country” is an intimate look at the timeless music of country music’s legendary female singers.
1600540.title: Iconic Women of Country

1600573.synopsis: Uttar is a heartfelt Marathi film that captures today's fast-changing world and the timeless bond between a mother and her son. Uma Bhalerao, a warm radio presenter from Pune, has raised her son, Ninad, single-handedly after her husband's passing. Now a young engineer chasing an ambitious dream, Ninad has grown distant until one day his project unexpectedly brings them closer. What begins as a technical experiment turns into a touching journey of love, understanding and rediscovery. Uttar is a soul-stirring experience that reminds us that no matter how modern life becomes, a mother's heart always knows the way home. A must-watch with your family.
1600573.title: Uttar

1600689.synopsis: A devastating plague has wiped out most of the world's population, plunging society into chaos and leaving survivors driven by vengeance. In this brutal new reality, one grieving father sets out on a relentless quest to track down the man responsible for his daughter's murder. How far will he go to seek justice in a world where revenge is the only law that remains?
1600689.title: What Remains

1600694.synopsis: When tragedy strikes twice, Bhavya refuses to remain a victim. Visually impaired, she is drawn into a perilous hunt for the truth behind the mysterious deaths of her husband & twin sister - uncovering a dark world where nothing is as it seems.
1600694.title: Divya Drushti

1600700.synopsis: After Mikey is suspended, his grandmother warns him about Krampus, a mythical figure who punishes naughty children. As Christmas nears, Mikey's skepticism fades when eerie events suggest Krampus may be real-and he's coming for Mikey's bad behavior.
1600700.title: A Creature Was Stirring

1600701.synopsis: When writer Jeba is murdered at midnight, the calm of an upscale apartment complex shatters. Inspector Magudapathi, known for his unorthodox methods, delves into the residents' secrets to uncover the truth. Amid the chaos, Adhi`s growing bond with his mother's therapist, Meera, complicates everything. Mufti Police is a tense thriller where every neighbor hides a motive and the truth is darker than anyone expects.
1600701.title: Mufti Police

1600761.synopsis: A young man’s strange belief sparks an intervention from his family.
1600761.title: The Worm

1600808.synopsis: Exactly one year after a tragedy, a young writer carries on through the night as though it were any other. What first appears ordinary gradually reveals itself as something far more fragile.
1600808.title: The World Is Our Dance Floor

1600883.synopsis: In a remote village, over a single day, four characters respond differently to the death of an upper-caste man named Shivaji.
1600883.title: Dhandoraa

1601000.synopsis: Revisits the 2010 death of Anastasio Hernández-Rojas, an undocumented Mexican immigrant who died while in custody at the border. When eye-witness video emerges, it sparks a far-reaching investigation from a border checkpoint to Washington D.C. CRITICAL INCIDENT chronicles journalists’, lawyers’, and family members’ efforts to explore the Border Patrol’s involvement in the incident, ultimately pointing to cover-ups, and uncovering the existence of a little-known unit inside the agency that had been involved in other border related incident.
1601000.title: Critical Incident: Death at the Border

1601101.synopsis: After losing everything to a personal mistake, a young man stumbles into a parallel world where a family is trapped by zombies. Driven to save them, he must navigate this deadly reality and fight for survival-and redemption
1601101.title: Not All Movies Are the Same: Dual

1601186.synopsis: White Rock brings together scientists, Traditional Owners, fishers and policymakers to expose one of the biggest environmental challenges facing our oceans: the explosion of long-spined sea urchins devastating Australia's kelp forests.
1601186.title: White Rock

1601195.synopsis: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.
1601195.title: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable...

1601672.synopsis: A group of young men waltz in pairs, balancing with a glass between their foreheads. In this captivating setting, director Albert Rask crafts a new code of conduct - an allegory reflecting the experience of growing up. A playful yet poignant exploration that reframes the burdens of responsibility, expectations and the rules of adulthood.
1601672.title: My Name Is The Sound I Use To Introduce Myself

1601683.synopsis: A getaway game of truth or dare leads four friends to swap partners, risking everything to reignite passion and save their marriages.
1601683.title: Switch

1601724.synopsis: The rural NSW town of Trundle attempts to hold the world's first ABBA Tribute Festival to save their dying town and rival their neighbor Parkes: home of the world's biggest Elvis Tribute Festival.
1601724.title: ABBA & Elvis in the Outback

1601839.synopsis: They follows two university professors over the course of a day. Lyudmil begins a new position at the university where Miho, the older chairman of the department, is busy juggling the social pressures of work and family. In the end, the two are seen living together as a couple, tender but cautious to keep their relationship secret.
1601839.title: They

1602089.synopsis: Japanese rock star HYDE’s concert performance from “HYDE [INSIDE] LIVE 2025 WORLD TOUR BEAUTY & THE BEAST” at KT Zepp Yokohama will be live streamed on Sunday, August 10, 2025. The concert will be available via worldwide live stream and also shown in theaters across Japan and Asia.
1602089.title: HYDE (INSIDE) LIVE 2025 WORLD TOUR: Beauty & The Beast

1602095.synopsis: Floeur Alder's parents are celebrated international ballet stars Lucette Aldous and Alan Alder and she grows up with god-mother Dame Margot Fonteyn and 'Uncle' Rudolf Nureyev. Like her parents, she trains in ballet. She is about to realise her goal to dance on the world stage when she is randomly stabbed in the neck by an unknown man on the streets of Perth. Facing years of physical rehabilitation, she turns to her family and dance to recover and, as the only child of celebrity parents, face the ultimate challenge to find her own way of dancing.
1602095.title: Pointe: Dancing on a Knife's Edge

1602101.synopsis: Reflections of Courage is a gripping documentary that follows Eddy Boas’s powerful account of his family’s survival during the Holocaust in Nazi-occupied Holland. As the youngest survivor, Eddy reveals how moments of bravery and kindness helped them endure unimaginable terror. This is a story of resilience, hope, and the courage to survive against all odds.
1602101.title: Reflections of Courage: The 'Eddy Boas Story'

1602111.synopsis: Nine post war migrants are interviewed in their houses and explain their survival in World War 2, migration to Australia. Travel on ships. Arrival in Australia. Life in migrant camps. Assimilation into Australian society.
1602111.title: Bonegilla: The Migrant's Journey

1602138.synopsis: Marking the 40th anniversary of winning a singing competition as part of a choir from his hometown of Modena in 1955, Luciano Pavarotti keeps a long-held promise and returns to the small town in North Wales to give a very special gala concert at the 1995 Llangollen International Musical Eisteddfod. Joining Pavarotti that evening is the BBC Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Leone Magiera, the modern day Corale Gioachino Rossini, Modena, directed by Paolo Rossini, and, for the finale, Japanese soprano Atzuko Kawahara. The program combines popular operatic arias and choruses, Neapolitan songs, one of Pavarotti’s own compositions, orchestral overtures and interludes, and a very special duet for the finale.
1602138.title: Pavarotti: The Lost Concert - Live at Llangollen 1995

1602259.synopsis: A whaling vessel drifts off-course as its captain hunts the mythical Kraken. Unbeknown to him, the Kraken is also on the hunt. After betrayal and destruction, the remaining crew must battle the beast in a final fight for survival.
1602259.title: Attack of the Kraken

1602459.synopsis: In a quiet village, Bhure's family faces poverty, fear, and old rivalries as Bhima and Pasho dream of a better future for their unborn child. With Dilawar, the rising influence of drugs, and fragile relationships, the lines between loyalty, greed, and truth blur, placing an innocent child in the eye of a storm.
1602459.title: Tera Bhanna Mitha Laage

1602483.synopsis: Andy's bogus job search comes to an end when they accept a mysterious position giving funerals to roadkill.
1602483.title: The Patron Saint of Roadkill

1602579.synopsis: For the first time in history a neurosurgeon describes communication with a live captured alien. This expanded version of Moment of Contact, New Revelations of Alien Encounters sees James Fox return to Brazil in the wake of congressional hearings in the United States. Ground-breaking interviews with former police chief, pathologists, and Dr Ítalo Venturelli who communicated with the alien.
1602579.title: Moment of Contact: New Revelations of Alien Encounters

1602673.synopsis: Following the death of Pope Francis, 135 cardinals enter the Vatican in total secrecy to pray, maneuver, and vote among themselves as both electors and candidates in an ancient ritual that determines the future of the Catholic Church.
1602673.title: Secrets of the Conclave

1602705.synopsis: A rebellious teen and a reserved caretaker form an unlikely bond in an orphanage as they come to terms with their painful pasts.
1602705.title: A Letter to My Youth

1602830.synopsis: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. As their fun-filled hostel life descends into chaos, the students and their warden are forced to face the mysterious presence lurking within Maharaja Hostel.
1602830.title: Maharaja Hostel

1602838.synopsis: From San Diego Comic Con to on board Disney Cruise Line's Destiny, we're with the cast of the Emmy-winning Disney+ Original series "Percy Jackson and the Olympians" for a behind the scenes look at the popular fantasy series.
1602838.title: On The Red Carpet Presents: "Percy Jackson"

1603067.title: Gaming X Symphony – Legends and Quests in Concert

1603261.synopsis: A pharmaceutical trial promises Aya her lost memories, but as they return, her body begins to manifest them in disturbing ways.
1603261.title: A Thing of the Past

1603262.synopsis: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest - the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth - something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.
1603262.title: Everest: The Other Side

1603423.synopsis: In his 10th comedy special, Pandji Pragiwaksono riffs on Indonesian legal culture and the absurdities of daily life in this stand-up political satire.
1603423.title: Mens Rea

1603844.synopsis: Three friends bond and their coming of age graph against a backdrop of kite-flying as a sports event.
1603844.title: Patang

1604179.synopsis: A short absurd romantic comedy about Claude, a highly imaginative teenager who spends an evening going to increasingly elaborate and medieval lengths to try and concoct the perfect sexual fantasy.
1604179.title: The Knight

1604280.synopsis: The story of an Irish brewmaster who travels to America to reconnect with his daughter and transforms an old brewery into an authentic Irish pub. A story of redemption and faith through a heartfelt mix of romance, comedy, and drama.
1604280.title: God & Beer

1604620.synopsis: With a fusion of intimate storytelling and broad reportage, No One Cares About Crazy People is an immersive deep dive into the crisis and chaos of severe mental illness (SMI). The documentary humanizes the face of SMI with a small cast of memorable characters, followed in real time over several years, as they — and also their families — navigate a system that too often seems to conspire against them. The historic roots of this national crisis are traced, as well as the emergence of bold but controversial activism that seeks to reinvent those failed policies. Inspired by the book of the same name by Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist and New York Times bestselling author Ron Powers. With narration by actor Bob Odenkirk and original music by Wilco frontman Jeff Tweedy.
1604620.title: No One Cares About Crazy People

1604647.synopsis: ive been thinking deeply about my work, trying to understand it a little more and i keep coming back to this idea or feeling that its all about transitions, changes... memories fade and life expands around this sense of sadness, or longing, or loss... sort of clinging to something we knew
1604647.title: Steamboat Willie (( Pt ii ))

1604660.synopsis: A man resorts to partying whilst stuck in an apartment.
1604660.title: As The Nights Go By

1604723.synopsis: James Blake joins three young men to explore why they're turned to the so-called manosphere to achieve success, and how it influences their real lives.
1604723.title: Men of the Manosphere

1605290.synopsis: Snoop Dogg and his merry friends sleigh through Minnesota on NFL Gameday to deliver a special holiday performance.
1605290.title: Snoop's Holiday Halftime Party

1605429.synopsis: Dead Bloom unfolds as a socially charged horror story about the lingering effects of environmental contamination and corporate denial.
1605429.title: Dead Bloom

1605903.synopsis: After returning home from a funeral, a couple discovers that Sharon's late mother's urn is at the center of a series of haunting disturbances, unraveling a chilling connection to a murder and a vengeful spirit.
1605903.title: Lady in the Urn

1606352.synopsis: A zombie outbreak confines people in an apartment building, forcing a mother to fight the undead to rescue her two children.
1606352.title: Urban Flesh Eaters

1607014.synopsis: In the year 2222 Earth's last living jungle is under attack from a power-hungry mogul. But Mowgli, a fearless eco-warrior raised by animals, isn't backing down. With his jungle crew he launches a dance-fueled rebellion to save nature.
1607014.title: Jungle Shake

1608087.synopsis: From the streets of Brooklyn to the sun-soaked shores of Miami and the ballparks of San Francisco, Baseball Mensch traces the extraordinary life of Marty Lurie — a Miami Beach Senior High alum whose voice, wit, and wisdom have made him a beloved figure in the world of baseball.
1608087.title: Baseball Mensch:  The Marty Lurie Story

1608982.synopsis: Trapped in an underground pit during a storm, three students from an all-girls school must confront their personal conflicts as they fight to survive.
1608982.title: From the Ashes: The Pit

1609580.synopsis: A Japanese drama film that explores family issues in contemporary society.
1609580.title: STREET SMART

1609843.synopsis: A quantum physics student must fight for his life and the girl he loves when he discovers the universe is governed by 7 parallel timelines and her estranged ex-boyfriend is out to kill her in every single one.
1609843.title: The Time Vortex

1609943.synopsis: A teenager is caught between her attraction to a boy and the sinister presence that resides in her attic; a confused townie roams the countryside, convinced that the locals are out to get her; and in a world where everyone has a double, one woman seeks to be her own person. A twisted collection of tales that dig into the human psyche to expose the violent urges and hidden fears that lurk within.
1609943.title: From Her Bones

1610019.synopsis: Guided by a legendary figure of the Finnish wood throwing game, a group of mates form Australia’s first ever team to compete at the Mölkky World Championships.
1610019.title: First to Fifty

1610181.synopsis: Four women are pushed to their breaking point in Dhaka’s underbelly, where the only way to survive systemic exploitation is to stop being the prey and start being the threat.
1610181.title: Pressure Cooker

1610413.synopsis: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.
1610413.title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5

1610460.synopsis: Fleeing her past, a troubled hiker and her dog traverse the Appalachian Trail, only to fall under the spell of a dangerous man. As obsession and visions mount, she's drawn toward Mile 666, where lust, death, and something ancient await.
1610460.title: Mile 666

1610646.synopsis: Madhan goes on a one-day date with Radhi, a beautiful girl who works at a spa; the day spirals into a dangerous chase as both the police and a gang hunt for Radhi, ending in a shocking truth that reveals their connection.
1610646.title: Dear Radhi

1610736.synopsis: A transgender woman returns home to finally come out to her parents, but as dinner spirals out of control, her anxieties manifest in sinister ways.
1610736.title: Homecoming

1610829.synopsis: Josemon shirked responsibility while his sister Sarah gave up her dreams for the family. Artist Kaleena comes to paint the church and challenges him.
1610829.title: Velleppam

1610865.synopsis: Two brothers, Nick and Alex, embark on a worldwide journey to discover what life is like for other siblings living with Down's Syndrome. Along the way, they learn more about their own relationship and the special bond they share.
1610865.title: Downside Up

1610971.synopsis: One of the strange guests at the eerie inn is a serial killer, trapping a ventriloquist investigator and his wooden sidekick.
1610971.title: The Dummy Detective

1611230.synopsis: Two friends' attempt to rescue the home from financial ruin by renting out rooms which turns into a nightmare as the guests uncover the house's dark, ritual-filled past.
1611230.title: The Ritual House

1611487.synopsis: One minute. One mic. No mercy. Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests put up-and-coming comedians to the test at a relentless Austin showcase.
1611487.title: Kill Tony: Once Upon a Time in Texas

1611586.synopsis: After nearly three years living in Japan, Fergus Gregg finds himself struggling to bid farewell to this beautiful country. On a journey tracing the path of his hero, the poet Matsuo Basho, Fergus decides to trek the northern landscapes of Tohoku. As he travels, he encounters more than he bargained for - facing setbacks, meetings with traditional hunter-gathers, and dances at northern Japan's largest Summer festival. Join Fergus Gregg on his 'Road to the North'.
1611586.title: Road to the North

1611629.synopsis: Hip-hop legend and hustler-turned-comedian Tip “T.I.” Harris is stepping into a whole new spotlight with his first-ever comedy special. From family drama to fame, and from the trap to the stage, nothing’s too wild (or too real) for T.I. to tackle. It’s raw. It’s unfiltered. And it’s funny as hell. Cheaper Than Therapy proves that sometimes the hardest-hitting lines aren’t in a verse—they’re in a joke.
1611629.title: Tip Harris: Cheaper Than Therapy

1611730.synopsis: A man on parole, a struggling mother, and a pair of drug dealing brothers each become part of a dizzying multiplicity of plots, but one story.  "The Devil Makes Work For Idle Hands" is a working class drama which focuses on social mobility, disillusionment, and the struggles of working class people. Seen through the perspectives of three characters, the film is loosely based on real life events and uses a mixture of professional and first time actors.
1611730.title: The Devil Makes Work For Idle Hands

1611790.synopsis: Nearly a year after catastrophic wildfires reshaped Los Angeles, Weathered host Maiya May returns to ask a question facing communities worldwide: what does recovery truly look like in an era of escalating climate extremes? What she finds goes far beyond one city - survivors still grappling with loss, systemic failures, and unanswered questions that echo across fire-prone regions on every continent.  As climate-driven wildfires intensify from California to Australia, Southern Europe, and beyond, Maiya’s investigation uncovers an emerging blueprint for wildfire-resilient communities - highlighting innovation, adaptation, and collective action that transcend borders. Both urgent and hopeful, the film offers a timely, internationally relevant roadmap for how societies can prepare for a hotter, more volatile future.
1611790.title: Weathered: After the LA Firestorm

1611875.synopsis: A film collaboration between Quenten Agius (Aboriginal storyteller) and Kim Mavromatis (mixed media producer). Filmed on Ngadjuri country, Mid North and Southern Flinders Ranges region of South Australia. The film incorporates 10 years of archival material, shot with 8 different cameras, including 3 drones and a mobile phone camera.
1611875.title: Ngadjuri - Spirit And Songs Of Country

1611977.synopsis: After his wife's consciousness is transferred into their android maid, a widower finds himself trapped in a deadly love triangle when the jealous A.I. goes to terrifying lengths to prevent him from moving on with a new woman.
1611977.title: Housemaid

1612018.synopsis: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.
1612018.title: Jackass: Best and Last

1612139.synopsis: A man desperate to disappear must embrace the very past he's running from when a relentless genetically enhanced killer hunts him down.
1612139.title: Eidolon

1612251.synopsis: When a struggling high school student is confronted with the painful fracture of her family, she seeks refuge far from the noise of her parents’ world. In the company of her grandmother and an old friend, she begins to see life from a distance---both tender and selfless. Her lessons and realizations are things that cannot be learned from books, but only from a life lived.
1612251.title: Until She Remembers

1612291.synopsis: The world of the supernatural meets the wild west when a small group of solders enter Apache county to find their missing comrade. Quickly, they discover something is terribly wrong as the very land itself appears to have turned against them. As they face demons of both man and myth, it's going to take all they have to survive.
1612291.title: Blood Totem

1612522.synopsis: Jack, a quadriplegic, and Lina, his day nurse, spy on neighbors with a drone and stumble upon a serial killer. When Lina finds a mysterious relic inside the killer's house, it transports her and Jack to an underworld where they switch bodies and are forced to kill for a creature. Embracing the killing inside Lina's body, will Jack want to switch back?
1612522.title: Give Me Back My Body!

1613035.synopsis: It follows an ordinary family whose lives are abruptly transformed by extraordinary luck—unraveling how money can both bind people together and quietly pull them apart.
1613035.title: The Lotto Winner

1613335.synopsis: This is the story of the “Miracle on Ice,” when the 1980 US Hockey Team beat the USSR in the Olympic semi-finals at the height of the Cold War to bring home a gold medal. Their iconic underdog story is told with never-before-seen 16mm footage and firsthand reflections from the players who were brought back to the scene of their historic victory.
1613335.title: Miracle: The Boys of '80

1613798.synopsis: The brutal murder of the wife of “Toro,” a military hero in the special forces, turns him into a man with a single purpose: revenge. After a stroke of fate makes him a millionaire, Carlos transforms his fortune into an arsenal and, together with his closest soldiers, sets out to hunt down those responsible.
1613798.title: Vengeance

1614424.synopsis: PLEASE NOTE: June 2027 is not a confirmed date. It is our target completion date and may change.  Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine. Unreal Engine is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved.  Set in Mount Gambier, South Australia, the film follows Lumy, a young girl who witnesses her father’s sacrifice at the edge of the mysterious Blue Lake. Growing up with unhealed trauma and an unexplainable power tied to the water itself, Lumy retreats into science while being quietly hunted by forces she doesn’t fully understand.  Years later, she forms a deep connection with a broken but kindred soul, Ashton. Together, they become scientists and uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the lake one that links Lumy’s existence to a phenomenon capable of reshaping reality. As the past resurfaces and the hunters return, Lumy must confront what her father died to protect. Born In Blue is a story of grief, survival, inheritance, and the cost of love.
1614424.title: born blue

1614492.synopsis: A graveyard rendezvous that isn’t just about love, but about fulfilling a promise – and facing its consequences.  A family weekend that digs up buried secrets – secrets that perhaps should have stayed underground forever.  A legendary VHS tape, worth killing for – or maybe someone already has.  And a childhood tale that proves, years later: sometimes the scariest things are the ones we believed were true as kids.  From Horrorszkóp and Cruel World Team comes four dark and unsettling stories in this chilling horror anthology.  Each one steeped in the shadow of death, human weakness, and the grim truth that the ending is never what you expect.  Four stories. Four secrets. Four inevitable ends.
1614492.title: The Four Gates of Death

1615229.synopsis: Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine and set in Mount Gambier (Berrin), South Australia. The story follows Lumy, a young girl who grows up in New Zealand before moving with her father to the quiet volcanic town beside the Blue Lake. In the late 1800s, time traveling villains arrive from the future, drawn to a powerful phenomenon beneath the lake and seeking Lumy herself. At the lake’s edge, her father sacrifices his life to protect her, altering the course of time. Marked by trauma and a mysterious bond to the water, Lumy grows up driven by grief and unanswered questions, turning to science while unaware she is still being hunted. Years later, alongside fellow scientist Ashton, she uncovers the truth the same force beneath Berrin fuels both the villains’ technology and her own ability to move through time. Realising what she has inherited, Lumy prepares to fight back and protect what her father died to save.
1615229.title: Born In Blue

1615734.synopsis: A brave group of international volunteers take their converted truck into Ukraine’s Eastern frontline villages to cook, hand out free pizzas and paint the faces of the children. Their presence offers a brief moment of joy and escapism in ‘forgotten’ villages, many of which had been occupied by Russia and which now face reoccupation; villages that have been largely abandoned by their government and by other aid agencies.
1615734.title: Pizza Under Fire

1615742.synopsis: Sir Frank Lowy has lived many lives. Born in Slovakia in 1930, he lost his father in the Holocaust, he fought in the Arab-Israeli War in 1948 and left Israel in 1952 for Australia to join family members who had settled in Sydney. There, Lowy met fellow immigrant John Saunders and together they opened their first shopping centre in Sydney in 1959, which led to the multi-billion-dollar international shopping centre empire, Westfield Corporation.
1615742.title: To Be a Jew: Frank Lowy In His Own Words

1616131.synopsis: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
1616131.title: A Child of My Own

1616263.synopsis: Kishii Samanosuke reunites with Heizo, battling deadly foes to protect a hunted girl and face master thief Koazu no Gentan.
1616263.title: Samurai Detective Onihei: Two Righteous Swords

1616400.synopsis: Tells the story of 28-year-old Horizon Air ground service agent Richard “Beebo” Russell, who, to the shock of all who knew him, clocked into work wearing a shirt that said “sky’s no limit,” stole a 33-million-dollar plane, and took off into the skies of the Pacific Northwest embarking on a white-knuckle flight that would come to embody the hopes, dreams, and despair of the American working class, and offer a timely look into the U.S. mental health crisis.
1616400.title: #SKYKING

1616674.synopsis: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.
1616674.title: Me Before Me

1616700.synopsis: Mo Gilligan takes on Hollywood — and lives to tell the tale. In this lively special, the Londoner dishes on fame, family and being British in America.
1616700.title: Mo Gilligan: In the Moment

1617115.synopsis: With a dark past in the foster system, a lonely woman questions if her new found half-brother is also the violent stalker wracking havoc on her.
1617115.title: Brother Unknown

1617810.synopsis: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.
1617810.title: Ice Twister

1617908.synopsis: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.
1617908.title: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter

1618086.synopsis: A group of teens dare each other to summon a mysterious figure from an old urban legend but what was suppose to be a harmless game turns deadly when one of them breaks an unspoken rule, unleashing the terrifying entity into the real world. Now hunted one by one, the friends must uncover the dark origins of the legend and find a way to banish the spirit before the knocking comes for them next.—Joseph Mazzaferro
1618086.title: The Knock Knock Man

1618837.synopsis: The “gay male nuns” of Sydney’s Order of Perpetual Indulgence have been shocking, delighting and confounding audiences with their satirical activism for over four decades, but does this bold brand of activism still hold relevance today?
1618837.title: Old Habits

1618838.synopsis: An intimate, autobiographical story of a transformative pair of pants and a childhood refusal to conform to societal expectations of gender.
1618838.title: Tarzan Pants

1618843.synopsis: Three college seniors venture to the abandoned Dizzy Dishes cabaret club while researching its fiery past. They encounter the former owner, Betty — who claims to be half woman, half “something else.”
1618843.title: Betty's Revenge

1618945.synopsis: Thando is perpetually unlucky in love, but when her bestie returns from his travels with a fiancée in tow, she's forced to face a new emotion — jealousy.
1618945.title: Yoh! Bestie

1619250.synopsis: Imagine a time when Earth was a molten, volcanic wasteland, constantly bombarded by colossal asteroids. We’ve long feared these cosmic impacts as destroyers of life – just ask the dinosaurs – but what if they were the key to our very existence? Explore a revolutionary new theory suggesting that these violent collisions provided the essential ingredients – water, minerals, and energy – needed for life to ignite on our planet. Discover how scientists are unearthing evidence from lunar rocks and ancient impact craters, revealing that the very objects once thought to extinguish life might have actually sparked it.
1619250.title: Asteroids: The Spark of Life?

1619417.synopsis: A group of vloggers investigate an abandoned research facility, where long-buried secrets transform their search into a desperate fight for survival.
1619417.title: The Bigfoot Experiment

1619533.synopsis: In the Arctic Circle, Jason Fox and an elite team of military veterans open up to each other about men’s mental health while taking on one of the world’s toughest ultramarathons.
1619533.title: Arctic Adventure: Ultimate Survival

1619989.synopsis: Shadowlands is an anthology series that explores love in three distinct stories: a couple renegotiating a relationship, a narcissist seeking to understand it, and star-crossed lovers mourning its loss.
1619989.title: Shadowlands

1620025.synopsis: Nothing is what it seems-five gripping tales where every secret hides something darker.
1620025.title: Beneath The Surface

1620034.synopsis: Martin Short looks back on a life fueled by joy in this documentary with classic clips, fresh interviews and star-studded, never-before-seen home movies.
1620034.title: Marty, Life Is Short

1620119.synopsis: A psychiatrist struggles to aid her stranded family and patients while grappling with her own mental state.
1620119.title: Dr. Quarantine

1620551.synopsis: A teenager, the only hearing member of a deaf family, finds her voice and learns to believe in herself through her passion for singing.
1620551.title: Feel My Voice

1620682.synopsis: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?
1620682.title: Love in Slow Motion

1620711.synopsis: Jean and Brendan have been dating for a couple months now. It's that sweet spot: Brendan's still enamored with Jean's career as a painter and Jean still finds Brendan's less-than-clever jokes funny. But as they begin to enter the thrilling and butterfly-inducing journey of physical intimacy, it is revealed that all may not be well. Brendan's riddled with anxieties in the bedroom, and Jean's own residence is overshadowed by something potentially more lethal: A poltergeist.
1620711.title: Its Presence Between Us

1620829.synopsis: Three generations living under one leaky Wellington roof in 2003, all on the brink of transformation. Sixteen-year-old Cassie is all bravado and vulnerability, drifting into risky territory as she searches for validation in all the wrong places. Her mother Maxine, 52, a formidable single-mother filmmaker on the brink of a long-awaited breakthrough, is finally offered a greenlight - if she can just land a star. Holding everything together is Huia, Cassie’s grandmother, 80, whose life has been defined by quiet service to family and a private obsession with raising monarch caterpillars, dreaming of one day witnessing the legendary butterfly migration in Mexico. But when Huia’s mind begins to fail her, the family is thrust into chaos. Can the maternal line hold together while everything is throwing them apart?
1620829.title: Caterpillar

1620845.synopsis: When a local Ten Pin Bowling Alley in the northern suburbs of Melbourne Australia puts on a Pro Amateur competition with the biggest cash prize in the country, the local league players try their luck.
1620845.title: Spare Time

1620943.synopsis: Jija Jung Bahadur, a man who knows everything about nothing, lands at his in-laws' home and turns life upside down. His ego and antics spark endless clashes with brothers-in-law Pinky and Gogi as they prepare to marry off their sister.
1620943.title: Welcome Jija Ji

1620991.synopsis: An engaging and thought-provoking look at Lucy Letby, the former nurse serving life in prison after being convicted of the murders of seven infants and the attempted murders of seven others.
1620991.title: The Investigation of Lucy Letby

1621024.synopsis: The epic duel between Djokovic and Nadal, showcasing their physical brilliance, mental resilience and emotional intensity. Explore how this match raised the bar for physical and mental demands in tennis, and inspired upcoming players.
1621024.title: The Match That Changed Tennis

1621113.synopsis: BRIT-winning and Grammy-nominated band Bring Me The Horizon's biggest headline show to date. Shot at São Paulo’s Allianz Parque Stadium, performed in front of a sold-out crowd of 50,000, the film expands the visual universe of POST HUMAN by blending cinematic visuals, fan-submitted videos and showcasing characters such as E.V.E, Selene & M8. It delivers an immersive experience that rivals that electric night in Brazil. The performance spans the full evolution of BMTH’s discography, from Sempiternal and That’s the Spirit to amo and the POST HUMAN albums. L.I.V.E. in São Paulo brings the viewer in, and never lets them go.
1621113.title: Bring Me the Horizon: L.I.V.E. in São Paulo

1621552.synopsis: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
1621552.title: Facing El Chapo

1621612.synopsis: In 1992, semi-retired detective and author Martin Dye is hired to track down a missing duffel bag of cash tied to a fatal 1970s crash that left one friend dead and another in a wheelchair. As Martin follows the trail through old classmates, small-town gossip, and buried lies, he uncovers a dark legacy of drugs, betrayal, and shattered lives - and learns some secrets refuse to stay buried.
1621612.title: Tears to a Glass Eye

1621636.synopsis: Furr Fever is the wild, fuzzed-up guitar-slinger of The Sextortions, a rockabilly band as deranged as they are irresistible. When Furr crosses paths with the howling, leather-clad Wolfy Howl, the two lost souls collide in a blaze of glitter and guitars in overdrive. But scheming music moguls, a corrupt Trump-ish mayor and a backstabbing bandmate are all gunning to tame them. Fortunately, the ghost of The King lives in Furr’s gold guitar, and rock and roll cannot be caged.
1621636.title: Wolf Cat Fever

1621842.synopsis: A gangster-in-training kidnaps the daughter of a prominent businessman in an attempt to win his boss' favour, but gets caught up in a web of deceit and conflict.
1621842.title: Bebe Main Badmash Banuga

1621987.synopsis: Beneath a cloud dog, a young woman swims. Later, she meets her brother at a cafe. A man from another place arrives and invites her to a private concert.
1621987.title: Jazzer Mouse
