1622032.synopsis: Get ready for comedic royalty as the Undisputed Queen of Comedy, Sommore, returns to Detroit for her 7th special, performing up close and personal at the Garden Theatre, recorded on June 28th.
1622032.title: Sommore: Chandelier Fly

1622039.synopsis: We get a glimpse into the fractured mind of an anxious news anchor one minute before going live.
1622039.title: The Anchor

1622226.synopsis: When a brother and sister are reunited after years of separation, they uncover a dark secret about one of the worlds largest pharmaceutical companies. Eager to expose the truth, they have no choice but to face their darkest fears together.

1623070.synopsis: Comedian Udom Taephanich shares candid stories from his chaotic life, from superstition and dark rituals to his time in Korea.
1623070.title: Deaw Still Alive

1623111.synopsis: Amanda Knox returns to Italy to confront Giuliano Mignini, the prosecutor who locked her up for a murder she did not commit
1623111.title: Mouth of the Wolf: Amanda Knox Returns to Italy

1623125.synopsis: Veteran naturalist Sir David Attenborough tells the story of a remarkable group of gorillas, from his first encounter in the '70s to the present day.
1623125.title: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough

1623260.synopsis: Three young sisters share a rented apartment in Rome’s university district with their respective boyfriends. Active in the student collective yet openly opposed to its leadership, they see themselves as guardians of a legacy of betrayed struggles, convinced they can renew a true sense of the “commons” on a small scale. Marginalized and outnumbered within the collective, they decide to make a documentary about the student occupation of the university.
1623260.title: Three sisters

1623526.synopsis: The Opening Ceremony of Milano Cortina 2026 features blockbuster acts from international artists including five-time Grammy Award-winner Mariah Carey, Golden Globe winner Laura Pausini and famed Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli, to the award-winning actor and producer Pierfrancesco Favino and The White Lotus’ Emmy-nominated star Sabrina Impacciatore.
1623526.title: Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Opening Ceremony: Harmony

1623583.synopsis: A documentary style examination of the artistic process, delving into the creation of a project that takes an immeasurable toll on its creator.
1623583.title: I BURNT MY BRAIN FOR YOU

1623927.synopsis: Granny is an upcoming film directed by Vijaya Kumara, starring Vadivukkarasi, Dhileepan, Singampuli, Gaja Raja, Ananthu Nag, and Aparna in prominent roles.
1623927.title: Granny

1624039.synopsis: A history of encounters in Edmonton and British Columbia.
1624039.title: Tracking the Wendigo

1624363.synopsis: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.
1624363.title: Lomu

1624564.synopsis: During a film shoot at a crew member's ancestral home in Perak, a production team's set is plagued by escalating trouble and eerie disruptions that threaten the entire project.
1624564.title: Libang Libu

1624613.synopsis: Lainey Wilson redefines what it means to be a modern country star while exploring her struggles and triumphs at a pivotal career moment.
1624613.title: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool

1624621.synopsis: A tender romantic drama about two young hearts brought together by fate. Kumari explores love, emotions, and the courage to choose the heart despite life’s challenges. A soulful Valentine-season love story.
1624621.title: Kumari

1624803.title: Doctor Who: Eve of the Daleks

1624931.synopsis: Three friends embark on a new experience only to find that they weren’t quite ready for what was in store for them.
1624931.title: Threefold

1624950.synopsis: Loud music, charismatic vocalists, broken guitars and drunk fans. The fervent and accepting Melbourne music scene in shown through local rock band Mindstain. Meet the magnetic members of the band. Encounter the sociable fans that thrive in the community. Feel the vigorous intensity that is the chaotic mosh pic. Hear the booming impassioned music and discover what makes this community so special.
1624950.title: Golden Age

1625328.synopsis: In the summer of 2022, a miner struck more than gold outside Dawson City, in Canada’s Yukon. A fully preserved infant woolly mammoth that died 36,000 years ago protruded from the Arctic permafrost, her flesh still pink and green grass in her belly. The creature’s discovery reignited interest in a species that has long inspired scientific curiosity.
1625328.title: Mammoth Hunters

1625381.synopsis: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.
1625381.title: Heart Eyes 2

1626170.synopsis: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.
1626170.title: Sing Geetham

1626188.synopsis: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.
1626188.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter

1626279.synopsis: After losing her boyfriend in a car accident. Shelly hesitant about dating again, until she's introduced to the charming Les Harris, who has alternative motives.
1626279.title: Unauthorized Love

1626675.synopsis: To join the elite ATIC Guard, Alana Toro must pass one final test: enter a simulation, prevent a terrorist attack, and prove her loyalty. Every mistake resets the clock. Every death disappears - except in her memory, where the weight keeps building. The more Alana learns, the more she begins to question the organisation she fought so hard to join.
1626675.title: Voidance

1626841.synopsis: After a jail stint, Slim hears about hidden legendary cough syrup and plots to steal it with his partner Pack, leading to betrayals and danger as they chase the score through the criminal underworld.
1626841.title: Double Cup

1627046.synopsis: How did PFAS chemicals once used in popular stain-resistant carpets end up in the water and environment in parts of Georgia, Alabama and South Carolina? FRONTLINE, The Associated Press, The Atlanta Journal-Constitution, The Post and Courier and AL.com investigate what happened with these forever chemicals and the ongoing health impacts. The joint investigation draws on thousands of pages of documents and court depositions and interviews with former regulators and industry insiders, as well as doctors, scientists and people who have the kinds of illnesses that researchers have linked to PFAS contamination.
1627046.title: Contaminated: The Carpet Industry's Toxic Legacy

1627382.synopsis: A married woman's secret affair spirals out of control when her brother in law traps everyone inside the house to expose the truth. As tensions rise, a violent accident forces everyone to question loyalty, love, and who the real victim is.
1627382.title: His Brother's Wife

1627696.synopsis: Officer Wray is determined to prove to his boss that he has what it takes to bring justice for an innocent victim involved in a murder case gone wrong. His boss assigns him onto a recent murder case involving 7 suspects who all had the potential to have committed this murder. As Officer Wray digs deeper into this mystery, with the help of a key witness and a helpful journalist, the situation becomes more and more dangerous for not just himself, but for everyone involved...
1627696.title: "It's Murder!"

1627824.synopsis: When one of Humdinger's schemes goes awry, a Junkyard Kitten's home is destroyed and Rocky bites off more than he can chew when he invites the kitten to stay at the Lookout overnight. While the kitten causes more trouble than expected, Rocky learns that even heroes need help.
1627824.title: Rocky's Cat-astrophe

1627976.synopsis: Hashtag Star follows the story of a social media influencer. Just when everything seems perfect, a forgotten mistake from her past resurfaces. As secrets discloses in the public eye, a celebrated social media influencer is forced to confront the truth, testing her reputation, relationships, and the cost of online fame.
1627976.title: Hashtag Star

1628116.synopsis: They're back! BTS gathers in LA to record their album "Arirang" in this documentary offering unprecedented access to the band as they enter a new era.
1628116.title: BTS: THE RETURN

1628123.synopsis: BTS is back. The iconic group returns to the stage for a live reunion concert to perform legendary hits and unveil brand-new tracks.
1628123.title: BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG

1628345.synopsis: The House of Beckham is at war. But what's the truth behind the accusations?
1628345.title: The Beckham Feud: Truth & Lies

1628367.synopsis: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.
1628367.title: Kartavya

1628442.synopsis: an Australian independent drama directed by Duncan James, following a bored, suburban housewife named Suze who discovers shocking secrets about her husband during a solo road trip. The 1h 23m film explores themes of guilt, redemption, and complex family dynamics with a French-cinema-inspired style.
1628442.title: Misgivings

1628448.synopsis: In this dark comedy, a woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — there's a dead body in her kitchen.
1628448.title: Maa Behen

1628484.synopsis: Back for his fourth Netflix stand-up special, comedy icon Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities and the world at large in this electrifying set.
1628484.title: Katt Williams: The Last Report

1628545.synopsis: The last living descendants of a once-thriving Black neighborhood in Athens, GA, come together to fight to preserve the memory of Linnentown. Their family homes were razed in a 1960s urban renewal project, and now they, along with civic-minded neighbors, unite to try to reclaim their forgotten history and seek redress.
1628545.title: Linnentown

1629172.synopsis: A short documentary about a man, his legacy and his impact on the world.
1629172.title: T.G.

1629326.synopsis: Minh Như returns to her family’s dye workshop after years of exile. There, she confronts terrifying supernatural phenomena and uncovers the brutal truth behind her mother’s death and a blood-soaked pact from the past.
1629326.title: The Corpse 2

1629369.synopsis: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.
1629369.title: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson

1629382.synopsis: Grieving and facing the consequences of their crimes, the Traoré brothers get one last chance to forge a new path.
1629382.title: Street Flow 3

1629517.synopsis: Three of the youngest Turpin siblings tell their stories of the past and how they experienced abuse a second time in the foster care system.
1629517.title: The Turpins: A New House of Horror - A Diane Sawyer Special Event

1629790.synopsis: "For months we experimented and represented ourselves, starting with simple walks in search of material for a thesis. How can we visually recreate a memory? We walked and filmed, photographed and painted, got to know each other and told our stories. An experience transformed into a story that speaks of a shared journey, made up of filming, changes of season, conversations about the moon, and exchanges of techniques. Inspired by “Dark Side of the Moon,” we tried to represent the intimate and personal emotions that came to us through the album. Each song has a language, each movement a color, each sound an expression. What remains today, half a century later? Something inexplicable, perhaps. A wonderful creation of friendship and mutual artistic esteem, the (re)creation of multiple memories, which overlap like membranes on the screen. - Erik Negro
1629790.title: Return to the Moon (or Nothing)

1629962.synopsis: The Story of Sam Regulus and his adventures to find his missing brother Jason
1629962.title: Echoes of Dread

1630021.synopsis: What’s next for Venezuela after the dramatic fall of Nicolás Maduro? In a documentary from the filmmakers behind A Dangerous Assignment, FRONTLINE and The Associated Press investigate the legacy of corruption in Venezuela, the challenges to democracy, the conflict with the U.S., and the fight over who will control the oil-rich country.
1630021.title: Crisis In Venezuela

1630293.synopsis: Two sisters returning to their family home after their mother's death, only to confront the monsters they accidentally conjured with a Ouija board.
1630293.title: They Wait in Shadows

1630409.synopsis: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.
1630409.title: The Debt Collector

1630423.synopsis: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.
1630423.title: My Dearest Assassin

1630433.synopsis: Three women fall prey to a ruthless phone scam. To settle the score, they'll take on the criminal network that stole their money — and their dignity.
1630433.title: The Red Line

1630661.synopsis: Follows Indians facing challenges while trying to travel to the USA and the struggles they encounter after reaching there.
1630661.title: Gaayapadda Simham

1630747.synopsis: Marshall Brooker is a relic hunter for hire. On his latest job, he discovers an ancient mask that seems to possess supernatural powers. Instead of turning it over to his employers, he attempts to hold it hostage until the price is raised. Unfortunately for him, the man paying for his treks into the jungle is Roman Stalnik, a heartless collector of relics, and a man who already knows their power. Now, Brooker must find a way to protect his family and get out alive, before the occult cabal funding Roman gets their hands on the relic.
1630747.title: Brooker

1631285.synopsis: The film examines girlhood as inherited performance-costumes worn before identity forms. Mona frames femininity as simultaneous nurture and constraint, exploring how intimacy between girls and garments becomes predetermined theatre. Clothing functions as ritual and control, dictating movement before self-knowledge arrives.
1631285.title: Discipline

1631485.synopsis: A former communist militant and a "live and let live" man form an unlikely friendship on a park bench, sharing their life stories with humor and heart.
1631485.title: Strangers in the Park

1631682.synopsis: Diagnosed at birth with a rare condition that was expected to kill him, Chad "Shorty" McDaniel embraces humor, grit, and a competitive spirit to live the life others said he would never have and shatter assumptions about disability.
1631682.title: 96 Pounds of Dynamite

1631807.synopsis: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.
1631807.title: The Secret Woman

1631856.synopsis: When a series of unfortunate coincidences involving a woman, her husband and her ex, culminates in a shocking death, her long-lost sister returns to redeem her.
1631856.title: Oh Butterfly!

1631917.synopsis: A spirited teen dreaming of the perfect debut makes a deal with a lonely newcomer, but unexpected feelings and revelations may shatter their plans.
1631917.title: 18th Rose

1632473.synopsis: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.
1632473.title: This, That, and Everything in Between

1632563.synopsis: After a tragic choice leads him to the brink, a disillusioned artist named Michael awakens on a mysterious beach. a liminal space where lost souls come to confront their pasts. Guided by Bob, a charismatic yet enigmatic caretaker, Michael embarks on a surreal journey through the pivotal moments of his life: love, heartbreak, and devastating loss. As he confronts hidden truths and unspoken regrets, Michael is faced with one profound question: Was it worth it, and what would life be like if he had stayed?
1632563.title: If You had Stayed

1632818.synopsis: A group of adult models turned thieves who face unintended consequences after stealing a camcorder that houses the spirit of a murdered child.
1632818.title: Dark Distortion

1632879.synopsis: From the Cadillac Palace Theatre in Chicago, comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first HBO stand-up special. A high-energy performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another – from Trader Joe’s to Oreos, NPR, and dog breeds – Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines, and more.
1632879.title: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace

1633056.synopsis: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.
1633056.title: All Wishes Come True!

1633264.synopsis: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.
1633264.title: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere

1633410.synopsis: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.
1633410.title: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'

1633759.synopsis: Two teenagers, Tom and Mac, are pulled and chased around Brisbane city as they argue about drugs, kickons and their life ambitions.
1633759.title: Sips

1633832.synopsis: Across six chilling stories, strangers face the terrifying consequences of their choices as a creeping nightmare begins to invade their lives.
1633832.title: Insidious Tales

1634198.synopsis: Growing Up Nyima is a documentary film that follows Nyima Tucker, a young woman of Ngarluma, Banjima, and Yamatji heritage, as she moves between the worlds of city and country. Born in the Pilbara and raised in Karratha before relocating to Perth at sixteen, Nyima’s journey captures the tension between modern life and ancestral connection. Across the 1,500 km that separate these landscapes, she grapples with questions of identity, belonging, and the meaning of home.
1634198.title: Growing Up Nyima: Between Two Worlds

1634301.synopsis: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.
1634301.title: Vanaveera

1634383.director: Thomas van Gool, Prospera Holder Young
1634383.synopsis: Victoria flies through the world solo, spending her days riding an e-scooter through the city, dealing second-rate vapes to teenagers she has no patience for. But, when her routine is disrupted by an encounter with a mysterious stranger who makes her feel seen, she questions if there might be another way she could be doing things.
1634383.title: Who is Still Dreaming?

1634392.director: Thomas van Gool, Prospera Holder Young
1634392.synopsis: A couple arguing about curtains decide to stop arguing and start dancing instead.
1634392.title: Dance to Soothe Nothing

1634479.synopsis: The hit series about final goodbyes between the dead and the living across borders comes to the big screen. Angel Hearse receives a wave of international repatriation requests: a couple in Mexico in a movie-like romance, a baby, a man in a wheelchair on a world journey, an American star and his secret love, and Nami, who heads to Mexico after news her lover is alive. Will miracle reunions await?
1634479.title: Angel Flight THE MOVIE

1634508.synopsis: Thirty years ago, a prominent zamindar family resided in Bangalore, consisting of Maari and Dr. Mamtha. This period marked the advent of IT and biotech companies entering Bangalore, juxtaposed with the city's notorious underworld activity
1634508.title: Surya Power of Love

1634681.synopsis: Few sporting events hold the cultural weight of the Sydney to Hobart. Every Boxing Day, as the Cricket Test breaks for lunch, millions of Australians turn their attention to the start of the Great Race. For days, the nation follows the fleet into one of the world’s most treacherous bodies of water — Bass Strait — where shifting weather systems can turn elite competition into a fight for survival.
1634681.title: True South

1634949.synopsis: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.
1634949.title: Lorne

1635086.synopsis: Three eccentric brothers maintain their "no women, no marriage" rule at their garage, but a return sparks fresh chaos. As old habits clash with new troubles, the iconic trio finds their world hilariously spiraling out of control.
1635086.title: Punha Ekda Sade Made 3

1635161.synopsis: Three gold miners searching for riches find a forgotten town. To survive the night, they must obey its bizarre rules, where every mistake is fatal.
1635161.title: Sundown

1635276.synopsis: Five eccentric dog owners seek help in dealing with their four-legged friends. Their last hope: an intensive course with the charismatic and legendary dog trainer Nodon in the Tyrolean mountains.
1635276.title: Eat Pray Bark

1635343.synopsis: When a student secretly living out of her car is confronted by a watchful security guard, survival and compassion collide.
1635343.title: Squata Locks

1635529.synopsis: Chanan Singh returns to his village after being dismissed from the royal palace, leading to a conflict with the crown over dignity and revolution.
1635529.title: Bambukat 2

1636092.synopsis: A disgraced cop gets one last shot at redemption by busting a major black money ring. The twist? His targets aren't typical criminals but women and children concealing something far more sinister than financial crimes.
1636092.title: DSP Dev 2

1636147.synopsis: Featuring the parallel stories of a supersize building project and a jaw-dropping archaeological adventure, Rome Underground takes viewers on an immersive journey deep under the Eternal City — revealing how the construction of a 26-kilometer subway line through Rome has literally unearthed some of the most important discoveries of the modern age.
1636147.title: Rome Underground

1636421.synopsis: A reclusive heiress, bound by blood and burden, invites seven distant relatives to her decaying manor with whispers of inheritance. Beneath the promise lies a quiet cruelty- a gauntlet of secrets, temptation, and ruin. As family bonds unravel, she watches, choosing not just a successor, but a soul willing to bear the curse she can no longer carry. One will inherit the family estate, but only the heiress knows the hefty price they'll pay.
1636421.title: The Executor

1636593.synopsis: Cisco and Cheska, a long-term couple, embark on a final "break-up trip" to decide whether to let go or fight for their relationship after years of growing apart due to conflicting ambitions.
1636593.title: Us in the End

1636741.synopsis: When a successful ad agent and perpetual bachelorette obtains the name of her "true love" from a magical billboard she is forced to deal with her friends obsessions' to find her Mr. Right.

1636918.synopsis: This eye-opening documentary follows six couples with unexplained infertility as they lower their exposure to plastics in hopes it helps them conceive.
1636918.title: The Plastic Detox

1637046.synopsis: Go inside the pressure cooker of Australia's Supercars Final. Chaos erupts, hearts broken and dreams are realised on the streets of Adelaide.
1637046.title: Supercars - Road to Glory

1637137.synopsis: Martin, a 16-year-old from Čučer-Sandevo, Macedonia, dreams of becoming a star as a professional gamer — an aspiration that conflicts with his mother’s wishes for him to have a traditional education. When his best friend, Dimitar, gets the opportunity to try out for Europe’s top eSports team, Dynasty, Martin eagerly embraces the chance to make his mark.
1637137.title: One More Game

1637319.synopsis: Filmed in front of a live studio audience and hosted by Alex Cooper of 'Call Her Daddy' fame, Miley Cyrus reflects on the creation and impact of the series with never-before-seen archival footage, all the while interacting and reminiscing on some of the show's most memorable sets 'brought back to life' — including the Stewart family living room and the legendary Hannah Montana closet.
1637319.title: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special

1637367.synopsis: Pushed beyond fear and silence, a woman kills the man who tried to exploit her and buries his body to escape her past. But when the police reopen the case, the grave is empty. With no body and too many secrets, suspicion deepens, truth blurs, and a haunting question remains, who moved the dead, and why?
1637367.title: Udd Da Teer

1637569.synopsis: KAT CRIME: TALES OF THE OCCULT follows Kat, the driven host of a struggling true-crime podcast, who drags her influencer friend Deana into a dangerous investigation involving a suspected witch coven accused of murder.
1637569.title: Kat Crime: Tales of the Occult

1637579.synopsis: A popular filmmaker sets out to make another movie when a filmmaking rival brings a curse upon the set. The cast soon become their characters and romance turns up in unusual places. Chaos is everywhere, battles erupt and it's a race against the clock to lift the love spell.
1637579.title: Love Spell

1637621.synopsis: Love, ambition and legacy collide under an unrelenting public spotlight throughout John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette's relationship and tragic deaths in the 1990s.
1637621.title: John and Carolyn: Love, Beauty and Loss

1637631.synopsis: The Grammy Award-winning British soul icon performs a celebratory concert at The Venetian in Las Vegas three decades after the release of his self-titled album Seal and eponymous follow up Seal II. Joined by longtime producer Trevor Horn, he performs a set highlighted by classic chart-topping anthems Crazy, Future Love Paradise, Killer and Kiss From a Rose, as well as a few surprises. Directed by Keirda Bahruth (Hardcore Devo) and with intimate interviews interspersed throughout, it’s a stunning film that shows this extraordinary artist at the top of his performance game.
1637631.title: Seal: Purpose

1638355.synopsis: An exploration of the caged heart, what happens when fear suffocates expression, and how  love unravels in silence as a result.
1638355.title: Fresco

1638677.synopsis: After the events of the first films, Rachel, the lone survivor of Aladdin, finds the lamp once more haunting her as she attends a therapy retreat. She must protect a new set of friends as the lamp's evil plan to grant three deadly wishes begins all over again.
1638677.title: Aladdin's Revenge

1638737.synopsis: They say never meet your heroes, how about never meet your friends heroes! An action hero from an old movie takes vengeance on punk teens.
1638737.title: Horny For Justice IV

1638741.synopsis: This documentary-drama film follows Lance Sgt. Haane Manahi DCM of B Company, 28th Māori Battalion, a soldier of extraordinary courage, whose actions proved pivotal in the 1943 battle for the fortified summit of Takrouna, Tunisia.
1638741.title: Man of Valor

1638841.synopsis: In the depths of despair, a young man travels to an empty beach in the hopes of reuniting with his lover, Maria, who inexplicably disappeared the year earlier.
1638841.title: The Ocean Washed Over Your Grave

1638927.synopsis: A grieving widower, resistant to his late wife's dog, slowly reconnects with the outside world through Tilly's persistent companionship.
1638927.title: Tilly

1638948.synopsis: Made miserable by the state of the world, two teenage lovers decide to skip school and spend the day at home together.
1638948.title: Slackadelia

1639000.synopsis: In this emotional interview, the late actor and ALS advocate Eric Dane shared his final message for the world — knowing it would not air until his death.
1639000.title: Famous Last Words: Eric Dane

1639341.synopsis: A recently separated man newly living alone discovers that he is sleepwalking at night, and as he records his activities, he discovers questionable behaviors and the presence of another mysterious figure.
1639341.title: Go to Sleep

163937.synopsis: Rainer’s landmark film is a meditation on ambivalence that plays with cliché and the conventions of soap opera while telling the story of a woman whose sexual dissatisfaction masks an enormous anger.
163937.title: Film About a Woman Who…

1639529.synopsis: Two bad girls at a private academy for wayward girls receive help from a mysterious inspirational teacher who helps reform them.
1639529.title: Bad Girl Sunday School

1639763.synopsis: A cunning but lazy man fakes his corrupt father's death to take over his police position, but chaos ensues when his father suddenly awakens from a coma.
1639763.title: Viyaah Kartaare Da

1639960.synopsis: On the day of Frankenstein’s Monster’s wedding, villagers riot and kill him. His bride escapes, vows revenge on the townsfolk responsible, and eventually resurrects the Monster – leading a trail of blood in her wake.
1639960.title: Frankenstein's Bride

1640165.synopsis: During a casual game of Scattergories, four friends discover that the most dangerous thing in the room isn't time, guns, or bad language- it's how well they know each other.
1640165.title: F**k Face

1640340.synopsis: Maa Jaye is a powerful Punjabi film that revolves around the deep bond of brotherhood. It tells the story of brothers bound by love, loyalty, and shared struggles, as they face life's challenges together. Rooted in emotions and family values, the film highlights sacrifice, responsibility, and the strength that comes from standing by one another through every test of time.
1640340.title: Bhootan Wala Khooh

1641315.synopsis: Drawn Back to Chennai by an Unexpected Call From His Former Lover, Dheeren Travels From Mumbai and Checks Into a Secluded Office Guest House. Soon After His Arrival, Disturbing and Inexplicable Events Begin to Unfold Within Its Walls. Night After Night, Dheeren is Plagued by Vivid Dreams—fragments of Memories That Eerily Mirror His Own Past and Unresolved Relationship.  As the Line Between Dreams and Reality Begins to Blur, Dheeren Realizes These Visions Are Not Random. Each Dream is a Clue, Slowly Pulling Him Toward a Buried Truth Connected to His Ex-lover’s Fate. Trapped Between Guilt, Fear, and the Supernatural, Dheeren Must Confront His Past to Uncover What Truly Happened to Her—before the Guest House Claims Him as Its Next Secret.
1641315.title: Fourth Floor

1641319.synopsis: Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero lead a rescue mission in Costa Verde when their friends are taken hostage.
1641319.title: Sniper: No Nation

1641817.synopsis: Mark Normand turns married life, fatherhood and hot-button topics into rapid-fire punchlines in this witty free-for-all where nothing is off limits.
1641817.title: Mark Normand: None Too Pleased

1641961.synopsis: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.
1641961.title: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom

1641962.synopsis: Magnus Carlsen, widely regarded as the greatest chess player of all time, is challenged by Hans Niemann, a rising star who capitalizes on the meteoric growth of online chess. Niemann’s ascension culminated in an epic, controversy-shrouded victory over Carlsen at the 2022 Sinquefield Cup, which eventually led to allegations and revelations of cheating. Determined to clear his name, Niemann fights his way back to the top of the chess world, setting the stage for a high-stakes rematch with Carlsen in 2024.
1641962.title: Untold: Chess Mates

1641965.synopsis: Volatile players. Criminal charges. National headlines. Portland's championship-caliber NBA team implodes spectacularly in this unflinching documentary.
1641965.title: Untold: Jail Blazers

1641966.synopsis: A retired Olympic equestrian takes on a new dressage student at his idyllic farm in New Jersey. Over time, tensions mount between the two, leading to 911 calls, cryptic social media posts, and accusations of spying. The feud culminates in a shocking act of violence and a trial that rocked the prestigious and sophisticated world of dressage.
1641966.title: Untold: The Shooting at Hawthorne Hill

1642375.synopsis: Two sisters, Silvia and Susanna, are divided by a deep conflict. Susanna, considered unstable but convinced of her own clarity, accuses Silvia of having an incestuous relationship with their father, shattering the family's balance. Her provocative and violent actions make her socially dangerous and force her to disappear. Meanwhile, her accusations contaminate everyone's relationships, leaving behind an ambiguous reality in which the truth appears painful and uncertain.
1642375.title: Horror Vacui

1642463.synopsis: World-renowned motivational speaker and author Tony Robbins sits down with superstar, Jon Bon Jovi. Enjoy this intimate conversation between friends with exclusive performances from Bon Jovi.
1642463.title: Bon Jovi Forever: A Tony Robbins Special

1642619.synopsis: When a boy from a broken home steals a peach from his neighbour's tree, he sets off a clash that will change him forever.
1642619.title: Pītiti

1642650.synopsis: A disillusioned Iraq War veteran is framed for a murder by a beautiful social media influencer. He must track down the only person who can testify on his behalf: a former sex worker on the run from a murderous gangster.
1642650.title: East Bay Confidential

1642859.synopsis: With unprecedented access to the official archives and intimate recollections from the band, both current and past,  Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition invites fans to experience one of the most iconic journeys in music history.  Spanning five decades, this electrifying documentary charts the band’s rise from the pubs of East London to the world’s biggest stadiums. Featuring exclusive interviews with band members and contributors such as Javier Bardem, Lars Ulrich and Chuck D, as well as all-new animated sequences of the band's legendary mascot, Eddie, the film offers a rare and intimate look at Iron Maiden’s uncompromising vision and unwavering connection with their truly global army of fans.
1642859.title: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition

1643111.synopsis: A group of students and teachers from The Delhi College of Linguistics hit the road to discover Australia and gain first-hand experience of its authentic language and culture. When their plane is diverted to the country town of Dubbo due to storms, and their tour-leader is detained by customs, the hapless bunch unearth the 'real' Australia while never making it to Sydney, Melbourne...or even Brisbane.
1643111.title: How to Talk Australians: The Movie

1643294.synopsis: Four estranged friends reunite on a fishing trip, but a missing child and a desperate father's accusation turn reunion into a deadly reckoning
1643294.title: Refuge

1643354.synopsis: Live It Up is a feature documentary celebrating Mental as Anything, the art-school band whose irreverent humour, visual art and clever pop songs made them one of Australia's most distinctive cultural forces. Following the release of Nips Are Getting Bigger in 1979, the Mentals rose quickly from inner-city Sydney pubs to national fame, becoming masters at capturing Australian suburban life with warmth, wit and playfulness. While success came fast, they never treated it with reverence. Funny, warm and unexpectedly moving, Live It Up explores how Mental as Anything navigated fame, longevity and the pressures of the music industry while holding fast to their humour and creative spirit - revealing why their music continues to resonate today.
1643354.title: Live It Up: The Mental As Anything Story

1643466.synopsis: In the spring of 2013, 31-year-old mother of two, Joanne Dennehy, embarked on a murderous rampage that would leave 3 men dead and 2 others fighting for their lives. She was only the third woman in the UK to ever be handed a whole life sentence; joining Myra Hindley and Rose West as one of the most notorious British female serial killers of all time.
1643466.title: Confessions of a Female Serial Killer

1643729.synopsis: Starring the sensational Gurnam Bhullar alongside the stunning Isha Malviya, this Punjabi cinema is crafted for every soul that has ever loved deeply. Directed by the talented Manvir Brar, Ishqa'n De Lekhe is set to redefine Punjabi romance on the big screen.
1643729.title: Ishqa'n De Lekhe

1644528.synopsis: Two friends facing homelessness resort to sabotage at a rental inspection.
1644528.title: Shoebox

1644575.synopsis: It is a story of an aged photographer Sansar Nath who gets entangled in the crisis of two young couples. He is unable to cope up with the changing times. Now he must accept the truth or fight for deliverance in his solitude.
1644575.title: Click Ceremony

1644796.synopsis: An intimate look into the lives of ravens reveals their intelligence, emotions, & social bonds thru play, communication, & connection. It follows a couple of ravens as they raise their young.
1644796.title: What Ravens Do

1644807.synopsis: In a special one off concert in Manchester, recorded on the evening of March 6, Harry Styles played his new album, ‘Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.' for the very first time.
1644807.title: Harry Styles. One Night in Manchester.

1645570.synopsis: Daska goes on an epic adventure across the galaxy in search of the mythical golden microphone, to record the greatest podcast episode of all time.
1645570.title: The Daska Discusses Movie

1645807.synopsis: 35 Days is an experimental, stop motion animation about what happens when a coalition of strangers answers the call to locate a missing cat during the pandemic lockdown of 2020.
1645807.title: 35 Days

1645890.synopsis: Fittest on Earth: 2025” is a bold, emotional exploration of the world’s fittest athletes and the sport that reshaped their lives. Through raw interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, and vulnerable reflections, 2025 Games athletes open up about the sacrifices, the breakthroughs, and the moments that nearly broke them — and why they keep coming back. On the women’s side, Tia-Clair Toomey chases her eighth title while the men battle in one of the most competitive fields we’ve ever seen.
1645890.title: Fittest on Earth: 2025

1646115.synopsis: After her family is murdered, a champion swimmer infiltrates the killer's home-ready to drown his world in vengeance.
1646115.title: Deep Dive

1646116.synopsis: Jevan moves her family into her late mother's home, only to discover her mother, Iris, a genetic scientist, created a deadly raptor that's now on the loose. As the creature hunts them, Jevan and her family must fight to survive and find a way to stop the ultimate predator.
1646116.title: Raptor Attack

1646122.synopsis: One year on from the disappearance of their friend, a close-knit group of friends reunite to pay their respects at the site of her disappearance. Little realizing that their friend was actually the victim of a terrifying beast known as the Ice Demon and they're next.
1646122.title: The Snow Demon

1646124.synopsis: A bachelorette party in the woods becomes a fight for survival when a Bengal tiger escapes the zoo during a storm. Trapped without phone service or escape routes, the women must outwit the predator stalking their cabin.
1646124.title: Tiger's Rampage

1646341.synopsis: Through years of heartbreak and resilience, Rory McIlroy's pursuit of the Green Jacket at the Masters becomes a reckoning with legacy and the final step toward completing golf's rarest achievement, the career Grand Slam.
1646341.title: Rory McIlroy: The Masters Wait

1646594.synopsis: The next chapter in human-initiated extraterrestrial contact is coming.  Dr. Steven Greer embarks on a journey with a small group of people exploring consciousness and peaceful, human-initiated extraterrestrial contact - CE5.
1646594.title: CE5: The New Frontier of Contact

1646730.synopsis: The boundaries between reality, memories and dreams are temporarily dissolved in order to parallel the film-maker’s internal sense of liminality as a ‘hāfu’ (half-Japanese, half-Australian). Drawing on Japanese folklore, memories of the past, and contemporary anxieties, the narrator journeys across her father’s hometown of Sōma, Fukushima, in search of a language that can temporarily capture such liminal entities, including herself.
1646730.title: Glossary of an Empty Orchestra

1646766.synopsis: When a routine call leads to the betrayal of a ruthless dealer, a hilariously depressed criminal helpline operator tries to escape his reality before he becomes the next body to be buried.
1646766.title: Criminal Helpline

1646950.synopsis: After mysteriously inheriting her parents house, a lifelong orphan finds a camcorder and a collection of video tapes containing the gruesome secrets of her family's past, and the horrifying truth behind the camcorder they were captured on.
1646950.title: Capture

1647068.synopsis: On 1 October 2017, during the Catalan independence referendum, Marta Torrecillas was violently dragged from a polling station by police. Her image and voice message went viral within hours, turning her into an international symbol of state violence. Days later, when medical reports contradicted her initial belief that her fingers were broken, she became the target of a brutal media backlash. Harassed, threatened and diagnosed with PTSD, Marta fights to reclaim her name and dignity. An intimate reflection on sisterhood, care and healing in the aftermath of public violence. Refusing to let a viral image define her, Marta’s story becomes a moving exploration of resilience, solidarity and the urgent need for truth and accountability in the digital age.
1647068.title: Rebel

1647153.synopsis: Six contestants compete in a high-stakes live TV quiz show to solve a complex "closed-circle" murder mystery for a 10 billion yen jackpot.
1647153.title: MYSTERY ARENA

1647508.synopsis: Hunted by an AI-controlled regime, a rogue soldier hiding in the forest must outfight elite assassins, cybernetic soldiers, and corrupted machines to stop an artificial intelligence from seizing total control of America.
1647508.title: Winter: Battleground

1647512.synopsis: A true crime podcaster becomes the target of a dangerous 'long-time listener'.
1647512.title: Long Time Listener

1647555.synopsis: When the planet Mercury is swallowed up by the Sun’s gravitational pull, a team aboard the Interplanetary Space Station, including a suspicious Martian scientist, must race to reverse the effect before Venus, and even Earth, are destroyed forever.
1647555.title: The Last Hail Mary

1647632.synopsis: "The Power of Pickleball" tells the story of a humble game that spread into a cultural phenomenon by bringing people together across generations, backgrounds, and walks of life. Centered on the passionate individuals who helped build the sport from the ground up, the film celebrates pickleball's unique ability to create community, spark joy, and change lives in unexpected ways.
1647632.title: The Power of Pickleball

1647712.synopsis: Shesha 2016 is a gripping crime thriller set over one chaotic night at a remote police station on the Karnataka-Kerala border. When an abusive officer is brutally murdered, a lone female cop gets trapped in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a cryptic caller. It’s a gritty, fast-paced watch filled with intense suspense and dark secrets.
1647712.title: Shesha 2016

1647934.synopsis: Born in the creative heart of 1980s and 90s Bologna, Kinki was Italy's first LGBTQ+ club: a visionary space where house music exploded and the night became a realm of freedom, identity, and cultural revolution. Through the voices of the DJs and charismatic figures who led it, this documentary tells the story of how a small club beneath the Two Towers changed music and clubbing culture forever.
1647934.title: Kinki - The Secrets of the Dancefloor

1648102.synopsis: A grieving scientist enlists the help of a goofy handyman to fix a special machine that will allow him to say goodbye.
1648102.title: The Handyman

1648398.synopsis: A family of three faces a crisis where the father has to ignore the law for his daughter's happiness.
1648398.title: The Summer That Snowed

1648678.synopsis: Narrated by Josh Gad, journey high into the rainforest canopy of Southeast Asia where a magnificent and mysterious community filled with playful personalities lives. Witness the exhilarating action, heartwarming encounters, and a closeup look at a stunning jungle teeming with wildlife as the inquisitive adolescent orangutan Indah prepares to leave her family and venture out on her own for the first time.
1648678.title: Orangutan

1649125.synopsis: Three middle school kids suspect their bus driver neighbor is behind a string of child disappearances. As they investigate, they uncover dark rituals and a sinister force hiding in plain sight—right next door.
1649125.title: My Neighbor is a Witch

1649176.synopsis: A village located in the Thiruvannamalai district has followed a belief for over 200 years. If a woman in the village becomes pregnant, it is customary to cook Pongal and sacrifice a goat to their family deity, which is located in the middle of a large forest nearby.  Now the heroine of the story is nine months pregnant. As per the tradition, the family travels to the temple. However, the forest area surrounding the temple is known for many anti-social activities.  What happens to the family that goes to this mysterious place? Why is the temple located deep inside the forest?
1649176.title: Kolaiseval

1649249.synopsis: Stroup dives into his experience being a '90s kid in rural Alabama and everything that came along with it.
1649249.title: Derrick Stroup: Nostalgic

1649529.synopsis: When a down on his luck hipster buys an old hearse with the hopes of converting it into a limousine service, he soon finds out that there's a lot more to the hearse than he bargained for .
1649529.title: Cursed Hearse

1649550.synopsis: Work obsessed entrepreneur Roy Walker must rebuild his fractured relationship when his estranged daughter arrives at his secluded beach condo one Father's Day, forcing them both to confront past mistakes and rediscover what truly matters.
1649550.title: Call Me When You Can: A Father's Day Story

1649758.synopsis: Follow the untold story of the 47-year old legacy of the McDonald's All American Game and the past, present and future stars that defined it.
1649758.title: Meal Ticket

1649831.synopsis: A mother haunted by trauma becomes overprotective of her daughter, but when the daughter falls in love, their bond fractures. As buried secrets emerge, both must confront whether forgiveness can heal old wounds before it's too late.
1649831.title: Living in the Cemetery

1649887.synopsis: Shirin David. Babsi. Barbara. Meet the woman behind the rap star as she balances fame, business and her identity in this intimate, emotional documentary.
1649887.title: Barbara - Becoming Shirin David

1650027.synopsis: A young waitress is abducted by a religious cult, who are hell-bent on curing her from a sexually transmitted werewolf virus or killing her in the process. She must escape before the first full moon.
1650027.title: First Moon

1650175.synopsis: Singer Lorelai's father suffers a heart attack and is placed on VR life support. She enters his virtual reality to revive him through shared memories, but becomes trapped in an Old Western VR world.
1650175.title: Goldmine

1650181.synopsis: Chaali Din is an adaption of best selling punjabi novel of the same name. This gripping story by Gurpreet Dhugga delves into the complexities of human emotions and relationships over a transformative 40-day journey. The book explores themes of love, loss, redemption, and self-discovery through vivid storytelling and well-drawn characters. With its gripping narrative and profound insights, this work captures the essence of life’s challenges and triumphs.
1650181.title: Chaali Din

1650276.synopsis: Holly arrives at church to pray for protection.  However, is greeted with an entity that craves her innocence.
1650276.title: Holly

1650789.synopsis: The Story of Everything is a cinematic exploration of the cosmos that reveals the hidden hand behind our universe. From the precise laws that govern the stars to the intricate patterns found in every living cell, the film traces evidence of intentional design throughout nature. Whether examining distant star-forming clouds or the spiral structure of DNA, we discover a consistent signature woven into the fabric of existence.
1650789.title: The Story of Everything

1650939.synopsis: Nimmi, a clever young woman, transforms her father's death into an unusual business running virtual funerals for NRIs. With her ragtag crew, she orchestrates chaotic send-offs until NRI Mickey arrives, sparking hilarious chaos and romance.
1650939.title: Pitt Siyapa

1651148.synopsis: In a future dominated by digital corporations, Maya is a cyborg who offers alternative identities in the virtual afterlife. When she breaks the rules by granting freedom to her clients, she becomes a threat and is hunted down. On the run and searching for her lost daughter, she travels through artificial worlds and rebel communities, discovering that even digital paradise is ruled by control.
1651148.title: Zero Existence

1651233.synopsis: José Sánchez has big ambitions, terrible instincts, and a mustache to match. After a string of bad deals, he accidentally bluffs his way into becoming El Serpiente, a political boss feared for all the wrong reasons. Now he must pull off one final deal to stay alive — a deal far beyond anything he can fake.
1651233.title: Son-in-Law

1651933.synopsis: Step inside the remarkable journey of The Beatles, the band that reshaped music and revolutionised culture in the 20th century. From their early days in Liverpool and the raw energy of The Cavern Club, to their meteoric rise in the 1960s and the frenzy of Beatlemania, the film explores how four young men-John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison, and Ringo Starr-captivated the world. Featuring archival footage, interviews, and timeless performances, it highlights their groundbreaking approach to songwriting, recording, and artistic experimentation that pushed the boundaries of rock and roll. Beyond the music, the film examines the personal challenges, creative tensions, and cultural shifts that shaped their journey, from the heights of fame to their eventual breakup. Ultimately, this is not only the story of a band, but of a movement that left an indelible mark on music, art, and society-one that still resonates across generations today.
1651933.title: The Beatles: The Sound of a Revolution

1652270.synopsis: A young woman promises to take her suicidal best friend to an alternative retreat but when their volatile mutual friend joins the trip, an unexpected detour to a local commune forces all three to confront some painful truths.
1652270.title: Everything Grows in Eden

1652457.synopsis: In this gripping romantic thriller, a desperate young couple, suffocated by their rigid lives, risk everything on a daring diamond heist that promises freedom and a fresh start.  But as their plan spins out of control and trust between them erodes, they're forced to confront a harsh reality: can love endure betrayal, violence, and fear, or was their dream of escape doomed from the very beginning?  When the stakes are life and death, the line between passion and destruction blurs beyond recognition.
1652457.title: Diamond Sky

1652602.synopsis: A tale of human connection, hope and resilience in the face of great tragedy, Under a Bamboo Sky uses new technology to bring to life an untold story of Australian soldiers held prisoner by the Japanese in WWII. Using their own words, their own voices, the film weaves the recollections of more than 60 former POWs with newly colourised archival material and new location footage to deliver a moving and revelatory first-hand account of their experience. Captured during the Japanese offensive and imprisoned in Singapore’s Changi Barracks, the film follows the years long journey of these soldiers through four countries. After bearing witness to some of WWII’s most history-defining events, they tell of returning home to families, wives and sweethearts, and of the price they paid for the trauma they endured. Shining through the horrors of war is the spirit of these men and an inspiring human capacity to find beauty in their surroundings and hold onto hope in the worst of circumstances.
1652602.title: Under a Bamboo Sky

1653169.synopsis: A detailed, minute-by-minute account of the Columbine High School shooting, exploring how the attack unfolded, the actions of the shooters, the responses of students, teachers, and law enforcement, and the critical moments that defined the tragedy. This documentary examines the timeline, decisions, and chaos that made it one of the deadliest school shootings in U.S. history.
1653169.title: Columbine Shooting: Minute by Minute

1653281.synopsis: Far from home, a young Burmese man struggles to escape the weight of a brutal and unforgiving military coup, threatening both his nation’s freedom and its very survival. Now, in Australia and unable to return home, he’s doing everything he can to stay connected to his people.
1653281.title: Shadow of Hope

1653299.synopsis: A sleeping mother looks after a decaying house. As we move through each room, we are met with new objects and new friends, off screen. She is scrolling through Agoda to find the best hotel.
1653299.title: Agoda Asleep at Home

1653300.synopsis: Round and round we go through the historic city. Shot on Super 8, Bolognaonga utilises hyperlapses to highlight the unique architecture and patterns formed throughout the historic city of Bologna.
1653300.title: Bolognaogna

1653302.synopsis: Two friends discuss and improvise repeated movements for the camera
1653302.title: Cradle & Step

1653303.synopsis: "Like the doctors before them, poets and philosophers failed to find a precise location for nostalgia...a metaphorical journey seemed like a homeopathic treatment for human longing...". – Svetlana Boym, The Future of Nostalgia
1653303.title: Heimþrá eða Nostalgía

1653304.synopsis: Looking at the present, as though the far future were dreaming of its ancient past – an 'iconogenic' vision of Australia.
1653304.title: Kata Tjuṯa, West of Uluru

1653305.synopsis: A 16mm film informed by the expansive nature of queer relationships and bodily autonomy. This film was processed by a plant-based developer and the sage used was grown in my garden.
1653305.title: Mistake Me for Anybody

1653306.synopsis: It is hard enough arriving without time, let alone to understand somewhere with somewhere else in mind; life as landscape passing from the back of a moving car. Shot over a single afternoon on the Isle of Mull, Scotland.
1653306.title: Passing Place

1653349.synopsis: Alice and Jack are at a rest stop on their way to a new city when they realise they've left something important back home. Jack heads back to get it and Alice is left at the rest stop alone where she is forced to face her fears about moving
1653349.title: Soft Tread

1653434.synopsis: A vigilante satellite hijacker takes justice into their own hands, kidnapping paroled rapists and broadcasting their execution live on TV. The mission? To deliver a powerful message: rape will not be tolerated.
1653434.title: Justice

1653435.synopsis: ONE OK ROCK DETOX JAPAN TOUR 2025 AT NISSAN STADIUM IN CINEMAS unleashes the raw pulse of a career-defining night—documenting the band's commanding takeover of Japan's iconic Nissan Stadium—where thunderous riffs, soaring vocals, and 70,000 voices collide into something electric, forging an unbreakable bond between the band and their worldwide legion of fans.
1653435.title: ONE OK ROCK DETOX JAPAN TOUR AT NISSAN STADIUM 2025 IN CINEMAS

1653580.synopsis: In Mike Marino: Back 2 School, NJ's Bad Boy of Comedy returns to Scotch Plains-Fanwood High School for a live stand-up special. Nostalgic Jersey stories, Italian-American humor, and high-school throwbacks in a heartfelt homecoming.
1653580.title: Mike Marino: Back 2 School

1653922.synopsis: When an alien visitor discovers it can communicate with Earth’s oceans, it becomes the only intermediary between humanity and a vast marine intelligence whose patience with the human race is running out.  Part survey, part discovery, the film explores a stretch of the wilderness that has largely slipped through the cracks of human attention, and in some places, bears the marks of human failure.  The alien encounters a force both beautiful and terrifying, a voice as old as the planet itself, carrying memories, warnings and a power beyond human control.  The film is a parable about nature on Earth by establishing an unidentified alien as interacting with the planet.  By way of subtle messages the sea warns the alien that the existence of the planet is at stake.  The alien discovers a controlling city but does not interfere with it and hopes that the sea will find a way to survive.
1653922.title: London's Last Wilderness

1654056.synopsis: A young man, born and raised in the vastness of the galaxy, lands on an unknown planet. As he surveys the landscape, he recognises fragments from ancient stories. Driven by a quiet urgency, he contacts his ship’s command to retrieve archival recordings of the last humans to abandon earth. Slowly, it dawns on him that he has returned to his ancestral home.
1654056.title: Earth

1654069.synopsis: In this comedy special, Alex Calleja shares his unflinching observations about his family, personal failures and the oddities of life in the Philippines.
1654069.title: Past Is Past

1654363.synopsis: The woman of Carter Morgan's dreams is his childhood friend's mother, Lisa Chase. When Carter finds out she's gotten divorced, he decides to go for it despite the obstacles that are placed in their way.
1654363.title: Wait List: A Love-ish Story

1654599.synopsis: Gene Spriggs forms the Twelve Tribes in Tennessee with teens and disenchanted hippies; the group later gains a cult reputation and faces accusations of child abuse, forced labor, and strict devotion to what members say is God's will.
1654599.title: People Magazine Investigates: The Secrets of the Twelve Tribes Cult

1654677.synopsis: A young woman is hired by a finance couple to tutor their son at their summer lake house, and finds herself increasingly enmeshed in the undisclosed darkness of their past.
1654677.title: Your Lips Never Left Mine

1654683.synopsis: Louise Monroe has been groomed from childhood to manipulate men. She discovers that her entire life has been controlled by her aunt, forcing her to untangle a web of lies, betrayal, and buried trauma before her own Karma comes for her.
1654683.title: Sharlotte's Web

1654730.synopsis: Qashmou’, a young man from a humble Saudi neighbourhood, constantly stirs up trouble, dragging others into it. But everything changes for him—and for those around him—when he moves to Riyadh to work for a wealthy family.
1654730.title: Qashmoo

1654922.synopsis: In a scorched, post-apocalyptic world, survival is fragile and trust is dangerous. When a hardened loner discovers a naive man with the mind of a child, the two form an uneasy alliance, their journey colliding with a sinister school where the once students (now adults) are still ruled by the authority figures of the past. Fear, secrets, and the threats prevent them from exploring whats beyond their gated community.
1654922.title: Last Save Point

1654947.synopsis: Brian Espinosa is a young, troubled man who has had more than his share of police contact. When his longtime girlfriend, Melody, overdoses, Brian enlists the help of his best friend, Sarah. When Sarah arrives, Melody has miraculously returned, yet she is not quite herself. Detectives Madsen and Slater are en route to apprehend Brian on a criminal warrant.
1654947.title: Flux

1654965.synopsis: Jack Folly is a smart, grumpy, unemployed A.I. programmer. When his girlfriend prods him to start pulling his weight financially, he makes a desperate stock market gamble using his new A.I. program "Babylon." But the play backfires, costing Jack his money, his relationship, and his sanity.
1654965.title: The Game of Life

1655021.synopsis: Chronicles the life of the legendary Tennessee Lady Vols basketball coach.
1655021.title: Breaking Glass: The Pat Summitt Story

1655394.synopsis: Pig Earth traces a sequence of conditions through which consciousness emerges, organises, and ultimately fractures under its own weight. It follows the slow organisation of mind from instinct into structure, from structure into consciousness, only for this awareness to rupture, turning back upon the organism that hosts it. If evolution tends toward efficiency, then consciousness appears excessive. If it tends toward survival, then consciousness appears compromised. The conscious animal becomes the animal that hesitates, the animal that suffers its own awareness, the animal for whom existence is no longer given but must be continually reckoned with. In this sense, consciousness may be less a culmination than a misstep: not the enlightenment of the organism, but its undoing.
1655394.title: Pig Earth

1655499.synopsis: Snakes and Surf Breaks follows a daring and amateur team’s 3 month expedition across the Indonesian archipelago in search of a Cobra.
1655499.title: Snakes and Surf Breaks

1655816.synopsis: On the day she plans to leave Cebu for America, a glamorous and outspoken young woman obsessed with Western beauty ideals sees her dream of reinvention unravel through family pressures, public humiliation, and romantic betrayal—forcing her to choose between fleeing her past or embracing the roots and identity she once tried to erase.
1655816.title: TISAY!

1655847.synopsis: You may never have heard of her, but she is an icon in the underground world of wrestling in Sydney, Australia. Fierce, alive, electric: her shows are part acrobatics and part insult comedy. She's never met a battle she can't face. But now, after 8 years of wrestling, things have shifted. As she prepares for the match she reflects on wrestling, sexism, gender and her future in the industry. What does it mean to be a Heel in a world that already villainises your identity?
1655847.title: Heel Turn

1656014.synopsis: Washington State follows investigator David Paulides as he examines a series of unexplained disappearances in and around Mount Rainier and Olympic National Park, where hikers, climbers, and experienced outdoorsmen vanish without tracks, scent trails, or clear cause. Through interviews with families, witnesses, and search personnel the film contrasts known environmental dangers - severe weather, terrain, and hypothermia - with unsettling anomalies. Some of these include aircraft debris fields, unusual patterns in search failures, eyewitness encounters, and reported aerial phenomena dating back to the 1946 Curtis Commando crash and the dawn of the modern UFO era. As grief-stricken families search for closure and investigators compare evidence against established "profile points," the documentary challenges viewers to consider whether these cases can be explained by nature alone - or if something unknown operates within the wilderness.
1656014.title: Missing 411 National Parks: Washington State

1656061.synopsis: History's greatest warriors, including Genghis Khan and Joan of Arc, are summoned by a shadowy organization to fight in a battle to the death. But unknown to their captors, the fighters have been plotting to turn the tables and dismantle the deadly enterprise from within.
1656061.title: Immortal Combat

1656220.synopsis: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.
1656220.title: 23 000 Lives

1656344.synopsis: A man becomes transfixed by a hypnotic mobile phone commercial, leading him to uncover a hidden message.
1656344.title: A Telephone

1656346.synopsis: Dr Jeni Haynes lives with Dissociative Identity Disorder, her memories held by 2,500 alternate selves. When she seeks justice for childhood abuse, a decade-long investigation asks whether fractured testimony can be believed, or whether her condition preserved the truth needed to make legal history, with police, psychiatry and the judiciary aligned together.
1656346.title: We Are Jeni

1656625.synopsis: After a chance encounter with a circus magician, the Famous Five set off to find the mysterious Eye of the Sunrise and keep it from falling into the wrong hands.
1656625.title: The Eye of the Sunrise

1656632.synopsis: He built dynasties, broke barriers, and became the silhouette that defines the game. But beneath Jerry West's legendary NBA legacy was a man haunted by perfection and pain. Through rare interviews with family and basketball icons, uncover the complex truth behind The Logo.
1656632.title: Jerry West: The Logo

1656865.synopsis: Dance for Your Life is a powerful testament to the transformative power of dance, where every leap is a story, every setback a lesson, and every moment a chance to be seen.
1656865.title: Dance For Your Life

1656990.synopsis: Luhvers make it out the gc
1656990.title: Year of the Horse

1657008.synopsis: Real-estate mogul Christopher Gates becomes homeless after losing his family, only to discover the sinister connection to their deaths.
1657008.title: Mister Gates

1657240.synopsis: Larry Booth, St Kilda’s underground kingpin hires a team of nine individuals. A chef, a butcher, a hacker, James Murphy, a jetski rider, Vincent, Fingers, Smokey and Larry’s son, Gavin… What’s the job?
1657240.title: A Random Act of Violence

1657367.synopsis: In 1987, Isabelle perceives the invisible-a mysterious gift she eventually embraces.
1657367.title: Beyond the Veil: Paranormal Exploration

1657463.synopsis: The courageous journey of a determined disabled advocate living with a tethered spinal cord and chronic pain, while balancing love, legacy and the fight for bodily autonomy as she chooses how she wants to leave the world: on her own terms.
1657463.title: The Last Days of April

1657464.synopsis: Three robbers with strange names seize an ordinary bank in Punjab. No demands. No ransom. Just cryptic riddles sent to the cops, each one leading deeper into the mystery.
1657464.title: The Great Punjab Robbery

1657502.synopsis: In his third HBO special, Ramy Youssef approaches a vast spectrum of personal topics, including marriage, AI, and being a dog parent.
1657502.title: Ramy Youssef: In Love

1657578.synopsis: When a wannabe running influencer's career is interrupted by an insidious call to something greater, he loses himself to curiosity and ambition.
1657578.title: I LOVE TO RUN

1658057.synopsis: Through POV storytelling, Parasomnia follows a data analyst in the 90s whose solitary lifestyle has been derailed by sleep paralysis and constant nightmares. As the nightmares escalate it becomes clear that something is watching – and it's getting closer.
1658057.title: Parasomnia

1658163.synopsis: A young Foley artist has grown up hearing a mysterious voice called Suyodhana and often visualises a figure resembling Duryodhana. Raised by his mother and supported by his childhood friend and partner, his life takes a turn when he is accused of his father’s murder, leading to an investigation that uncovers deeper layers of his past.
1658163.title: Suyodhana

1658175.synopsis: Caught between his parents’ academic expectations and his grandfather’s devotion to kung fu, young Liang Ruicheng loses his confidence after a youth martial arts competition costs his family a treasured jade heirloom, sending tensions soaring. At his lowest point, Ruicheng discovers how kung fu shaped three generations of his family and finds the strength to forge his own path forward.
1658175.title: Kung Fu Juniors

1658220.synopsis: A man desperate to capture a traffic accident on his new dashcam accidentally unleashes a car crash day in his personal life.
1658220.title: Dashcamera Obscura

1658368.synopsis: “UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun” follows the world-renowned classical Chinese dance company Shen Yun Performing Arts as it rises to global acclaim while facing intimidation and threats of violence. Through the eyes of two brothers and their fellow performers, the film traces an unlikely journey—from ordinary American childhoods to the world’s most prestigious stages—where rigorous artistic training and spiritual conviction shape both their craft and their character.  As Shen Yun tours internationally, the company becomes the target of escalating smear campaigns, threats, and alleged interference linked to the Chinese Communist Party. Blending personal storytelling with investigative reporting, “UNBROKEN” reveals what happens when art, faith, and freedom collide with totalitarianism power—and how resilience, community, and cultural revival endure in the face of intimidation.
1658368.title: UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun

1658568.synopsis: A cunning young girl attempts to rob the tooth fairy to help her struggling single mum, but the tooth fairy turns out to be a twisted nightmare version of the fabled sprite, and she won't be so easily fooled.
1658568.title: Baby Teeth

1658580.synopsis: When an incomplete artwork opens up a gateway into an alternate reality, an artist is forced to confront her own artistic process and life choices.
1658580.title: Freestyle

1658635.synopsis: After losing love, Panchi finds love through a voice on the same phone number, until truth, crime, and blood ties pull him into a dark spiral of fate.
1658635.title: Panchhi 2

1658653.synopsis: On the morning of the winter solstice, Tang Yu's son disappeared in the stairwell; gambler Yuan Wu hid his father's body; and two unsolved cases involving the assault.
1658653.title: Vanishing Point

1658678.synopsis: Roy and Tina enjoy a picture-perfect life together-until it begins to unravel into an unsettling loop of twists and deception. As the boundaries of their reality shift, the ultimate truth proves to be more chilling than they ever imagined.
1658678.title: Grahanam 2.0

1658896.synopsis: Five haunting visions of the future collide in this gripping sci-fi anthology where technology spirals out of control, society begins to collapse, and humanity is pushed to its limits.
1658896.title: Breach

1658982.synopsis: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.
1658982.title: The Roast of Kevin Hart

1659087.synopsis: When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

1659155.synopsis: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.
1659155.title: The Truthers

1659169.synopsis: Investigative journalist Jeremy Corbell emerges as a key figure in a dangerous fight to uncover the truth about UAPs, driven by rare access and knowledge few possess. As his pursuit deepens, so do the risks of exposing what was never meant to be seen.
1659169.title: Sleeping Dog

1659193.synopsis: Two stories intertwine at the moment life changes forever. Between diagnoses, farewells, therapy sessions and new opportunities, four people discover that love doesn't always come when we expect it… but it always comes when we need it.
1659193.title: Instant

1659239.synopsis: Love doesn’t break all at once. Nine standalone stories catch it in the moment of fracture, from a bedroom argument to cross-border espionage, from quiet grief to genre worlds, and in the long, stubborn work of finding our way back.
1659239.title: Love Love: Fractures

1659249.synopsis: Bad behavior travels from the bedroom to the classroom to the beach in these six short films from Spain, France, Germany, Australia and Afghanistan that follow wayward boys and men for whom mischief and sexuality go hand in hand.
1659249.title: The Male Gaze: Naughty Boys

1659386.synopsis: Jimmy, an American Bhutanese food anthropology student, returns to Bhutan after 20 years to heal his fractured family through food, uncovering secrets that bring reconciliation, love, and renewed bonds between his mother, step-sister, and extended family.
1659386.title: With Love From Bhutan

1659389.synopsis: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.
1659389.title: One Piece Heroines

1659643.synopsis: The Bog crew is back on the hunt for another deadly cryptid in the dark Northeast Forrest. The BCU continues to expand their ever growing world of mysterious cryptids and urban legends with a new investigation into the elusive "Rake"!!!!!.
1659643.title: The Rake Investigation

1659670.synopsis: In a system corrupted by politics, greed and sex, there's an honest man in Buffalo who's made it his life's mission to hold his peers accountable. Dean Alessi is an attorney in Buffalo's Lawyer Disciplinary Office who fights for justice, even as he battles his own personal demons. Dean took an oath to protect the public from bad lawyers, and is willing to risk everything to keep that sacred promise. As the bodies pile up, Dean puts his own life on the line when he disobeys orders to expose a corrupt District Attorney who has committed the ultimate ethical wrong - murder.
1659670.title: One of the Good Ones

1659690.synopsis: A man admired for his integrity watches his perfect life unravel when an unexpected visitor shows up at his front door and forces him to confront the painful consequences of his past betrayal.
1659690.title: The Secret Between Us

1659806.synopsis: A group of paranormal hunters chase a lead for an urn holding an ancient spirit. In an abandoned warehouse, the group quickly realizes that what was supposed to be just another one of their videos, could end up having deadly consequences.
1659806.title: Rabisu: Curse of the Demon

1659902.synopsis: After the events of a pandemic, two boys finally leave on their road trip. But not everything goes as planned.
1659902.title: Boys Will Be Boys

1660153.synopsis: A successful atheist podcaster crosses paths with a devout Christian. Both share a love for science, but are unable to see eye to eye on matters of the heart. This intellectual film will interest both believer and non-believer alike.
1660153.title: Beauty and the Atheist

1660175.synopsis: Let's build a snowman! See World of Frozen at Disneyland Paris with the directors of "Frozen 3"!
1660175.title: Disney+ Insider World of Frozen

1660612.synopsis: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.
1660612.title: Wanda Sykes: Legacy

1660940.synopsis: A Gen Z couple meets via dating app. Their relationship unfolds with unexpected consequences.
1660940.title: Nee Forever

1661228.synopsis: An experimental essay film blending documentary and fiction, where women's voices turn a satiric eye on AI, agesim, and the absurdities of capitalism.
1661228.title: 4 or 5 things I want you to know about me (an essay)

1661439.synopsis: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.
1661439.title: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time

1661855.synopsis: A woman battles lifelong sleep paralysis while living alone. As nightly episodes worsen her mental state, paranormal investigators suggest her condition may have supernatural origins.
1661855.title: Night Terror

1662317.synopsis: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.
1662317.title: The Crash

1662414.synopsis: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime.
1662414.title: Propeller One-Way Night Coach

1662432.synopsis: Featuring interviews from members of the casting, production design, costume design, and creature effects teams, follow the behind-the-scenes journey of bringing the Harry Potter books to the small screen. Find out how the new Golden Trio were found, and celebrate the commitment to detail of the artists, craftspeople, and technicians who have come together to bring the wizarding world to life.
1662432.title: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic

1662437.synopsis: Eli Manning recruits NBA Superstar Donovan Mitchell to go undercover at a coaching clinic in Cleveland, Ohio. Mitchell goes from chiseled to grizzled as he transforms into Peanut Waterloo, a youth basketball coach with a lot to learn.
1662437.title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Donovan Mitchell

1662440.synopsis: On the night of their anniversary, Sarah is unexpectedly called into work but when a sudden zombie outbreak traps her inside, Brian must fight through the chaos to reach her before it's too late.
1662440.title: Bloodthirsty

1662599.synopsis: An Egyptologist in possession of a haunted Bride of the Dead amulet is the target of a tech billionaire who believes the ancient Egyptian mummy artifact holds forbidden magic that could awaken a deadly mummy curse and unlock eternal life.
1662599.title: Bride of the Dead

1662683.synopsis: From training camp to the final confetti fall, Super Bowl Champions: The 2025 Seattle Seahawks is the definitive, cinematic story of a team that soared above the odds, told with the style only NFL Films can deliver. Narrated by actor and Seahawks fan Jeffrey Dean Morgan, the 75-minute documentary looks back at Seattle's 2025 championship season through game broadcast footage, including extended highlights of their 29-13 victory over the New England Patriots in Super Bowl LX. The film also includes coverage from the championship parade, behind-the-scenes footage captured by the team, and the largest compilation of player and coach wired sound from throughout the season ever for an NFL Films championship documentary.
1662683.title: Super Bowl Champions: The 2025 Seattle Seahawks
