1662878.synopsis: Detective Burko goes undercover and infiltrates the Kyiv Cultural Center Spaska 13, where a concert, a podcast, and a party featuring three music bands — Renie Cares, Khliborob, and The Feels — are being prepared. What begins as a musical investigation turns into a warm and ironic immersion into Kyiv’s indie scene, offering an inside look that can be revisited and reinterpreted years later.
1662878.title: Snail Effect

1662958.synopsis: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.
1662958.title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous

1663625.synopsis: Enter Brisbane’s Theatre of Magic at Rydges Hotel and discover an evening where elegance meets illusion. Recently crowned a 2025 TripAdvisor “Travellers’ Choice” Award winner and ranked among the top 10% of experiences worldwide, this hidden theatre features world-class magicians, a spellbinding selection of food and drink, and award winning sleight-of-hand artists. Don’t miss out—get your tickets today for Brisbane’s Theatre of Magic!
1663625.title: Theatre of Magic

1664003.synopsis: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.
1664003.title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav

1664162.synopsis: Chloe Carhart, a paranormal influencer is sent a USB in the mail with four self-recorded tapes.  Curious and keen for the clicks, she embarks on a horrifying journey to discover the truth behind PORT, a shadowy government organisation who cover up supernatural events.
1664162.title: U/S/B

166426.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales

166428.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World

1664758.synopsis: Plunges into the Isle of Man TT, the world's most dangerous motorbike race, seen through a small team. With Francesco Curinga and Shaun Anderson, triumphs and disasters collide in a human drama and cinematic portrait of road-racing passion.
1664758.title: TT for Life

1664798.synopsis: The interior world of a sex doll is explored through their relationship to a new owner.
1664798.title: CUM DOLL The Movie

1664938.synopsis: A young woman with a painful past discovers her DNA holds the cure to cancer, instantly making her the most valuable secret on earth. As powerful interests close in, and her past haunts her, she must choose between her own safety and well-being, or risking everything to share her secret with the world.
1664938.title: Strand 45

1665061.synopsis: Follows comedian Patton Oswalt with new takes on parenting, living with a cat who sees ghosts, yard cleaning videos, artificial intelligence, and more.
1665061.title: Patton Oswalt: Tea & Scotch

1665163.synopsis: Peter and Ashley's online date escalates into a heated battle of the sexes. When Ashley storms out, Peter finds her being harassed and intervenes, unwittingly getting involved with corrupt cops, kidnapping, and stolen money.
1665163.title: The Lonely Crowd

1665224.synopsis: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.
1665224.title: Sheng Wang: Purple

1665429.synopsis: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.
1665429.title: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident

1665710.synopsis: He thought he found a place to stay rent free… but nothing in life is free.  Marcus, a smooth-talking hustler, moves in with Shay, a quiet therapist hiding a dark past. But when his plan to con her is exposed, he quickly realizes he’s not in control. Trapped inside her apartment, Marcus is forced into a twisted game where every move comes with consequences and escape may cost him everything.
1665710.title: Rent Free

1665724.synopsis: A high-energy action drama centered on strength, loyalty, and confrontation. The story unfolds through intense moments and gripping action as the protagonist faces powerful forces and personal challenges.
1665724.title: Shera

1665744.synopsis: For the last two decades, in the rural heartlands of Punjab, the elected leadership of a small village has done nothing to develop the community, instead engaging in corrupt and harmful practices. To save his home and combat pressing issues, Fateh steps up to take charge and run for the position of Sarpanch (village head), which forces him to confront intense opposition.
1665744.title: Sarpanch

1665770.synopsis: The story of one of the greatest live concerts ever filmed, with interviews with band members Jon Farriss and Kirk Pengilly, plus never-before-seen backstage moments.
1665770.title: INXS: Live At Wembley

1666433.synopsis: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.
1666433.title: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches

1667493.synopsis: Follows Brazil's journey to winning its fourth World Cup in 1994, featuring interviews with players and unseen behind-the-scenes footage from the tournament.
1667493.title: USA 94: Brazil's Return to Glory

1667906.synopsis: An Iranian and an American teenager connect online during Iran's "Woman, Life, Freedom" uprising. As tensions grow, their digital friendship becomes a lifeline-offering hope, empathy, and strength amid fear and social upheaval.
1667906.title: My Little Moon

1668117.synopsis: Aa Bata Aama is a heartfelt story set in a serene Nepali village, following a loving couple who are blessed with a son, Krishna, after years of hope and prayer. They raise him with deep care and big dreams, eventually making great sacrifices to send him abroad for better opportunities. As Krishna adapts to a new life, he becomes increasingly distant from his roots and family. Back home, his parents continue to cherish his memories and wait for his return. The film gently explores themes of love, sacrifice, ambition, and the emotional distance that can grow between family and dreams.
1668117.title: Aa Bata Aama

1668162.synopsis: Max Bourke (played by Max Bourke) tastes tea in his boost juice, and in an effort to find out why, he has to infiltrate British HQ.
1668162.title: The Spy Who Tasted Tea

1668239.synopsis: Details the plot to kidnap, rape and murder UK television presenter Holly Willoughby, and how it was intercepted by an undercover cop. Gavin Plumb, a 36-year-old security guard, was arrested after being detected by a cybercrime officer.
1668239.title: The Incel Celebrity Kidnap Plot

1668364.synopsis: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.
1668364.title: Desire

1668590.synopsis: The story about resilience of people living in the mountains of Nepal, navigating survival and hardship.
1668590.title: Pahaad

1668693.synopsis: James Cunningham's short film MONTSERRAT offers a poignant and introspective portrait of the Australian immigrant experience, encapsulated through the daily life of a solitary tradesman. Featuring a delicate performance by actor and model Wilson Bazurto, the film reveals the quiet existence of Montserrat, a young man whose life is marked by routine and loneliness. Wearing his ubiquitous yellow or orange hi-vis tradesman's uniforms like a shell of his identity, Montserrat's days blend into one another as he navigates mundane tasks in his mostly empty house. The film's observational cinematography captures a rare glimpse into the life of a man overlooked by society.
1668693.title: Montserrat

1668718.synopsis: Set against the gritty yet vibrant backdrop of Charm City, Baltimore Hustle is a powerful ensemble drama that captures the heartbeat of a city built on resilience, loyalty, and the unbreakable will to rise.
1668718.title: Baltimore Hustle

1668929.synopsis: Ana is a dedicated student who appears to be fine, but she faces constant pressure from school and expectations around her. Little by little, the exhaustion and difficulty in expressing herself begin to show, even if no one notices at first.  When the situation reaches its limit, a moment of listening within the school changes everything. The short film shows how young people’s mental health often goes unnoticed and how spaces for support can be the first step toward change.
1668929.title: Quando Ninguém Vê

1669135.synopsis: A group of Circuit Court Judges frustrated at the corrupt legal system are releasing criminals only to later kidnap and hunt them on a large estate.
1669135.title: Hunting Party

1669180.synopsis: A lonely Muay Thai instructor (Mark Bale) seeks self-confidence through an online life-coaching app, gradually surrendering control to an unseen mentor.
1669180.title: Life Coach

1669229.synopsis: Len Zuks, the unlikely alchemist, forges mythic creatures and whimsical figures from the abandoned steel and rubber of everyday life. The Last Rooster reveals how, through his hands, refuse becomes revelation, and the discarded gains dignity.
1669229.title: The Last Rooster - Artist Len Zuks

1669444.synopsis: The self-appointed woman representative, Grace, wants nothing but the truth. After moving in with her unemployed boyfriend in her house and providing him with all his daily needs, she hopes she is building her future husband. When she catches him cheating she feels betrayed and heartbroken. She then goes out for drinks to de-stress. Grace meets Thabo who is a player. Grace finds out that Thabo has a partner after a night of passion and loses it over the fact that Thabo lied to her. Thabo's lies lead him to being kidnapped and he cannot leave until he understands Grace's anger. Will he escape and go back to his partner? Will Grace face the consequences of her actions?
1669444.title: Guarded

1669915.synopsis: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.
1669915.title: Angel and the Badman

1669984.synopsis: An amazing cast takes you on a journey beyond UFO Disclosure. It starts within the cement walls of Washington DC, and then guides you beyond your imagination. Prepare for an awesome adventure that will leave you questioning EVERYTHING.
1669984.title: Accidental Truth: Next - Beyond UFO Disclosure

1671507.synopsis: Celebrating the release of his sixth album, Gen Hoshino takes the stage on his sold-out Gen Hoshino presents MAD HOPE tour in this Netflix-only edit.
1671507.title: Gen Hoshino presents MAD HOPE MAD MUSIC

1671548.synopsis: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.
1671548.title: Dear You

1673194.synopsis: The Louds are headed to Europe, where they'll attend a knighting ceremony in London, search for the world's best pizza in Italy, spend a night in a creepy castle in Transylvania, ski the Swiss alps, and time-travel to ancient Greece!
1673194.title: The Loud House: European Adventure

1673320.synopsis: Set against a community backdrop, events unfold around personal conflict and shifting relationships. As tensions rise, individuals are forced to confront difficult choices. The outcome is shaped by loyalty, pressure, and consequence.
1673320.title: Jawaak

1673678.synopsis: Uncover the shared patterns that surface in near-death and shared-death experiences, illuminated by the groundbreaking work of Dr. Raymond Moody and William Peters. Their decades of research intertwine with profound personal testimonies and age-old stories from every corner of the world—a graceful dance between intellect and emotion that opens a luminous doorway into the afterlife.
1673678.title: Afterlife: Beyond the Light

1673928.synopsis: This feature documentary charts Rod Quantock’s five-decade career and his tireless efforts to communicate the perils of neoliberalism and the urgency of climate change through humour. His journey illustrates the building of the thriving comedy landscape we take for granted today, showcasing a man who has remained steadfast in his pursuit of truth in an hilarious fashion.
1673928.title: Rod Quantock Comedy Warrior

1674087.synopsis: Robin Byrd pioneered NYC public access with her cult sex-positive call-in show.  Now the larger-than-life 70-year-old champion of free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex reflects on her unique legacy and her hidden, decades-long marriage behind the scenes.
1674087.title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story

1674360.synopsis: Heidi’s baby shower descends into chaos when her estranged father crashes the party.
1674360.title: Baby Shower

1674575.synopsis: Based on a true story, we follow Jenny, a middle-aged woman in remission going for an MRI. However, before the scan Jenny discovers that she can’t take off her erotic piercing. This leads to her finding an unlikely confidant in the MRI’s Technician as they both try and find a solution to this tricky situation.
1674575.title: The Scan

1674582.synopsis: Eleven-year-old Mallee has recently lost his mum, now struggling to navigate a world broken open. Across a day spent with his friend, Alby, and Alby’s Mum, Julia, he searches to find a reflection of his experience, attempting to understand his new reality and reconcile his grief.
1674582.title: Nothing And The Sun

1674644.synopsis: The pressure of glory. A shocking loss.​ Raw locker room talk. Go behind the scenes into their reality as Samurai​ Japan's camera keeps rolling.
1674644.title: Beyond the Game: Samurai 2026 WORLD BASEBALL CLASSIC

1675032.synopsis: In his first HBO comedy special, comedian Josh Johnson debuts original material about our shared experiences as humans – tackling topics like family, religion, and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity.
1675032.title: Josh Johnson: Symphony

1675177.synopsis: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.
1675177.title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set

1675418.synopsis: After the devastating loss of their infant daughter, Maria and Avery Brooks struggle to survive the quiet devastation that grief leaves behind. Once vibrant and full of life, Maria retreats into silence, while Avery-desperate to fix what feels irreparably broken-searches for any solution that might restore the woman he loves. As outside help enters their home, fragile emotions begin to shift in unexpected ways. What starts as an attempt to heal slowly exposes buried loneliness, unmet needs, and dangerous vulnerabilities. Love becomes complicated.
1675418.title: Tragic Villain

1676362.synopsis: Angel is a young woman on the brink of a nervous breakdown. Feeling as if she has no control left in her life, she commits wholeheartedly to a series of spontaneous and erratic decisions. The result is an emotional metamorphosis with large scale consequences.
1676362.title: Laws Of Desire

1677128.synopsis: Jenny does the same thing every day: have a shower, make some coffee, walk to the park, sit down at her usual bench, and drink half her coffee. This has worked out for her for years but when a mysterious gentleman keeps beating her and interrupting her schedule she decides to make it her mission to beat him to the bench . Its easier said than done.
1677128.title: Change Of Plans

1677340.synopsis: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.
1677340.title: Secret of Kalinga

1677415.synopsis: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her
1677415.title: Paroxysm

1677550.synopsis: Kill Tony tag teams with WrestleMania 42, as Tony Hinchcliffe, WWE icons and comedy heavyweights put upstart stand-ups to the test in Las Vegas.
1677550.title: KillTonyMania

1677574.synopsis: Comedy trailblazer Eddie Murphy celebrates his legendary film career in this star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles.
1677574.title: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy

1678.synopsis: Japan is thrown into a panic after several ships are sunk near Odo Island. An expedition to the island led by Dr. Kyohei Yamane soon discover something far more devastating than imagined in the form of a 50 meter tall monster whom the natives call Gojira. Now the monster begins a rampage that threatens to destroy not only Japan, but the rest of the world as well.
1678.title: Godzilla

1678192.synopsis: Centuries after being killed for witchcraft, a mother and daughter are resurrected. They seek revenge on descendants of those responsible. As locals disappear, two journalists investigate the mysterious events.
1678192.title: Blood Witch

1678386.synopsis: Centers women's voices in a narrative of empowerment and resistance. The Telugu film weaves together diverse female experiences, examining how women balance societal expectations, personal goals, and systemic obstacles.
1678386.title: Lechindi Mahila Lokam

1678844.synopsis: This documentary revisits the French football team's controversial 2010 World Cup and the bus strike that sparked global headlines and national outrage.
1678844.title: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny

1678850.synopsis: Haunted by a past abusive relationship, Ella tries to psych herself up for her third date with Harry.
1678850.title: Date 3

1679036.synopsis: Viewers travel around the world, getting a global perspective on the three biggest (and interrelated) problems our species faces – climate change, species loss and soil loss. More importantly, viewers will learn about the multitude of methods in which regeneration is addressing and even reversing these trends on an ecosystem-by-ecosystem basis, all while storing enough carbon in the ground to help mitigate our changing climate.
1679036.title: Groundswell

1679730.synopsis: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.
1679730.title: THE RIBBON HERO

1680044.synopsis: Worlds collide when characters lives are split in new directions. An experimental film utilising the medium of a split screen to follow the stories of a couple loose Sydney siders.
1680044.title: Perfect Marble

1680052.synopsis: Script Draft Untitled follows two housemates as they realise that they no longer share similar values. Chase gets sucked into the alt-right pipe line, and Ryan begins to understand himself.
1680052.title: Script Draft Untitled

1680084.synopsis: When a covert research team imprisons Popeye to harness his superhuman strength as a military weapon, their experiment spirals violently out of control. Transformed into an unstoppable force driven by rage, Popeye tears through the facility, leaving destruction in his wake. With time running out and casualties mounting, one scientist risks everything to stop the monster they created - before he reaches the outside world.
1680084.title: Popeye III: Requiem

1680087.synopsis: A fanatical cult resurrects Popeye, convinced they can bend his legendary strength to their will. Instead, he rises furious and uncontrollable, cutting a violent path through anyone who summoned him. As chaos spreads and the cult’s plan collapses, one determined survivor must confront the unstoppable sailor and end his rampage once and for all in this explosive finale.
1680087.title: Popeye 4 : Resurrection

1681195.synopsis: In Salbardi village, mysterious deaths spark fear. Officer Manorama investigates amid superstition, political pressure, and resistance. As mansion secrets and power struggles emerge, she battles mental strain seeking truth and justice.
1681195.title: Salbardi

1681623.synopsis: In a world destroyed by war, pandemics, and disaster, a small group of survivors finds refuge inside a rebuilt stronghold known as The Fort. As darkness rises and deception spreads, the community must stand together in faith and courage to defend their last haven and fight for truth, hope, and the future of mankind.
1681623.title: The Fort

1681677.synopsis: A story about a boy, a hat and the end of the world.  Amid catastrophic loss and a broken world, a young survivor struggles to cope, until a chance encounter with a familiar face reignites her will to go on.
1681677.title: LudoVic

1683357.synopsis: High-mountain guides, alpinists, and friends Lise Billon, Fanny Schmutz, and Maud Vanpoulle set out to rewrite the history of Cerro Torre—Fitz Roy’s neighbor in Patagonia—from a female perspective. The film’s illustrated, animated introduction recounts the heavily male-dominated history of this legendary peak, alongside the more personal stories of the three protagonists as they discuss their relationship with mountaineering and their place as women in a world that does not always welcome them with open arms. After spending time in El Chaltén connecting with the climbing community and training on routes and boulders, the climbers head to the mountain face for a three-day ascent, tackling the 800-meter vertical rise of this granite monster. Alternating between ice and rock pitches, they become the first all-female team to reach the summit.
1683357.title: Patagonian Chimeras

1683499.synopsis: In 1937, the Nazi regime launched its war on modernity, branding artists like Picasso, Chagall, Van Gogh, and Matisse as “degenerate”. Their works were banned, destroyed, or mocked in grotesque exhibitions, while Aryan ideals were glorified in state-sponsored shows. Framed by a major new exhibition at the Musée Picasso in Paris, the documentary revisits this ideological assault through rare footage, suppressed artworks, and the voices of curators and survivors. It broadens its scope to music, literature, and architecture, exposing how the Reich targeted all forms of dissenting expression. A timely meditation on repression, resistance, and the enduring fight for creative freedom.
1683499.title: Hitler's Big Fear: The Trial Against Degenerate Art

1683551.title: Contact in the Woods: The Dr. Johnathan Reed Story

1683621.synopsis: Four friends on a night out are asked by the police to be a part of a line up. But when they get to the station, they discover that the fifth member of the line up, and the perpetrator, went to high school with them.
1683621.title: The Line Up

1683657.synopsis: Whilst Mona is auditioning for a new musical, she falls and hits her head. After the accident, she is able to see a ghost from the 2010s who is willing to help her haunt the judges in order to get the lead role.
1683657.title: Break A Leg! A Showstopper

1684226.synopsis: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.
1684226.title: Bride of the Year

1684240.synopsis: From part-time footballer to Premier League legend, this is the story of Jamie Vardy's unprecedented path and his rise to the top against all odds.
1684240.title: Jamie Vardy

1684244.synopsis: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.
1684244.title: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul

1684246.synopsis: This is the story of Vinnie Jones's rise, fall, and comeback against odds – and red cards – from one of football's most notorious hard men to FA cup winner.
1684246.title: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones

1685309.synopsis: A special concert prepared exclusively for MOA to celebrate TOMORROW X TOGETHER's 7th  debut anniversary, [2026 TXT MOA CON]. Experience a powerful live band performance and special solos, showcasing each member’s unique talent.
1685309.title: 2026 TXT Moa Con in Japan: Live Viewing

1685364.synopsis: 12 jurors get increasingly hangry as catering refuses their ever desperate requests for a meal. Also gets a bit lynchian towards the end.  Third night. Even better night. Best night, love this night.
1685364.title: SCF – The Premiere: 12 Hangry Men

1685523.synopsis: The Devil in a Sundress is a sharp, seductive thriller about the most dangerous lie, the one that looks like love. Because evil doesn't announce itself with horns and fire. It shows up soft-spoken, sun-kissed, and completely convincing.
1685523.title: yes

1686144.synopsis: The untold story of the film that traumatised a generation.
1686144.title: Survivors: The Spectre of Threads

1686178.synopsis: Kristin Harila risked everything to summit the world’s 14 highest peaks at record speed. When her final ascent sparked backlash, her greatest triumph became a reckoning.
1686178.title: Savage Mountain

1686326.synopsis: Mixing animation and interviews, this film follows Emi Martínez's journey to becoming a legendary goalkeeper, from small-town Argentina to world glory.
1686326.title: Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time

1686398.title: SEXTA-FEIRA 13 - e a Banalização do true crime

1686471.synopsis: Thirty years after a string of unexplained disappearances, three friends uncover a hidden crawlspace containing an old puppet buried beneath their home. The night quickly spirals into a twisted nightmare when the puppet springs to life and unleashes its curse.  Trapped inside the house with the unhinged puppet, the three friends must find a way to break the curse before it’s too late.
1686471.title: Curse of the Were-Puppet

1686580.synopsis: Follows the investigation of a factory general manager's murder, where four workers—a mechanic, assistant manager, owner, and new recruit—become the primary suspects.
1686580.title: Moondram Kan

1686719.synopsis: The film is a chaotic, comedic road trip that begins when a journalist disappears, sparking rumors involving "Big Brothers". Satya (Gowrav Shetty) impulsively takes a car, only for Madhu (Shwetha V) to jump in while fleeing goons. A masked man, Munna Bhai (Gilli Nata), joins them later, turning the journey into an unpredictable adventure filled with eccentric characters. The story blends comedy, light romance, and crime, ultimately concluding with a courtroom scene.
1686719.title: Super Hit

1687079.synopsis: When Leo, a fresh high-school graduate, invites two girls to a small party, buried insecurities soon emerge among the other boys in attendance. In a series of serious misjudgements, Leo initiates a cruel game on his friend Jim, which has consequences far more serious than any of them could have anticipated.
1687079.title: In the House of the Bad Man

1687139.synopsis: A lesbian and a trans woman walk into a fertility clinic… it, um, it doesn’t go particularly well.
1687139.title: Hope

1687141.synopsis: Charlie is sucked behind their couch into a surreal museum of everything they’ve ever lost, from piles of mismatched socks to a cabinet of virginity trophies, only to discover a disturbing new exhibit devoted to their current relationship.
1687141.title: The Museum of Lost Things

1687173.synopsis: After a sudden power outage, people awaken to a world cast in eternal night. Each trapped in their own isolated version of reality. Soon they are confronted by mysterious figures known as The Ushers, Who claim they can lead them to a place where a final irreversible choice must be made.
1687173.title: Blackout

1687538.director: Brandon Scott Smith, Derek Sullivan Smith
1687538.synopsis: A football club from Nuuk is forced to overcome a series of obstacles as they travel north for the world’s shortest football season, in pursuit of a dream of becoming Greenland’s national champions.
1687538.title: No Place for Football

1687797.synopsis: As panic spreads, the past claws its way into the present, Betty Rae is forced to confront a darkness woven into her family's story, turning Halloween night into a deadly reckoning.
1687797.title: The Laksman

1688331.synopsis: While attempting to record life as it was, Arthur unintentionally documents his family’s unraveling.
1688331.title: What Am I Looking At? Is It Someone’s Navel?

1688365.synopsis: From the streets of Budapest to the fields of Poland to the beaches of the Mediterranean, women in love grapple with their affections, desires and dreams in these five exciting, moving and sexy short films from up and coming directors.
1688365.title: Upon Her Lips: Kiss Me

1688380.synopsis: Southerly follows Ada, a young and impulsive musician who flees Melbourne's 2020 lockdown for a coastal property in rural NSW. There, she meets Josh, a washed-up musician living across the road. Sensing an opportunity to reclaim what has already been a disappointing year, Ada persuades the reluctant Josh to help her record music.Through uneasy collaboration and shared isolation, Ada and Josh are forced to challenge each other as well as themselves, ultimately finding the opportunity for the change they both need.
1688380.title: Southerly

1688575.synopsis: Two-time NASCAR champion Kyle Larson attempts the notorious "Double," racing the Indianapolis 500 and the Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. With weather, exhaustion, and risk closing in, 1,100 miles offers a rare inside look at one of the toughest challenges in motorsports-and the man daring enough to take it on.
1688575.title: Kyle Larson vs. The Double

1688633.synopsis: In a remote Southern Italian village, fear spreads after a series of mysterious disappearances in the nearby woods. When two strangers arrive claiming to be messengers of the Lord, the desperate townspeople see them as saviors-except for one woman, who, with the help of a free-spirited girl and an outcast accused of witchcraft, uncovers a darker truth that lies beyond
1688633.title: Le Terre Incolte

1688652.synopsis: Two friends go on a work trip and encounter unexpected challenges and local personalities as they navigate their assignment. Their efforts to adapt to unfamiliar surroundings highlight moments of humor, small-town culture and the unpredictable nature of work travel. Their experience offers new perspectives on their friendship.
1688652.title: Gary

1688662.synopsis: An aspiring singer/songwriter finds herself in a dangerous living situation when she befriends a strange but seemingly kind girl who offers her a room to live in during her troubled times.
1688662.title: Sharp Obsession

1688804.synopsis: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..
1688804.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing

1688935.synopsis: A simple village boy refuses to sell his land when a powerful company offers big money, even as his own family gives in. As he stands alone, his fight turns from a personal struggle into a larger battle to protect his roots and expose the truth behind the project.
1688935.title: Oye Bhole Oye 2

1688992.synopsis: Set in the Aboriginal community of Yirrkala in Arnhem Land, this love story explores how two teens navigate their mutual feelings while maintaining cultural boundaries and kinship.
1688992.title: Catching Eyes

1688994.synopsis: A woman with dementia, under her daughter's care, drifts between reality and memories of her mother when she was a child.
1688994.title: Ginkgo

1688996.synopsis: While camping with her family for the annual raft race, Frankie (11) is suddenly thrust into awareness of her developing body and how the world will perceive her.
1688996.title: Raft Race

1688997.director: Judith Pungarta Inkamala, Marjorie Nunga Williams
1688997.synopsis: This short film brings together the artworks and stories of 6 leading artists and choristers: Judith Pungarta Inkamala and Anita Mbitjana Ratara of Hermannsburg Potters alongside Marjorie Nungarrayi Williams, N. Donald, Betty Conway and Lizzie Jako of Tangentyere Artists.  ‘Our Choir Has Always Been Travelling’ charts the international legacy, inter generational impact, and joy of the Hermannsburg Choir and subsequent iterations; Ntaria Ladies Choir and the Central Australian Aboriginal Women’s Choir.
1688997.title: Our Choir Has Always Been Travelling

1689000.synopsis: A farmer manages to save his livelihood by selling a new fruit product whose origins are best kept a secret between him and his domineering mother.
1689000.title: Flesh Fruit

1689001.synopsis: Late in the night, while the world sleeps, a subterranean swamp craft rushes beneath the reeds.
1689001.title: Flywire

1689002.synopsis: In search of a perfect vintage sweater, a lonely artist is drawn into the chaotic orbit of two thrift-shopping twins, leading brand-label-status, shame and longing to collide in an unexpectedly tender and surreal encounter.
1689002.title: Mr Adidos

1689005.synopsis: When her mother suddenly dies, Sonja is thrown into tumult. Dealing with early-twenties existential angst and a sense of responsibility for her teenage younger sister Emma, she has a lot on her plate. Suddenly under the care of her controlling grandma and—as a young woman living with Down syndrome—constantly faced with a society that judges what she’s capable of, Sonja is desperate to be herself and take charge of her own life. When a chance encounter with the charismatic Hakim leads her to a krump class, Sonja discovers a life-changing outlet for expression.
1689005.title: Boss Cat

1689198.synopsis: The beloved fitness personality's remarkable rise to fame; examining the cultural impact that made him a household name.
1689198.title: The Mystery of Richard Simmons: A Diane Sawyer Special

1690070.synopsis: What starts as a routine audition for a no-name indie horror flick quickly turns deadly when a group of actors find themselves trapped inside a building with no way out. They're hunted by masked killers who know every inch of the building.
1690070.title: We Can't Leave

1690370.synopsis: An escaped prisoner finds himself competing in the Kings Birthday tournament but eventually rallies the townfolk to overthrow the King for the greater good.
1690370.title: The Adventures of Wilfred Finch

1690435.synopsis: In a time when the abortion debate continues to divide culture, politics, and communities across America, this deeply emotional film cuts through the noise to tell a raw and unforgettable human story, one that challenges audiences to see the person behind the issue. EDEN’S CHOICE follows the journey of 13 year old Eden, a young girl facing abuse, poverty, and an unplanned pregnancy. As her family crumbles and her circumstances spiral beyond her control, Eden is forced to make a decision that will shape the rest of her life. Choosing courage over fear, she makes the life altering decision to choose life. What follows is a powerful journey of sacrifice, perseverance, and ultimately, redemption, as Eden comes to understand the profound impact of her choice years later.
1690435.title: Eden's Choice

1690760.synopsis: An amateur astronomer discovers a strange new star in the sky that leads him into the heart of a dark conspiracy to control humanity by exploiting its addiction to technology.
1690760.title: Capio

1691022.synopsis: A thought-provoking documentary examining personal accounts of alleged alien abduction, hybridization, and non-human identity.
1691022.title: The Hybrids

1691147.synopsis: A group of small-town filmmakers chase their dream of making a movie despite having no budget, no connections, and no idea what they’re doing.
1691147.title: American Deadbeats

1691590.synopsis: Supertramp: Crime of the Century in Concert at Hammersmith Odeon 1975 is a comprehensive release capturing the British progressive rock band's landmark March 9, 1975 show in London. Restored from original 16mm film, this release features a Dolby Atmos audio mix and a setlist that bookends their hit album. Just prior to embarking on their first major North American tour in 1975, Supertramp played a highly anticipated, sold-out show at London's Hammersmith Odeon. This performance showcased the classic line-up of Rick Davies, Roger Hodgson, Dougie Thomson, John Helliwell, and Bob Siebenberg at the critical moment Crime of the Century was propelling them to global fame.
1691590.title: Supertramp: Crime of the Century in Concert at Hammersmith Odeon 1975

1691759.synopsis: Juliette tries to survive a breakup with her girlfriend by chronically masturbating and trying to convince herself to start dating men. Her delirium is finally relieved (sort of) by an unexpected stranger.
1691759.title: Cockroach

1691760.synopsis: Edward is sweating over his poetry performance, all the while trying to get to know Max, and compete with the flirtatious Alex, the event’s snarky, but charming MC . Judy wants Ruth, but will her ex Penny, and Judy’s own knitted fashion choices get in the way? Ex-girlfriends, angry poets, rusty romantics, and a dash of imposter syndrome collide at a spoken word event in this LGBTIQ+ comedy short film/ pilot.
1691760.title: Big Flirt

1691762.synopsis: Today, people living with HIV who are on treatment can live long, healthy lives and cannot pass the virus on. Yet many still face outdated assumptions, fear and discrimination.
1691762.title: HIV Still Matters: The Future of HIV

1691902.synopsis: Exploring the lives of stray cats in Athens and beyond, ACROPOLIS CATS AND OTHER WONDROUS CREATURES examines the tenderness and tragedies in human-animal relationships. It reflects on love, cruelty, compassion, and what we can learn about freedom in a rapidly changing world.
1691902.title: Acropolis Cats and Other Wondrous Creatures

1691904.synopsis: Passionate conservationist Neil Waters embarks on a decade-long search through Tasmania’s wilderness to prove the Tasmanian Tiger still exists. Once celebrated but now ridiculed, his quest becomes a moving story of belief, science, redemption, and the ethics of extinction.
1691904.title: Eyes Like Diamonds

1692138.synopsis: A city of reinvention, San Francisco tries to rise from the ashes after an era of turmoil and troubled headlines. Told through intimate vignettes; a Muni operator, the mayor, artists, the man who cremates overdose victims and dozens more.
1692138.title: San Francisco Rising

1692419.synopsis: When a businessman obsessed with ancestral superstitions forces his science-minded wife and daughter on a nationwide search for a success-granting amulet, the family is repeatedly duped by fraudulent shamans in their desperate bid to secure the girl's overseas education.
1692419.title: 5 Bomoh

1692628.synopsis: Between 2021 and 2025, the city was under massive construction to prepare for a new streetcar line. As the works finally come to an end, I grapple with the ending of a construction of my own.
1692628.title: While construction is in progress, shops will remain open

1692782.synopsis: A mysterious VHS dating tape from the 1980s becomes the centerpiece of a chilling found-footage nightmare in Video Hearts, a horror short from filmmaker Ken Cohen. What begins as an awkward relic of lonely-hearts video culture slowly reveals something far more sinister hidden beneath the tape’s nostalgic surface, blending analog horror aesthetics with eerie psychological dread.
1692782.title: Video Hearts

1693002.synopsis: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common — in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case.
1693002.title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell

1693201.synopsis: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.
1693201.title: Poldi

1693400.synopsis: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.
1693400.title: 2 Big to Rig

1693884.synopsis: The 45-minute performance moved through three phases. An opening of contained, whispered self-consciousness as students navigated the after-dark building. A middle section in which genuine exchanges and unplanned moments surfaced. A final integration in which the edit, score, cue delivery, and student presence arrived at something unrehearsed and unrepeatable.
1693884.title: Turn Around

1694425.synopsis: Superhero team Spectronizer, has to defend the town from a threat that is closer to home than they may think....
1694425.title: Spectronizer

1694426.synopsis: A documentary that follows Canadian-born defenseman Luke Prokop as he decides to become the first — and still only — professional athlete playing under contract to an NHL team to come out as gay. Growing up in Edmonton steeped in Canada’s tough, often homophobic hockey culture, and playing without gay role models throughout professional sports, Luke’s path to coming out of the closet has been neither easy nor obvious. The film charts Prokop’s personal journey against the backdrop of a professional hockey industry that has had, at best, an ambivalent relationship to diversity. As the film sensitively reveals, being publicly out certainly came as an earthquake to his family, especially his father Al, who as Luke’s mentor and sometime coach represents the most complex and moving relationship in the film.
1694426.title: The Hockey Player

1694562.synopsis: A short experimental film that follows the desperation of needing to go to the toilet.
1694562.title: The Convenience

1694620.synopsis: A fierce family rivalry sparks a desperate plan to go abroad, but lies, love, and chaos soon reveal that true happiness lies back home.
1694620.title: Haye Ni Bebe Meriye

1695081.synopsis: A reclusive WWII veteran rescues a traumatised Polish woman from a crash. Her abrasive nature clashes with his old-world routines, but as a fragile bond forms between them, they must combine forces to fight the violent past that has tracked her down.
1695081.title: Gone to Ground

1695180.synopsis: A maladjusted cart pusher at a dying grocery store falls for an underage cashier during a heat wave in the New Jersey suburbs.
1695180.title: Cart Pushers

1695225.synopsis: After surviving a devastating plane crash that nearly took his life, legendary and electrifying drummer Travis Barker embarks on a raw and redemptive journey in this intimate portrait of the man behind the tattoos who transformed pain into power.
1695225.title: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear

1695285.synopsis: After a devastating cyclone displaces a fishing community, they seek refuge only to fall under the control of ruthless drug dealers. Amid the turmoil, a carefree young fisherman is forced to grow up after a personal tragedy, torn between love and his duty to protect his people, as he rises to stand against oppression.
1695285.title: Therachaapa

1695360.synopsis: Stranded at a remote cabin, a grieving family faces a relentless bear that tests their shelter and forces a final stand.
1695360.title: Grizzly Attack

1695366.synopsis: A cabin getaway turns deadly when a rogue bear stalks five college friends, forcing the survivors to flee through the forest at night with a ranger guiding them.
1695366.title: Grizzly Bear Massacre

1695389.synopsis: Our main fella awakes, but when he does he is no longer in his normal world. He is confined to a comic book. He must confront his past to make it out and right his wrongs, before the darker side of him takes over. A story told in two parts four years apart, in which throughout the years he gains perspective to help him defeat the darkness once and for all. Like Mega Strathdene, but if he was cool. Theres cool shit and explosions though.
1695389.title: Trapped in a Comic Book

1695493.synopsis: Karen an unhappy married woman joins several Beauty Contests in the hope of being famous and adored by complete strangers. As she continues to lose beauty contests, we see that her competition is being killed off one by one. As we follow Karen's journey through the film we discover who is the killer and what are the true motivations behind the murders.
1695493.title: Karen the Beauty Queen Butcher

1695513.synopsis: Kitty Video and Cam make their living producing sleazy, "snuff-style" fetish videos for their online fans. When Silver Springs is suddenly overrun by influencers chasing clout, Kitty decides it's time to give the audience something real.
1695513.title: Video Vixen

1696131.synopsis: Autism is not a weakness or a flaw, it is simply a different way of experiencing the world. Every person learns, thinks, feels, communicates, and understands life in their own unique way. This story follows the emotional journey of a brother and sister whose deep bond becomes the heart of the film. Amid society’s misunderstandings and everyday struggles, their relationship reflects love, acceptance, sacrifice, and the strength of family, creating a touching and inspiring tale about embracing individuality.
1696131.title: Parbati

1696236.synopsis: Follows Venkata Laxmi, a village girl who claims Sanju has been murdered, and introduces Mareechika, a US-returned woman, into his life, leading to shifting relationships and a murder investigation.
1696236.title: Mareechika

1696687.synopsis: A day at the beach takes a turn for the worst for a small friend group when one of them disappears mysteriously. It’s a mad dash to try and find her as quickly as possible whilst also preparing for the worst.
1696687.title: Beach Goers

1696764.synopsis: An inspiring story that shows how the presence of a marine species can affect the entire economy and the whole society of one of the smallest islands of the Azores, the Island of Santa Maria.  It is the only place in Europe where a large number of whale sharks are sighted and in addition their migration is shrouded in mystery, no one knows where they come from, where they are going … and why they appear surrounded by thousands of tunas.  It also accompanies the scientific expeditions that for 11 years have tried to unveil the secrets of these giants and to know if their recent presence is linked to global warming and rising water temperatures around the Azores.
1696764.title: The Island of Giants

1696912.synopsis: Electronic music legends Underworld returned to the Concert Hall for a euphoric series of sold-out shows during Vivid LIVE 2024. Featuring classic tracks from across their catalogue and never before seen behind-the-scenes footage, this unique concert film showcases why this iconic duo have stood the test of time over the past four decades.
1696912.title: Underworld: Live at Sydney Opera House

1697509.synopsis: Oscar "Chuddy" Wall, a Nightfill Replenishment Associate, gets more than he bargains for when he downloads a game that his friend pre-ordered. His eagerness transcends him into the game files, where several challenges await him.
1697509.title: The Penetrable Wall

1697546.synopsis: EMO SUPERSTAR finds himself stuck in the city of Las Vegas after the rapture has occurred on Earth. A low life ex drug dealer primarily selling SSP (Soul Sucking Piss), tries to find Jesus, heaven, and God. He attempts to escape sin city, traveling through the desert, and the suburbs in order to find redemption. Temptations of drugs, sex, and freedom whisper in his ear as he falls in love with a beaten up old sex doll.
1697546.title: My Vegas Eyes

1697567.synopsis: With exclusive access to never-seen-before classified government files and explosive video and audio recordings, this is the scandalous story of how thousands of alleged Nazi war criminals hid in Australia after WWII and managed to evade justice – despite a government-sanctioned Special Investigations Unit desperate to prosecute them.
1697567.title: The Hunt for the Last Nazis

1697730.synopsis: When a jaded paralegal reunites with his volatile ex-friends, old desires and rivalries ignite into a dangerous game of seduction, power and betrayal.
1697730.title: By The Horns

1698418.synopsis: Actor Fedi Nuril takes the hot seat as he faces hilarious jokes from a panel of six comedians and celebrities through the “Trilogy of Laughter”.
1698418.title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril

1698575.synopsis: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.
1698575.title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy

1699155.synopsis: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.
1699155.title: Maternal Instinct

1699424.synopsis: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.
1699424.title: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery

1699463.synopsis: Following the adoption of their longtime babysitter, 16 year old Sophie, Hope begins to suspect her new daughter is hiding a terrible secret that will endanger her family.
1699463.title: The Girl We Let In

1699598.synopsis: In a world heading towards climate breakdown, All the World is Green takes us on a journey to discover how much what we put on our table fuels climate change. Through the guidance of scientists, academics, activists, journalists and philosophers, we embark on a journey spanning from China to the USA, leading us to discover how our love for animal products took over our food system, pushing our ecosystems to the verge of collapse for the profit of a handful of corporations. After a journey stretching through Asia, America and Europe, the film leaves the viewer with a choice: remaining part of the problem, or becoming part of the solution.
1699598.title: All the World Is Green

1699609.title: Eric Dane: Life, Loss & Courage – A Diane Sawyer Special

1699970.synopsis: Tells the story of climate refugees across six continents, celebrating the voices and experiences of people living at the forefront of the climate crisis, displaced from their homes by climate disasters.
1699970.title: The Welcome Table

1701297.synopsis: A family barricades themselves in their Tokyo home during a global crisis, but buried secrets soon resurface, threatening to tear them apart.
1701297.title: Cain

1701665.synopsis: The Marine Spirit is based on factual events as told through the eyes of a Nigerian couple. When the young couple find themselves haunted by the spirit of the Mami Wata – an ancient African water deity; they discover the power of faith and prayers.
1701665.title: The Marine Spirit: A Tale Of The Mami Wata

1701692.synopsis: After her brother is murdered, Jade Carter uncovers a secret list linking powerful elites to a deadly conspiracy. As corrupt forces close in, she must outsmart both criminals and law enforcement to expose the truth - and survive long enough to get revenge.
1701692.title: Killer Curve

1701799.synopsis: Brain injury survivors trek to Everest Base camp to prove human resilience.
1701799.title: The Everest Dream

1701823.synopsis: A young, bored and unhappy 9-5 office worker drifts into daydream at his desk about his true passion of  jazz, only to snap back into reality.
1701823.title: In Another Life

1702012.synopsis: A look at the career of the Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan.
1702012.title: The Dripton Files: More Mummy, More Problems

1702350.synopsis: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.
1702350.title: Fallen Angels

1702575.synopsis: After a typical day at the garage, a young mechanic swaps her stained overalls for a leather ensemble—as she shifts gears into a different kind of routine. Driving through bustling Paris, she helps a passerby cross the street, delivers plants to a hardware store, and picks up an enigmatic passenger.
1702575.title: Avec Kim

1702960.synopsis: After his hit show "GOAT," Ge Pamungkas is back with fresh material — exploring love, marriage and the battle of the sexes in this comedy special.
1702960.title: GOAT Pandemonium Ge on all tempo

1702975.synopsis: A short private film created by 3 high-school students depicting the average teenage-girl experience. Shot in a grass field over 2 minutes.
1702975.title: IBIU

1702997.synopsis: A compelling mystery about an old song and it’s impacts on the generation growing up hearing it.
1702997.title: Hound Dog’s Release

1703020.synopsis: A man embarks on a grueling 500 mile run through the desert using psychedelics to push his physical and mental limits. While he battles his inner demons and the harsh terrain, he seeks redemption, aiming to prove that human potential is limitless and to challenge the stigma surrounding unconventional healing.
1703020.title: Dante: 500 Miles on Psychedelics

1703041.title: Should I Stay Or Should I Go

1703103.synopsis: In a near future Britain, at a biotech lab on the brink of collapse, three interns invent a cognitive enhancing drug. They begin full scale manufacture, only to become targets of government forces who view their breakthrough as a threat.
1703103.title: Addicted to Change

1703149.synopsis: In the closing days of the Second World War, the SS attempt to manufacture immortality using stolen Egyptian funerary rites. What they create is not eternal life, but a mummified revenant, a sadistic officer bound into undeath by occult ritual. Buried, forgotten, and sealed beneath a British coastal fort, the relic waits. When it is uncovered decades later, the war resumes, only this time it is personal.
1703149.title: The Mummy: Reckoning

1703154.synopsis: A dysfunctional rehab group is stranded at a rundown cabin as a roaring firenado melts everything in its path. With roads gone and heat rising, the misfits must combine their strange skills to fortify the house and survive the firestorm’s return.
1703154.title: Fire Tornado

1703270.synopsis: Big Foot comes out of hiding to save a little girl from a forest fire. He becomes a celebrity and opens a very popular burger joint in LA. A looming recession causes the restaurant to fail but the sexy waitresses hatch a plan to save it.
1703270.title: Big Foot Burgers

1703429.synopsis: An unsuspecting student takes a deadly elevator ride with a classmate.
1703429.title: Elevator Killings

1703603.synopsis: Follows Hannah Berner as she questions her future, exposes her unorthodox career path, dishes dating secrets and admits she's "part-time hot."
1703603.title: Hannah Berner: None of My Business

1703675.synopsis: Follows a visually impaired girl and a boy who cannot walk as their lives intersect through a matchmaking arrangement.
1703675.title: Ramani Kalyanam

1703696.synopsis: In suburban Australia, a self-proclaimed vigilante known as “Ninja Man” struggles to balance delusions of heroism with the harsh realities of his chaotic personal life. Armed with improvised weapons, a dysfunctional “Ninja Mobile,” and an obsessive grudge over a stolen wallet, he patrols the streets in search of purpose — all while evading police, confronting mythical threats like Bigfoot, and navigating family breakdowns. Australian Batman is a bizarre and heartfelt satire of superhero culture, masculinity, and small-town Australian life.
1703696.title: Australian Batman

1703707.synopsis: The story follows a young man from Lahore’s inner city who falls in love with a woman facing social restrictions and personal struggles. Their relationship develops amid violence, emotional conflict, and opposition from society. The film explores themes of love, destiny, womanhood, and sacrifice against the cultural backdrop of Old Lahore.
1703707.title: Luv Di Saun

1703744.synopsis: Child bride Gauthali overcomes abuse, loss, and discrimination through the power of education. Her determination to reclaim her future challenges deep-rooted traditions inspiring to stand against gender inequality.
1703744.title: Gauthali

1704066.synopsis: Lewis enlists his top agent, Alex Lapierre - aka "The Shepherd" - for a mission that's as high-stakes as it is dangerous: eliminate a list of targets for Tania Edwards, a powerful and enigmatic woman tangled in a massive scandal. But things quickly take an unexpected turn. A mysterious bounty hunter, known only as "The Ghost," enters the picture with a very different agenda: to take out both Tania and Alex, but on whose behalf? Caught between the conflicting demands of his superiors and his own growing doubts, Alex faces a tough decision: follow orders and remain the loyal soldier he's trained to be, or be swayed by Tania's allure and question everything he believes in.
1704066.title: The Shepherd Code: Lapierre

1704309.synopsis: A London-based girl dies after falling from a balcony during a wedding in Punjab. Declared brought dead, her death sparks a murder probe. With 20 suspects and buried secrets, the wedding turns into a deadly game of truth and lies.
1704309.title: Top Cop

1704326.synopsis: After the death of her estranged mother, a troubled woman returns to her childhood home and discovers a box. When she breaks its seal, she unleashes malevolent entities tied to a dark family legacy and a deadly secret of her own.
1704326.title: The Box in the Attic

1704506.synopsis: On October 16th, 2023, Georgina Reagan and her driver Petar Petrov went missing. Only Reagan's Canon EOS 90D camera was found. The fates of both Reagan and Petrov remain unknown. This is what happened next.
1704506.title: Recorded 2

1704846.synopsis: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.
1704846.title: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted

1705387.synopsis: The movie follows Lou, a gentle purple creature with an embarrassingly stretchy trunk, as he rescues Kiri, an ungrateful little dinosaur, from a flood — sweeping the pair into the greatest adventure in prehistory. Along the way, they discover that you can find friendship in the wildest places.
1705387.title: Kiri and Lou Go Raaa!

1705729.synopsis: When an aid worker vanishes in the first hours of war in Ukraine, a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative crosses into the shattered country to bring her home-facing mercenaries, shifting battle lines, and ghosts he thought he left behind.
1705729.title: Man of War

1706093.synopsis: On the run, a young woman breaks into an abandoned house with a dark past-a quadruple murder still fresh in the headlines. But the longer she hides, the more the house begins to reveal its secrets. She begins to suspect she's not alone.
1706093.title: Evil Within

1706151.synopsis: Harry Enfield heads a brilliant cast in this quirky political comedy where plots, counterplots and seduction flourish in faraway Borovia.
1706151.title: Welcome to Borovia

1706553.synopsis: Two gangsters decide to play poker against each other. When ones secrets come loose, tensions rise.
1706553.title: All Or Nothing

1706554.synopsis: A prostitute seeks help from a lonesome drunk detective to murder and overthrow her abusive fat pimp.
1706554.title: Pimpsville

1706625.synopsis: A letter brings a young woman's grief to the surface, reconnecting her with Somalia and her lost birth mother. Starring Edyll Ismail (Send Help).
1706625.title: Mother

1706726.synopsis: In 1954, Marilyn Monroe—a 28-year-old actress who was not yet a star—traveled to Korea, in the midst of the war, to perform on stage and boost the morale of American troops. She undertook a four-day tour in the dead of winter, immortalized by unforgettable photographs: Marilyn in a sheer, form-fitting dress, in the freezing cold, facing more than 100,000 GIs. This trip was a turning point in her life. Thanks to this unprecedented success, she would reveal herself to herself and to others. Marilyn discovered herself as a radiant, free, sexy, and admired woman. She entered into legend, as well as into every American household of the 1950s.
1706726.title: Marilyn Monroe: The Rise of an Icon

1706831.synopsis: A true story of an 18-year-old Ema McKie who, after receiving news that her fiancé has committed suicide, drives across the country to join him in death, losing her mind to find her truth and journey home.
1706831.title: A Stab At Heaven

1707533.synopsis: Two low-budget dancers, Cashier and Old-Timer, reunite to perform a surprise birthday gram for Alex, a closet lesbian who is so grossed out by their crude performances that she has a nightmare of her girlfriends being stalked and killed by Cashier's supernatural KILLER THONG. As the only survivor, she must confront her fears, find a way to defeat the KILLER THONG and admit her attraction to women. In the aftermath, Alex finds her coffee table covered with photos. As she looks through the outrageous party pictures, she realizes it's time for her to come out of the closet.
1707533.title: Killer Thong

1707544.synopsis: Two generations of Arsenal greats are brought together as Bukayo Saka joins club legend Thierry Henry for an unguarded look at what it takes to perform at the highest level. Saka and Henry reflect on pressure, resilience, and the joy that first drew them to the game, with the conversation taking them back to Saka’s childhood home in Ealing where it all began.
1707544.title: Bukayo Saka: The Time Is Now

1707690.synopsis: Yulia works as a florist in a flower shop, and since the beginning of the war, "Horror" - a faceless fear of death-has returned to her, forcing her to almost never leave her apartment, losing in her anxieties.  Everything changes when Yura, her childhood friend, arrives, they begin to develop feelings for each other. However, this illusion shatters when Yura admits that, in just a few days, he will be heading to the front line, as it is the only way to fulfill his greatest wish - to return home.
1707690.title: This Is Horror

1708175.synopsis: When a bad person is marked as a 'virus', they become a verified target and will be terminated. A unique team of assassins known as 'AVL' follows this strict code. But when Blake discovers her target is innocent, she uncovers a bigger conspiracy. To hide their corruption, members of the AVL mark her as a Verified Target.
1708175.title: Verified Target

1708212.synopsis: Khadak Singh Chauhan follows a retired man’s emotional yet humorous fight against corruption and government red tape.
1708212.title: Khadak Singh Chauhan

1708214.synopsis: Love You Dadu Dadi Ji is a musical family drama film directed by Harinder Sohal. The plot revolves around four school-going boys and their deep, emotional bond with their grandfather. It explores the value of elders, the importance of family, and bridges generational gaps.
1708214.title: Love You Dadu Dadi Ji

1708218.synopsis: Cab 0786 tells the story of Rajveer Pandher, a father who sends his daughter Kiran to Chandigarh to fulfill her dreams. But the city's freedom leads her into the dangerous world of drugs. When Kiran finally calls for help, Rajveer leaves his village and becomes a cab driver in Chandigarh. His journey reveals the strength of a father's love and the sacrifices he will make to protect his child.
1708218.title: Cab 0786

1708712.synopsis: A singer’s journey to fame becomes a journey of love, loss, and a final promise to the woman he could never forget.
1708712.title: Adaraneeya Tharuwak

1709734.synopsis: Based on the life of Marty Reichman, who became the oldest college football player in American history at the age of 44.
1709734.title: 4th & 44

1710008.synopsis: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.
1710008.title: Nothing to Lose

1710203.synopsis: Tony Hinchcliffe takes center stage to prove no topic is too taboo and nothing is off-limits — not even the audience — in this razor-sharp special.
1710203.title: Tony Hinchcliffe: Man of the People

1710392.synopsis: Gun Pilots takes a compelling insider’s view into the rigorous world of U.S. Army Apache flight training. It follows student aviators as they confront the formidable challenge of mastering the AH-64 Apache—the most lethal attack helicopter ever built!
1710392.title: Gun Pilots

1710459.synopsis: When an artist stages a deeply personal performance piece, her work becomes an urgent attempt to reach her audience before it's too late.
1710459.title: Flame

1710593.synopsis: After the death of his father, a pastor's son takes the lead, but a power-hungry deacon plots his ruin in a tale of faith, ambition, and betrayal.
1710593.title: Secret Sins

1710733.synopsis: Take a ground-level view of 2024's Hīkoi mō Te Tiriti, one of the largest movements of people in Aotearoa’s recent history; reflecting on identity, unity, and the enduring significance of Te Tiriti o Waitangi for Māori today.
1710733.title: When We Walk

1710786.synopsis: When a group of young European women uncover a family secret through DNA, they set out on a journey to find their sister - and the father who left them. What begins as a quest for answers becomes a journey about the true meaning of family.
1710786.title: Daddy Issues

1711153.synopsis: At Hamlyn High, Diversity Day is documented with mockumentary flair as an eccentric principal enthusiastically oversells a series of painfully awkward student presentations. From cringey accents to half-baked posters, the unenthusiastic students stumble through their projects until the chaos gives way to a surprisingly genuine realization that diversity is about understanding and respect, not performance.
1711153.title: Diversity Day

1711182.synopsis: A heartfelt story of identity, family, redemption, and the transformative power of humanity, where a simple pension document becomes the beginning of an extraordinary journey of self-discovery.
1711182.title: Pension Patta

1711295.synopsis: In this silent romantic comedy-drama, a reality-challenged title writer must navigate the perils and possibilities of two worlds: the one in his head, and the one in which he has a chance at real love.
1711295.title: Away with Words

1711422.synopsis: On a journey through heartbreak, in search of transformation. The film is built through friendship: each person helps in their own way, searches for the story, translates the words into their own language, sings Emily Dickinson, joyfully mends the dress of sorrow.
1711422.title: The Bitches

1711662.synopsis: To finish a novel, a writer retreats to a remote Texas Hill Country home and becomes entangled in a deadly clash with a mysterious cult.
1711662.title: A Texas Nightmare

1711665.synopsis: A young swimmer stops practicing and dives into a fierce internal battle. Having always been just "the swimmer", he is now suffocated by the fear of who he is without the water. In this struggle, survival means deciding between leaping into water or quitting forever.
1711665.title: Beneath the water

1712330.synopsis: This documentary uncovers one of the most consequential and little-known stories in modern football history and highlights the pivotal moment that helped shape Lionel Messi’s international future and altered the trajectory of global football.
1712330.title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape

1712405.synopsis: On a remote Australian farm, a weary farmer crosses paths with a wounded stranger desperate for help. What begins as an uneasy act of kindness quickly spirals into a nightmarish fight for survival, as something far more sinister than an injury reveals itself.
1712405.title: Bug Bite

1712415.synopsis: Desperate for money, a struggling photographer accepts a high-paying anonymous photoshoot in a stranger’s house.
1712415.title: Exposure

1712471.synopsis: A revenge short made for the 48 hour film project Brisbane.
1712471.title: Light 3

1712475.synopsis: A young drug dealer has to evade two police officers whilst getting ready to have dinner with his girlfriend's parents for the first time
1712475.title: Runner

1712480.synopsis: As a priest listens to a distraught woman’s confession, he begins to realise she’s after more than forgiveness.
1712480.title: The Confession

1712550.synopsis: Following a suspicious, near-miss doomsday event, an amateur astronomer and a stoned conspiracy theorist turn to Banterbot, an AI chatbot, for answers.
1712550.title: Aipocalypse

1712571.synopsis: In a neon-drenched dystopia where lifespans are traded like currency, a dying man drags himself through the night in search of a second chance he may not deserve.
1712571.title: Blue Sands

1712589.synopsis: Refusing to accept the loss of her girlfriend, Quinn spirals through the suffocating confines of prison. In the depths of her grief she must navigate her unraveling mind and confront her inner demons.
1712589.title: The Brutal Alchemy of Water

1713007.synopsis: “Naked” is a raw, intimate split-screen drama set inside a grand hotel. On a weekend away, young couple Nora and Simon are caught in the intoxicating rush of a new relationship. But when Simon accuses Nora of saying the wrong name in bed, a brief but crucial window opens: a chance for both of them to be honest. Physically close yet emotionally miles apart, each side of the screen follows their inner narrative as a quiet countdown begins.
1713007.title: Naked

1713073.synopsis: Two homeless companions discover a magical hourglass with the power to rewind time… but only for ten seconds. They soon realise that this could be an opportunity to drastically change their situation. However, their plan requires two people, and neither one fully trusts the other.
1713073.title: Transience

1713113.synopsis: In 1912 Australia, two girls hide a forbidden bond from their nature-worshipping cult, but when their secret is exposed, the fearsome Shepherd blames them for the land’s failing harvest.
1713113.title: Spring Child

1713136.synopsis: In WW1 Germany, Australian citizens are pronounced 'Enemy Aliens', and their lives and whereabouts are controlled by the authorities. Wilf is taken from his University and placed on a rural farm, and then later imprisoned along with other foreigners as the war rages on across Europe.
1713136.title: WILF - Hope & Hardship

1713163.synopsis: For decades people have been spotting strange lights in the sky, seeing unidentifiable craft dart across the horizon, and occasionally waking up with a lingering suspicion that something had been in their bedroom that wasn't there before. But what if we've been thinking about UFOs all wrong? What if these mysterious visitors aren't just little green men in flying saucers but something far weirder-something that interacts with us not through radio waves, but through our minds? Welcome to the mind-blowing world of psionics and UFOs, where telepathy and consciousness itself might be the key to unlocking the biggest mystery of our time. Patrick Scott Armstrong host of the popular podcast and YouTube channel Vetted takes a journey around America to meet those who claim they can use psionics to summon UFOs, experience them doing it in the field, and even tries it himself His aim - to get to the bottom of whether it's all nonsense or whether this is something that should be taken seriously.
1713163.title: Psionics: The Minds That Summon UFOs

1713171.synopsis: In the tranquil Australian hinterland town of Pomona, young Kellie Handly, a nine-year-old with a vivid imagination, navigates her days with the companionship of her imaginary friend, Bingo Man.
1713171.title: Bingo Man

1713185.synopsis: How To Move is an Australian drama short film that deals with concepts of individualism, community, class, expression, and change. The story follows a man named Jesse over the course of a day as he struggles with the plan to leave his hometown that night.
1713185.title: How To Move

1713201.synopsis: A Magician performs for her freaks in the circus when she looses control and finds something is living inside her. At an attempt to keep this creature away she comes face to face with her child only to end up in another womb.
1713201.title: The Velvet Viscera

1713524.synopsis: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.
1713524.title: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20

1713536.synopsis: The lifecycle of entanglement between humans and nature at the microscopic and chemical level, and the inevitable consequences that follow.
1713536.title: Irregular Compressions

1713537.synopsis: An Auslan Sprite must protect her sign language for those who need it most.
1713537.title: So Beautiful

1713538.synopsis: A surreal feminist satire sees history’s greatest patriarchs - Adam, Genghis Khan, Henry VIII, and Napoleon - undone by Lilith and a mischievous Goddess of the void. Through rich tableaux, symbolic food rituals, and playful myth-making, the film exposes the fragility beneath dominance and reimagines softness as a radical force.
1713538.title: Flaccid

1713539.synopsis: A dreamlike journey over Victoria’s salt lakes, filmed on Wamba Wamba Country. As the lakes’ shifting hues unfold, ambient music, striking imagery, and Aboriginal storytelling merge into a meditation on colour, rhythm, and culture.
1713539.title: Eagle Eye

1713567.synopsis: A drama based on a true story that spans decades, exploring themes of love, friendship, courage, and societal change. The story begins in 1981 with Ted, a frail elderly man, reflecting on his life as he celebrates a landmark legal ruling with his nephew Simon, Simon’s partner Mark, and his lifelong friend Catherine. Flashbacks reveal Ted’s youth in 1940s Melbourne, where he stood up against homophobia and violence, forming a complex bond with Catherine and Leo.
1713567.title: Unacceptable

1713575.synopsis: A grieving woman is bombarded with well-meaning advice she never asked for.
1713575.title: With Sympathy

1713578.synopsis: When Parker finds out that her best friend, Moonie, has been accidentally dating a stand-up comedian, she attempts to save her friend from embarrassment by convincing her that a breakup is in order, but Moonie doesn’t see the problem.
1713578.title: She F***ed a Comedian

1713590.synopsis: After successfully casting a spell from a thrift-store grimoire, Alex and Riley realise they may have gotten more than they bargained for.
1713590.title: Secondhand Spells

1713600.synopsis: When the sacred code between two hitmen best friends is broken, revenge is the only option. Clyde tracks down his former colleague Mal – but his assassination attempt will be harder to execute than he first thought.
1713600.title: Served Cold

1713660.synopsis: A love story between a fisherman and a DVD player.
1713660.title: I Am a DVD Player

1713666.synopsis: A traditional paint on cel animated music video for Melbourne group Eddy Current Suppression Ring's 2025 track 'Shapes and Forms'.
1713666.title: SHAPES AND FORMS – Eddy Current Suppression Ring

1713670.synopsis: A geometric shape chases a blob around an underground complex. Based on a sequence of acrylic paintings, the film straddles the worlds of highbrow and lowbrow art, exploring the illusion of meaning.
1713670.title: Underneath

1713671.synopsis: When Quin discovers her missing bra pad has been used as a sponge, she tracks down the culprit: her housemate Ian. A chain of increasingly absurd misunderstandings leads her to his online girlfriend, and somehow, a fight to the death.
1713671.title: Mission: WASH DISHES DON'T DIE

1713672.synopsis: To survive the camp activity of Spotlight, Brumi and their best friend Pepper team up with a mysterious stranger named Milo. But as Pepper and Milo grow closer with every challenge, Brumi is forced to confront their insecurities and decide what they value most.
1713672.title: Spotlight

1713675.synopsis: Observed by an elderly figure, a child faces a moment of quiet significance when they encounter a tortoise on its back. A hand-drawn animated watercolour, the film transforms a fleeting encounter into a reflection on vulnerability and how we carry it.
1713675.title: Tortoise

1713678.synopsis: A young girl moves to a different country, grappling with the confusion of settling in, the sadness of missing her family, and the isolation of not understanding the language. As she navigates the challenges of independence and belonging, she discovers that even in the most difficult moments, she is never truly alone.
1713678.title: Here and There

1713679.synopsis: In a cursed forest where every creature wears a mask to live, one being's mask begins to crack inch by inch. Desperate and afraid, it hunts the other animals, ripping away their masks in a violent bid for survival, in this stark black and white fable about fear, greed, and the cost of survival.
1713679.title: The Fractured

1714046.synopsis: Eli Manning recruits NASCAR champion Ryan Blaney to go undercover at the Team Penske Race Shop in Mooresville, NC. Blaney transforms into Hamish Wimsley, a British gent who's long in the tooth and even longer in the beard. He'll get under the hood of NASCAR and Team Penske before showing diehard fans that he's still got some petrol left in the tank.
1714046.title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Ryan Blaney

1714220.synopsis: Abducted from her idyllic paradise and drugged, Ranger Jane Winter must escape her bonds or risk being caught in a predator's unforgiving web forever.
1714220.title: iHostage

1714232.synopsis: At Sturnley’s Supamart, a faded family grocery store, awkward checkout clerk Nora dreams of singing the store jingle. But when a customer mistakes small talk for life-changing wisdom, Nora is thrust into the spotlight as the store’s new mascot. Overnight, she is elevated from trainee to the face of the Sturnley empire, caught between her power-hungry father, her jealous brother, and the zealous locals. As Nora’s influence spirals into absurdity, she must decide whether to stick to the script or use her own voice.
1714232.title: Shelf Life

1714301.synopsis: Through the rise of Silvio Berlusconi, this film investigates how private television transformed the public's relationship to information, power and democracy.
1714301.title: The Revolution will be televised: The men who made Berlusconi
