1714302.synopsis: What happens when we lose a species that is family? Ganibarra is a deeply personal journey into the cultural connection between first nations people and dingoes.
1714302.title: Ganibarra

1714307.synopsis: In the midst of the Australian gold rush, a parched Chinese Traveller enters an isolated bar, but is refused service by a familiar face that sets him on a path of vengeance.
1714307.title: Kung Fu Western

1714334.synopsis: A man sees a doctor about his hand, which is on fire.
1714334.title: The Touch

1714358.synopsis: Darren barrels through work at a below average pizza shop, dreaming of being the poster boy of culinary leadership. He’s got the cooking skills, and the looks, but is completely incapable of standing up for himself.
1714358.title: Shrooms

1715076.synopsis: As murders begin to surface around hotels and expos, suspicion around Vi begins to close in. With her past resurfacing and her behavior growing harder to read, one question lingers: What is she really hiding?
1715076.title: The Exhibitor

1715371.synopsis: An actor refuses to let her audition end until she gets the line just right.
1715371.title: Anna is Still Reading for Delilah

1715462.synopsis: One night while isolated and alone a boy rediscovers the importance of human connection through an AI platform called ‘Let’s Chat’.
1715462.title: Let’s Chat

1715492.synopsis: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.
1715492.title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea

1715598.synopsis: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.
1715598.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?

1715623.synopsis: A missing friend. A seaside city. A loan shark who uses giant mascots for crime. What they find in Blackpool is far stranger — and funnier — than they ever imagined
1715623.title: In Blackpool

1715818.synopsis: Lin-Manuel Miranda and others set hip-hop and Broadway on fire in The Hamilton Mixtape.
1715818.title: A Spark Into A Flame: Hamilton & Hip Hop

1715914.synopsis: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone – East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.
1715914.title: Wham! 10 Days in China

1716056.synopsis: After the fall of Troy, warrior-king Odysseus begins a perilous voyage home, only to be thrown into a decade of wandering across a world ruled by gods and monsters. He outwits cyclopes, resists enchantresses, and descends into the realm of the dead, while his family fights to survive in his absence.
1716056.title: The Odyssey - The Real Story

1716060.synopsis: Across the turbulent 20th century, five stories reveal desperate choices and hidden triumphs-from the Holocaust's shadows to Cold War espionage-uncovering resilience in war's quiet, aching aftermath.
1716060.title: The Quiet Between Storms

1716365.synopsis: Leave it to Ryan Hamilton to get hit by a bus and have the last laugh — whether it's falling for his anesthesiologist or a dispensary trip with his mom.
1716365.title: Ryan Hamilton: This Just Hit Me

1716370.synopsis: A piano tuner wanders through the streets of New York after dark, seeking artistic inspiration. Sketchbook in hand, he observes the city’s lovers, mourners, and giant ants from afar. But when a twist of fate brings him face-to-face with a kindred spirit, he finds what he was looking for all along.
1716370.title: 7 Piano Sketches

1716513.synopsis: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.
1716513.title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition

1716649.synopsis: Inspired by true events from 2007, Main Haan follows Seerat, a young woman haunted by an unseen presence after moving to Delhi. As terrifying incidents escalate, a shocking truth emerges—a restless spirit is using her to reveal an unfinished story connected to Sarab, the man she loves.
1716649.title: Maiin Haan

1716684.synopsis: One night while isolated and alone a boy rediscovers the importance of human connection through an AI platform called ‘Let’s Chat’.
1716684.title: Let’s Chat

1716756.synopsis: What was once considered a childhood hobby has evolved into a billion-dollar global marketplace. Signed, Sealed & Delivered takes audiences inside the high-stakes world of sports collectibles, where rare trading cards, signed jerseys, and historic memorabilia have become status symbols, emotional investments, and financial assets. Through exclusive access, interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage, the documentary explores the personalities and businesses driving the hobby's modern explosion. Featuring appearances and commentary tied to sports and business icons including Lionel Messi, Kevin O'Leary, and Gary Vaynerchuk, the film uncovers the culture, psychology, risks, and financial opportunities behind the booming collectibles industry — while asking what people are truly chasing when they spend fortunes trying to own a piece of sports history.
1716756.title: Signed, Sealed & Delivered: Inside the Billion-Dollar World of Sports Collectibles

1716760.synopsis: A young girl loses her job, prompting a day of mundane and surprisingly deep conversations.
1716760.title: Everyone Gets Bored of Everything

1716771.synopsis: A narrative exploring memory and friendship, as best friends catch up over two cups of chai to play a round of Tabbeh.
1716771.title: Tabbeh

1716778.synopsis: Amidst the suffocating isolation of a prolonged COVID lockdown as a single mother, Caitlin struggles to find hope.
1716778.title: The Sun Comes Up

1716893.synopsis: Job is introduced as an incredibly wealthy man. God and Satan engage in a Supernatural discussion resulting in Satan gaining permission to 'test' Job by destroying his possessions and family.
1716893.title: 18. THE BOOK OF JOB

1717197.synopsis: A VHS featuring Lionel Messi starts a tug of war between Spain and Argentina over his loyalty.
1717197.title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape

1717231.synopsis: An ice cream cart, a sunset, and a shared memory—two strangers rediscover a connection that speaks louder than words.
1717231.title: Strawberry Cheesecake

1717809.synopsis: RADWIMPS celebrates 20 years since their major debut with this concert film, captured during their 17-show nationwide anniversary tour.
1717809.title: RADWIMPS 20th Anniversary Live Tour

1717823.synopsis: Matsu, known as Jack, arrives by train at Spencer Street Station, heart pounding, uncertain, yet hopeful.
1717823.title: 20 Years Later

1717825.synopsis: Debrah John and Ayor Makur are championing and advocating for change in regards to the practice of child marriage that is taking place in South Sudan.
1717825.title: From No Voice to Big Voice

1717830.synopsis: Inspired by the life and poetry of Sargon Boulos, this film explores exile, memory, and the enduring connection between a person and their homeland.
1717830.title: I Came From Here

1717839.synopsis: The caged bird sings with a fearful trill of things unknown but longed for still and his tune is heard on the distant hill for the caged bird sings of freedom
1717839.title: Mama?

1717843.synopsis: Told through the eyes of children, the story of Maksym, a 10-year-old Ukrainian boy, who flees the war, arrives in Valencia and meets a Russian girl named Milana.
1717843.title: Maksym & Milana

1717846.synopsis: An aging restaurant owner reflects on an old letter she once sent to her father in her homeland.
1717846.title: Huí Jiā

1717849.synopsis: After four decades of food, culture and support, Dr Nouria Salehi reflects on the closing of the Afghan Gallery Restaurant and the community it will leave behind.
1717849.title: With Love, Nouria

1718137.synopsis: Private investigator Sunshine "Sunny" LeBlanc is brutally murdered, triggering a shocking investigation. Her sudden death exposes a massive secret: she was leading a triple life, simultaneously married to a woman and two men who knew nothing about each other. Bound by grief and shared betrayal, the wife and two husbands must move into the same house for their own protection. Putting aside their shock and jealousy, the trio unites to avenge Sunny's death. Using her own detective files and tools, they hunt for her killer. As they dig deeper, they uncover a dangerous web of personal lies and high-level government corruption that puts all their lives in immediate danger.
1718137.title: A Life of Sunshine

1718210.synopsis: When a man clears out his childhood home to put on the market, he and his friend discover his parents' past seance records and hypnosis journals - awakening something that should have stayed buried.
1718210.title: A House Most Haunted

1718477.synopsis: Experience Take That live from their spectacular Circus tour – a dazzling stadium spectacle of gold-plated hits, breathtaking circus performers, and pure nostalgia. From the soaring anthems of Greatest Day and Back for Good to the jaw-dropping theatrics of fire-breathers, trapeze artists, and a 30ft mechanical elephant, this is the greatest show in town.
1718477.title: Take That - The Circus Live - Manchester 2026

1718478.synopsis: In July 2025, acclaimed blues guitarist Joe Bonamassa played three nights live at the Marquee in Cork in tribute to the legendary Rory Gallagher.  Since the sudden death of Rory Gallagher on June 14, 1995, at the age of 47, his status in the music world has only grown larger and more relevant. Rory was a self-taught virtuoso who brought about a musical revolution, avoided the pitfalls of fame and stardom, and yet became an internationally acclaimed superstar and inspiration for many.  Rory's influence reached across generations – every aspiring guitarist who encountered him was undoubtedly inspired or transformed by the power of the guitar. Only a handful of guitarists can even remotely do justice to Rory's music and guitar playing, and Joe Bonamassa dutifully took on that challenge, which he himself called "the greatest challenge of my musical life." During three sold-out nights, Joe and his fantastic band brought Gallagher's music to life!
1718478.title: Joe Bonamassa: The Spirit Of Rory – Live From Cork

1718566.synopsis: No one could predict the kind of life Michael J Fox would live. From his meteoric rise to movie stardom to the tragedy of contracting Parkinson's at just 29, his life, in a way, has been a movie in itself.
1718566.title: Michael J Fox: Actor, Activist, Optimist

1718636.synopsis: Four college students venture to a storied haunted house over night. The goal is simple, obtain research for a paper they are writing on urban myths and legends. A caretaker, played by Richard Grieco, greets them and offers to share the tale of the home's tragic beginnings. As events unfold, the group starts to understand there's more to the stories.
1718636.title: Sanctus House

1719018.synopsis: Recently single, Hunter tries to reconnect with his old friends by attending a BBQ. As he struggles to re-kindle old friendships, the nature of his past relationship becomes clearer.
1719018.title: Pain and Suffering

1719448.synopsis: 17-year-old Gigi (Kate Larson) moves with her mom (Candace Kirkpatrick) from California to small-town Minnesota, where she cleverly plots to help her Grandpa (comedian Jeff Allen) get his life back on track after the loss of his wife.
1719448.title: My 7 Grandmas

1720113.synopsis: Outsiders on a bachelor trip arrive in a close-knit beach town where locals fiercely protect their territory. Tensions erupt, hidden traumas surface, and survival becomes a nightmarish spiral into madness.
1720113.title: Crimson Cove

1720215.synopsis: If suddenly, from one day to the next, we could no longer see our reflections—never again seeing our own eyes, nose, face, or ourselves—what would it be like?
1720215.title: HOMONCULUS

1720240.synopsis: A long-standing legend speaks of treasure hidden beneath village ponds and wells, with only one man ever claiming to have found it. When clues about the lost treasure begin to surface, a series of misunderstandings, unexpected discoveries, and amusing consequences unfold, blending mystery with humor.
1720240.title: Sathyathil Sambhavichathu

1720280.synopsis: Through an artistic and human journey, Anne-Laure Maison and Michel Cam paint a portrait of marginalized lives, revealing, through art and encounter, resilience in unexpected places. Artists Anne-Laure Maison and Michel Cam embark on a journey to explore the timeless question: "Who are you?" In search of encounters along their travels, they discover and document the struggles and resilience of the people they meet. Through large-scale artistic installations and collages, their work sheds light on marginalized individuals and reveals them in a new light. The stories collected intertwine in a unique creative expression, transforming personal narratives into a collective and empowering experience.
1720280.title: Human Soul

1720289.synopsis: Four boys flee home on a journey of self-discovery, acceptance, and freedom.
1720289.title: The One, The Other And Those From Beyond

1720486.synopsis: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.
1720486.title: Lilo & Scratch

1720716.synopsis: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.
1720716.title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You

1720758.synopsis: A coast-to-coast event exploring Disney Parks and attractions as a portal through which America's greatest stories, triumphs and traditions are celebrated.
1720758.title: Disney Celebrates America: The Pursuit of Happiness

1720899.synopsis: Poetic doc on young queer people of colour navigating identity, freedom, and nighttime sanctuary in Sydney.
1720899.title: Queering Sydney

1720907.synopsis: Why the AFL was the last major sports league without an openly queer male player; explores inclusion in Australian football culture.
1720907.title: The Last Closet

1721329.title: Paranorías: Los Archivos Perdidos Del Dr. Romanoski

1721352.synopsis: Pastor Edmond Henry's appears to have the perfect life. But when a mysterious murder shatters the calm, his darkest secret is exposed, unleashing a chain of events that unintentionally destroy his family and everything he fought to protect.
1721352.title: Shattered Silence: Imitation of a Perfect Life

1721367.synopsis: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.
1721367.title: Homage

1721600.synopsis: Journey into the lives of Father's fighting to be with their children. As they face an uphill battle against a biased system pushing a Fatherless agenda. Wrongfully Accused, False Accusations, Child Support and Meritless Restraining Orders
1721600.title: Deadbeat

1721856.synopsis: Ray, a former gymnast-turned-pageant winner leaves behind the comfort of fame and privilege to take part in the Spring Revolution against Myanmar’s military dictatorship.
1721856.title: Ray

1721888.synopsis: A short documentary following C.O.F.F.I.N from their beginnings as teenagers on Sydney’s Northern Beaches to becoming one of Australia’s most respected contemporary rock’n’roll bands.
1721888.title: 10,000 Miles From Oslo

1722167.synopsis: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy’s cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.
1722167.title: Mickey's Country Farm

1722506.synopsis: In a future where gifted children are turned into weapons, Ava escapes the Blackwell Institute, desperate for freedom. Hunted by Bo, Ava must find freedom before the forces that created her destroy everything she's fighting for.
1722506.title: Flicker

1722713.synopsis: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.
1722713.title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain

1722722.synopsis: Leeds, 2034. A charismatic yet violent student rules the pupils of an all-boys school through a combination of menacing charm and sheer thuggery. At the end of the academic year, they gather for a school photo, which quickly descends into riotous, pugilistic celebration under the boy's leadership.
1722722.title: GENER8ION: STORM starring Yung Lean

1722897.synopsis: When the block heats up in Atlanta, Bishop, Tez, Poncho, and the crew must navigate love, money, and loyalty. In Da' Partments, everybody's got a hustle - and nothing stays quiet for long.
1722897.title: Da ’Partments 2

1722922.synopsis: A pirate looking for a place to fit in accidentally joins a club of cannibals.
1722922.title: Cannon Ball/Cannibal

1722960.synopsis: A young couple try to save their marriage after being delivered a file from the future detailing their impending divorce.
1722960.title: Hindsight Services

1722965.synopsis: Eli Manning recruits WNBA superstar Sabrina Ionescu to go undercover at her alma mater, the University of Oregon. Sabrina transforms into Jennifer Scone, an enthusiastic Ducks fan who's attending her first basketball game. She fools coaches, mingles with fans, and shocks the crowd at halftime.
1722965.title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Sabrina Ionescu

1723068.synopsis: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.
1723068.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory

1723075.synopsis: Set in one of the world's most closely watched wine regions, Stem & Barrel is an intimate, cinematic documentary that follows three acclaimed Napa Valley wineries through a single harvest season a defining moment that touches every part of the work, from vineyard to cellar to guest experience. With rare access to the people behind the process, the film reveals how each winery moves through the season in its own way balancing craft, hospitality, mentorship, and legacy while upholding a world-class reputation built by generations before them. Across early mornings in the vineyard, long days in the cellar, and moments shared with guests, each piece of the season is connected and every decision shapes what comes next. Because in Napa Valley, harvest isn’t just about making wine it’s about carrying something forward.
1723075.title: Stem & Barrel: Napa Valley

1723460.synopsis: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.
1723460.title: A Toxic Love Story

1723570.synopsis: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.
1723570.title: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain

1723911.synopsis: Australian coins provide a set of instructions that question how to live in a capitalist colonial society in the time of climate uncertainty. Head or Tails was shot on a hand wound Bolex following self-imposed instructions over a single roll of film. Setting the focus to close range, I let the flip of a coin decide which direction the camera “walked”. The camera, fixed to a mono-pod, strides through the landscape till the film wind or path runs out.
1723911.title: Heads or Tails?

1723990.synopsis: A motley crew of para ice hockey skaters fight to keep their grassroots sporting club on the rink in this stirring, often hilarious documentary.
1723990.title: Hard as Puck

1724020.synopsis: A mute young woman, Nora, awakens into a surreal domestic prison, a seemingly idyllic beachside cottage under the suffocating control of a charismatic but sinister Fisherman and his increasingly unstable partner.
1724020.title: The Tide Turns

1724077.synopsis: How do you separate a Melbourne-born Oz music treasure and cosmopolitan star from a resilient woman? Follow the threads of her story, in her own words.
1724077.title: Tina Arena: Unravel Me

1724711.synopsis: In 1947, in a small town in New Zealand, rationing essential goods became a way of life after the war. Helen McCrae, a Middle-aged woman's life disintegrates as she is waiting for news of her son Adam from the front lines.
1724711.title: On the Edge of Hope

1724782.synopsis: If you’ve watched someone brush their teeth, chances are you live with them or you’re in love with them.  A collage by Greer Clemens of scenes from movies and TV shows where people brush their teeth.
1724782.title: Silence As Romance: Brushing Your Teeth

1725099.synopsis: Bea has always known she was born to perform. But when a pandemic shuts down her school's music program and bans singing altogether, even her boundless ambition hits a wall. Undeterred, she convinces her friends to form an underground show choir — and what starts as an act of rebellion slowly becomes something much bigger: a reminder that music isn't a privilege, it's a lifeline. Funny, heartfelt, and packed with original songs, Plan Bea is an Australian musical feature film that proves you can't stop joy.
1725099.title: Plan Bea

1725116.synopsis: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she’s tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner’s clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.
1725116.title: Simpsley

1725411.synopsis: House hunting in London has already pushed Barry and Alex to the edge, but when they meet an eccentric landlord at a viewing gone off the rails, they’re forced to ask: is this madness or just the rental market?
1725411.title: Break Clause

1725502.synopsis: Six diverse professional dancers navigate the dance of life as they balance the rhythms of motherhood and their demanding careers, unveiling the joys, struggles, and triumphs of pursuing their dreams.
1725502.title: Mama Dancers

1725567.synopsis: A new feature-length surf film featuring 100% never-before-seen waves, taken from over 300 hours of footage shot during the two-year journey to make "South To Sian".
1725567.title: Sian Sessions

1725760.synopsis: Jing An reconnects with her parents during their short visit to Sydney. Through small gestures and everyday moments, the film observes the tenderness and distance within a family.
1725760.title: Then the Wind Stops

1725959.synopsis: From a quiet academy hopeful to one of football's most prolific strikers, this documentary traces Harry Kane's determined rise through setbacks, loan spells, and relentless self-belief. Blending personal interviews, unseen training-ground moments, and career-defining matches, it reveals how discipline, mentality, and leadership transformed him from an underestimated youngster into a global sporting icon.
1725959.title: Harry Kane: Against the Odds

1726465.synopsis: Booze, Blood and Gators. A broke-down swamper with a bottle in one hand and a blade in the other learns the hard way that rage will rot your soul.
1726465.title: Gator Face

1727869.synopsis: Paani follows a heartfelt story of two brothers torn apart by militancy, loss, love, and painful social traditions.
1727869.title: Paani

1728002.synopsis: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.
1728002.title: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz

1728056.synopsis: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.
1728056.title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy

1728105.synopsis: While recording vocal takes alone in a deserted carpark, an anxious singer confronts the shadows outside and the fear within.
1728105.title: Singer

1728113.synopsis: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.
1728113.title: Katseye: Wild Hearts

1728503.synopsis: Former Victoria detective Narelle Fraser investigated some of Australia’s highest profile crimes. Her easy manner allowed her to gain rapport with many perpetrators, leading to their convictions… but it all came at a price. The constant daily exposure to horrific crime had a cumulative effect on Narelle’s mental health. She hid the effects for 27 years, but after suffering panic and amnesia, she received a diagnosis of PTSD, which forced her discharge from the Police. THE POLICEWOMAN illustrates the crimes that caused her descent into hell, and the battle to claw her way out. Narelle’s positive outcome in this true crime feature will demystify the stigma of mental health and speak to millions of first responders around the world.
1728503.title: The Policewoman

1728564.synopsis: A look at the artists and Imagineers whose creativity shaped Disney’s newest addition.
1728564.title: The Magic Behind Island Tower At Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows

1728629.synopsis: Kaka, branded as a curse since birth by his fellow villagers goes on to win a lottery ticket. And that changes everyone's behaviour towards him. But there's a twist in the story which only Kaka knows.
1728629.title: Kaka Jamm Peya

1728954.synopsis: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?
1728954.title: My Grandfather Charles Manson

1729196.synopsis: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.
1729196.title: Dread

1729399.synopsis: This autobiographical experimental documentary explores the story behind Ben Duffy’s first film, We Are Skateboarders, and the 15-year mental health journey that followed. Ben was 19 and living with undiagnosed bipolar disorder when he made the film. Although it became the second most-watched skateboarding documentary after Dogtown and Z-Boys, it was not a commercial success. As attention grew, Ben’s mental health deteriorated, forcing him to question the meaning of success in life and art. His healing began through therapy, where he confronted trauma, shame, guilt, and complex PTSD linked to the filmmaking experience. The documentary captures his transformation from immense pain toward catharsis, self-love, and compassion. It is a raw and inspiring exploration of resilience, creativity, and mental health.
1729399.title: We Are Skateboarders: A Mental Health Transformation

1729559.synopsis: A celebrated composer facing death, his working-class neighbour facing jail, and a sharp New York writer form an unlikely alliance over one charged weekend in Far North Queensland.
1729559.title: Storm Bird

1730324.synopsis: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.
1730324.title: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi

1730482.synopsis: A queer and trans found family create a death ritual that weaves together the inextricable experiences of grief and eros, community and country.
1730482.title: HARD / SOFT / STICKY / WET: A Joyous Death

1730721.synopsis: Jack moves into a share house. Things quickly spiral.
1730721.title: Dean

1730775.synopsis: Two wealthy space tourists embark on the trip of a lifetime. Literally.
1730775.title: Space Turd

1730968.synopsis: Fragments of recreated archival footage depicts daily life along the Mekong River in the countryside of Cambodia. Cooking, planting rice, children at school and crossing the river is captured on Super 8, yet the fictional time period is unknown. An imagined flash flood submerges everything. “Where is the old house? Do you go through here?” A voice repeats over and over again. All is not lost as water drops ripple open portals of memories that reemerge from the depths of the river.
1730968.title: Lost In The Water

1731494.synopsis: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.
1731494.title: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic

1731594.synopsis: In the year 2073, where all copies of films have been lost in a sea of AI-generated replicas, two detectives seek out the original copy of 'The Matrix'.
1731594.title: How Do You Remember The Matrix?

1731954.title: Libera nos: Il trionfo sul male

1732051.synopsis: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.
1732051.title: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man

1732097.synopsis: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.
1732097.title: Euphoria: A Look Back

1732324.synopsis: A middle-class man's carefully balanced life is turned upside down by unexpected challenges that test his dreams, relationships, and resilience. As he faces one setback after another, he discovers the true meaning of family, perseverance, and self-worth.
1732324.title: Mister Middle Class

1732489.synopsis: Stretching more than 5,600 kilometres across the country, the Dingo Fence stands as a symbol of one of Australia’s longest-running and most complex debates. On one side, livelihoods depend on protecting livestock. On the other, a native apex predator plays a vital role in the health of our ecosystems. On The Fence is a feature documentary that brings together graziers, scientists, First Nations voices and conservationists to explore the people, landscapes and ideas at the heart of this conversation. Rather than asking who is right or wrong, On The Fence asks a different question: are we willing to coexist with apex predators and learn from the mistakes of our past?
1732489.title: On the Fence

1732857.synopsis: Details how self-help guru Soulaire Allerai manipulated followers into financial and mental dependency through isolation and forced communal living. Former members describe the organization's promises of enlightenment masking a reality of strict control and abuse.
1732857.title: People Magazine Investigates: The Cult of the Soulful Journey

1733915.synopsis: When reigniting memories from his past, a lowly drifter come face to face with his deepest secret.
1733915.title: Skeleton

1734011.synopsis: An aspiring fashion designer fights to prove himself against his father's wishes. Just as love enters his life, a mysterious disappearance sets him on an unforgettable journey into a hidden world where his true destiny awaits.
1734011.title: Raja The Raja

1734152.synopsis: While patrolling a restricted zone, Agent MU-0213 is ordered to track down and execute a deserter. During a deadly confrontation, he discovers that his opponent is the fugitive agent MU-1225, known as Tristan. Cornered and seemingly doomed, MU-0213 is spared when Tristan asks him a single, unexpected question: "Do you have a name?" The question awakens fragmented memories, forcing MU-0213 to question everything he believes about himself. But what is Tristan really after, and why would a skilled sniper spare his enemy when he had the perfect chance to kill him?
1734152.title: The Executor

1734379.synopsis: After surviving a mass shooting at her office, a former mean exec attends a secluded therapy retreat in the hopes of recovering, but when odd occurrences keep happening, she begins to suspect that something else is lurking in the shadows.
1734379.title: A Mind in Chaos

1735460.synopsis: In a remote town, a 14-year-old misfit teenager becomes manipulated by a mysterious, disfigured old man.
1735460.title: Hide

1736415.synopsis: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.
1736415.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On

1736916.synopsis: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.
1736916.title: Instadocs: The Prediction Games

1736993.synopsis: On another world much like our own, a young Samoyed named Seamus Alessandro O'Shaughnessy discovers a lost girl named Dakota who has unfathomable magic! Seamus must overcome great challenges both physical & emotional alongside his best friend Carolina Oriqueda Campbell Keeshond-Seal to save Great Canyon City from the Menace known as The Blurred Blaze! Can our heroes defeat their foes while simultaneously protecting an innocent child in the process? And who exactly is The Blurred Blaze?
1736993.title: Thera: The Inverted Planet

1738070.synopsis: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.
1738070.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour

1738701.synopsis: Patriot Southern Command under General Nathaniel Greene organizes militias for a push against the British.
1738701.title: Rise and Fight: The Battle of Hobkirk's Hill

1738843.synopsis: Follows Ken Jeong and Rei Ami as they launch a public awareness campaign to reshape the perception of sharks across East Asia using K-Pop after shark encounters off the Korean Peninsula.
1738843.title: K-Pop Shark Heroes

1739186.synopsis: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.
1739186.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young

1739202.synopsis: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.
1739202.title: Untold: Raygun: Breaking Badly

1739206.synopsis: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.
1739206.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool

1739317.synopsis: In four thought-provoking sci-fi stories, people confront altered memories, forbidden love, artificial lifetimes and extraordinary powers. As time, identity and reality begin to shift, each must decide what truly makes a life worth living.
1739317.title: Echoes of Tomorrow

1739614.synopsis: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white shark believed to be one of largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.
1739614.title: Invasion of the Mega Sharks

1739619.synopsis: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder and predator specialist Rosie Moore head to Jupiter, Florida to uncover what's fueling a surge in bull shark aggression. Testing weather, prey and human behavior, they build toward one explosive final demonstration.
1739619.title: Bull Shark Dinner Bell

1739626.synopsis: A new report of a 15-foot mako shark off the coast of Mexico shatters conventional wisdom on how large these sharks can grow. A team of experts heads to the Pacific Ocean to track down this mega shark and find the biggest mako in the world.
1739626.title: Biggest Mako on Earth

1739628.synopsis: In New Zealand's waters, great white "houses" battle for dominance. Experts risk it all to reveal the bloodlines that determine their allegiances.
1739628.title: House of Sharks

1739632.synopsis: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).
1739632.title: Jurassic Sharks

1739635.synopsis: This special investigates the chilling phenomenon of great white sharks washing ashore with their livers extracted with surgical precision. To decode the orca's "kill sequence," the team travels to the Strait of Gibraltar, where orcas have developed a highly organized tactic of ramming sailboats, crippling rudders, and even sinking vessels.
1739635.title: Jaws vs. Orca

1739638.synopsis: Forrest Galante explores America's strangest alien sharks in celebration of the nation's 250th anniversary.
1739638.title: Alien Sharks: Untamed America

1739640.synopsis: Josh Gates explores Scotland's Stronsay Beast, the earliest known shark attack and how the USS Indianapolis led to history's deadliest attack.
1739640.title: Expedition Unknown: Shark Secrets

1739641.synopsis: The team investigates disturbing reports of aggressive mutant sharks in the Marshall Islands, exploring whether the region's atomic past is to blame.
1739641.title: Expedition X: Atomic Sharks

1739643.synopsis: Experts analyze shark encounters caught on camera, using forensics to review bite marks and behavior patterns as they wonder: What shark attacked?
1739643.title: What Shark Attacked?

1739644.synopsis: Experts attempt to train great white sharks using cues and challenges to test learning, memory, and decision-making in the wild.
1739644.title: How to Train a Great White

1739647.synopsis: In a world first, a cliff diver Molly Carlson attempts a 50-foot dive off a helicopter into a floating cage surrounded by a shark feeding frenzy.
1739647.title: Ultimate Shark Dive

1739649.synopsis: A scientist hunts for a possible radioactive shark killer near an old nuclear dumping ground in New York that's ringed with makos and great whites.
1739649.title: Sharkzilla Takes New York

1739651.synopsis: Four shark fanatics reveal their obsessions, including an intimate relationship, a massive collection, and a body covered in sharks.
1739651.title: My Strange Shark Addiction

1739654.synopsis: Dr. Craig O'Connell and Aliah Banchik deploy state-of-the-art tech as they try to capture the thresher's deadly tail whip on film in the Philippines.
1739654.title: Thresher Shark: Stun to Kill

1739655.synopsis: Ben is a hired assassin who works for a mastermind serial killer, Ian. But when his boss is murdered, Ben has to confront Ian's killer and take vengeance upon him.
1739655.title: THE BEAN

1739960.synopsis: An investigative documentary exploring long-standing and newly detailed allegations of sexual misconduct, grooming, and criminal sexual conduct against Oscar-winning actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman Jared Leto.
1739960.title: Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret

1740133.synopsis: Returning to his hometown after serving time for manslaughter, “Maniac” faces an unpaid debt— along with an unwelcome spiritual presence.
1740133.title: Blak magic

1740313.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.
1740313.title: Stamptown

1740332.synopsis: A 30-year-old British-Mexican comic creator visits her parents to secure a deposit for her first flat, only to find help won’t come because her mother, 51, is pregnant.
1740332.title: Chasing Home

1740362.synopsis: Beyond Borders Patagonia follows a group of filmmakers, surfers and snowboarders on a journey into Chile's final frontiers, in search of undiscovered waves and hidden mountains in the Andes, with no blueprint and everything at stake.
1740362.title: Beyond Borders Patagonia

1740614.synopsis: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.
1740614.title: Newton's 3rd Law

1740844.synopsis: When the sacred Theyyam ritual demands the ultimate sacrifice from a young boy, his parents dare to challenge centuries-old beliefs. An emotional drama about faith, loss, and the courage to defy tradition
1740844.title: Paithallattam

1740877.synopsis: In the Storm on Sesame Street special, Elmo and his friends work together to get ready for a big storm, learning how to be prepared, have courage, and calm their bodies and minds when things feel scary. After the storm passes, Sesame Street looks different, and everyone pitches in to help their neighbors rebuild their homes. With the help of the neighborhood, including celebrity guests Post Malone and Michelle Buteau, Elmo and Abby set out to make a difference, and discover that small acts of kindness, and support from friends, can make the biggest difference of all.
1740877.title: Storm on Sesame Street

1740989.synopsis: "IDOL" is a confessional piece by underground artist AQUAKEY. Set in the near future, the story follows Gleb Bykhovtsev—a rising star in the entertainment industry signed to a major label. Weary of relentless commercialism and censorship, Gleb disrupts the "Artist of the Year" awards ceremony where he was a nominee, triggering a downward spiral in his life. "IDOL" is a story about a life one would never wish to live. A non-linear narrative interweaves two parallel versions of Gleb’s existence: his dream—fantasies of the future—and his reality—memories of a sober past. Or is it the other way around? An independent, non-commercial, and genuinely raw, provocative auteur film by debut director Egor Kudinov.
1740989.title: IDOL

1741004.synopsis: Follows General William T. Sherman's 1865 Union push from Savannah, Georgia, into South Carolina. The film details the campaign's battlefield clashes at Broxton and River's Bridge, a rare Union cavalry defeat at Aiken, and the continued Union advance toward Columbia and North Carolina.
1741004.title: Sherman's March Through the Carolinas

1741201.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?
1741201.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​

1741346.synopsis: A husband's fight to save his wife from a demonic possession that began the moment the dybbuk box chose her as its next host.
1741346.title: Evil Follows

1741784.title: The Apparition: final piece in The Ship trilogy

1742417.synopsis: Ahura is a wheelchair carrier who tries to escape at all costs, but finds Gymbia being a decisive presence on a stormy day.
1742417.title: Dias de Tempestade

1742483.synopsis: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.
1742483.title: Biff the Human Slayer

1743303.synopsis: Truth or Consequence is a concert film in which Amyl and The Sniffers perform country-influenced versions of their songs, two unreleased tracks, and a cover of the Slim Dusty classic 'Lights On The Hill'. It was recorded and filmed in front of an intimate and increasingly rowdy audience at El Coyote in Los Angeles, by the band's long-time collaborator, John Angus Stewart.
1743303.title: Truth Or Consequence

1743364.synopsis: A film of live music photographed at the famous El Coyote mexican restaurant on Beverly Blvd, Los Angeles 90036.
1743364.title: Amyl and the Sniffers Present: Truth or Consequence

1744007.synopsis: Earth's gravity weakens, causing devastating earthquakes and electric anomalies that magnetize objects to catastrophic effect. As the planet is ripped apart, a team of expert scientists must figure out the cause and save the world.
1744007.title: Geo-Storm

1744177.synopsis: The director sits down with her grandparents, Elenea and Manuel Paplera as they look back at what they remember about growing up at the end and post WWII in Philippines under Japanese occupation and how being raised in that environment has affected them and how they’ve gone about raising their family. From memories of their youth, to deciding to pick up their lives and immigrating their family to Australia, to working laborious jobs to provide for their family. After sitting down with her Lola and Lolo, the director uncovers her connection to her Filipino heritage. After strife over two countries and three generations her family is still here now, betting over Mahjong games against their friends.
1744177.title: Family Ties

1744681.synopsis: Three roommates borrow money from a dangerous lender to start a business. When their plan fails, they face serious consequences. Caught in a risky situation, they must use their wits to survive and fix their mistakes.
1744681.title: M.R.P (Neekentha Naakentha)

1744724.synopsis: Reflecting on his prolific, award-winning career in music and stage acting, Daniel Lavoie has no plans to slow down, with continuing performances around the world.
1744724.title: Daniel Lavoie: Failing at Retirement

1744734.synopsis: From Canada to Europe’s great opera houses, soprano Barbara Hannigan builds a fearless career defined by risk, precision and emotional intensity.
1744734.title: Barbara Hannigan: Soprano and Conductor

1744735.synopsis: Being together takes practice, and it's one of Sae Hoon (Stan) Chung’s favourite lessons from the arts community. It means letting go of the fear of having to try again.
1744735.title: Sae Hoon Chung: Worlding

1744737.synopsis: This short film is a reflective portrait of Tonya Williams, shaped through her encounter with her own archives. As she revisits these materials, Tonya recounts the memories that have anchored her journey.
1744737.title: Tonya Williams: One Way or Another
